example.en: Heavy rain damaged several boxes stored near the loading door.
example.zh: 大雨損壞了存放在裝貨門附近的幾個箱子。

senses.en: broken or harmed so that it cannot work or look normal

example.en: Please report any damaged packages to the shipping desk.
example.zh: 請向出貨櫃台通報任何受損的包裹。

senses.en: harm that is done to something
senses.distinguish: 不可數，常見 damage to、cause damage、water damage。

example.en: The fire caused serious damage to the storage building.
example.zh: 這場火災對儲存倉庫造成嚴重損害。

senses.en: money that a person or company must pay for harm they caused
senses.distinguish: 用複數 damages，常搭配 pay、claim、award，與不可數的 damage 不同。

example.en: The supplier agreed to pay damages for the late delivery.
example.zh: 供應商同意為延遲交貨支付損害賠償金。

extra_vocab.en: without paying any money
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡，客服說因為這個馬克杯屬於春季促銷，所以可以免費寄出替代品。at no cost 比 free 正式，是客服與公告裡常見的客氣說法。
extra_vocab.pattern: provide／send／offer + N + at no cost (to + 人)
extra_vocab.grammar_note: at no cost 多放在句尾，後面可接 to + 人，如 at no cost to you；加 extra 變成 at no extra cost，表示不另外加價。

examples.en: We will repair the printer at no cost during the warranty period.
examples.zh: 保固期間，我們會免費修理這台印表機。

examples.en: Employees can attend the training workshop at no cost to them.
examples.zh: 員工可以免費參加這場培訓工作坊。

examples.en: This offer lets members upgrade their plan at no cost.
examples.zh: 這項優惠讓會員可以免費升級方案。

examples.en: Hotel guests may use the fitness center at no cost.
examples.zh: 飯店住客可以免費使用健身中心。

similar.diff: 意思相同，更常出現在公告、收據與服務條款；後面通常不接 to + 人。

example.en: Parking is available free of charge for all registered guests.
example.zh: 所有登記的賓客都可以免費停車。

similar.diff: 比較口語，常用在日常對話或網站說明，語氣沒那麼正式。

example.en: Customers can download the user guide for free from our website.
example.zh: 客戶可以從我們的網站免費下載使用手冊。

similar.diff: 是形容詞，放在名詞前，指飯店、航空或活動中招待的免費服務；at no cost 是副詞片語。

example.en: Guests receive a complimentary breakfast with every room booking.
example.zh: 每筆訂房都附贈住客一份免費早餐。

confusable.diff: at cost 是「以成本價」出售，還是要付錢；at no cost 才是完全免費。

example.en: We sell the old stock at cost to clear the warehouse.
example.zh: 我們以成本價出售舊庫存，好清空倉庫。

confusable.diff: at low cost 是「低成本、價格便宜」，仍然需要付費；at no cost 是完全不用付錢。

example.en: The new system lets us store files at low cost.
example.zh: 新系統讓我們能以低成本儲存檔案。

items.tag: 合約付款條款與年度預算

level.why: 以公司合約與年度預算為核心，包含條款、付款期限與財務規劃等中高頻商務字彙；文章需要同時理解條件、金額與後續處理方式。

items.passage:
To: Regional Managers
Subject: Updated Software Contract

The finance department has approved the budget for our new inventory management software. Under the contract, the company will pay 40 percent of the total fee when the agreement is signed and the remaining balance within thirty days after installation. The annual maintenance fee is not included in the initial payment and will be billed separately each January.

Please review the contract carefully before signing it. In particular, check the clause concerning early termination. If a department cancels the service before the first twelve months have ended, an additional fee will apply. The accounting team will keep a copy of each signed contract for the annual audit. Please send any questions to the finance department by Friday.
items.zh:
收件人：各區域經理
主旨：更新後的軟體合約

財務部門已核准新庫存管理軟體的預算。根據合約，公司會在協議簽署時支付總費用的 40%，剩餘款項則在安裝完成後 30 天內支付。年度維護費不包含在初始付款中，而是每年一月另外開立帳單。

請在簽署前仔細審閱合約。尤其要確認與提前終止相關的條款。如果某部門在前 12 個月結束前取消服務，將會產生額外費用。會計團隊會保留每份已簽署合約的副本，以供年度稽核使用。如有任何問題，請於週五前寄給財務部門。

vocab.col: sign a contract / review a contract

questions.q: When must the company pay the remaining balance?
opts: At the beginning of each January
Before the first twelve months end
why: 合約是在審閱後簽署，不是此處所說的剩餘款付款時間。
正解：剩餘款項必須在安裝完成後 30 天內支付。
一月支付的是年度維護費。
前 12 個月是提前終止條款的相關期間。

questions.q: What will happen if a department cancels the service early?
opts: The maintenance fee will be waived.
The contract will be renewed automatically.
why: 文章沒有說提前取消會增加預算。
年度維護費並不會因此自動免除。
正解：若在前 12 個月結束前取消服務，將產生額外費用。
文章沒有提到會自動續約。

questions.q: Managers should review the contract carefully before ______ it.
why: before 後面此處需要動名詞作為介系詞的受詞。
signed 為過去式或過去分詞，不能直接接在 before 後表達這個動作。
正解：signing 是動名詞，before signing it 表示「在簽署它之前」。
to signing 的形式錯誤，不能使用 to 加動名詞。

questions.q: The annual maintenance fee will be billed ______ each January.
why: 正解：separately 是副詞，用來修飾 billed，表示「另外開立帳單」。
separate 是形容詞，不能直接修飾 billed。
separation 是名詞，不符合句型。
separating 是分詞，文法與語意都不合。

questions.q: The accounting team keeps signed contracts ______ the annual audit.
why: by 通常表示「在某個時間以前」或方式，不符合此處目的。
正解：for 表示保存合約的目的，即供年度稽核使用。
during 表示「在……期間」，不是此處強調的用途。
against 通常表示對抗或預防，語意不符。

extra_vocab.en: happening once every year, or relating to one year
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 annual audit 指每年一次的查帳，annual maintenance fee 則是每年收一次的維護費。annual 只放在名詞前面修飾，不能放在 be 動詞後面當補語。

example.en: The annual report will be published in March.
example.zh: 年度報告將在三月公布。

example.en: Shareholders will vote at the annual meeting next month.
example.zh: 股東將在下個月的年會上投票。

example.en: The card has no annual fee for the first year.
example.zh: 這張卡第一年不收年費。

example.en: Each department must submit its annual budget by November.
example.zh: 各部門必須在十一月前提交年度預算。

examples.en: Please attach last year's sales figures to the annual summary.
examples.zh: 請把去年的銷售數字附在年度摘要裡。

examples.en: Employees receive an annual review of their work each spring.
examples.zh: 員工每年春天都會接受一次工作考核。

examples.en: Our annual sales have grown by ten percent since 2022.
examples.zh: 自 2022 年以來，我們的年度銷售額成長了百分之十。

confusable.diff: 兩者意思相近；annual 較正式，常用於報告、費用、會議，yearly 較口語，也可當副詞。
anniversary 是名詞，指某件事發生後每年的紀念日；annual 是形容詞，指每年一次的。

example.en: We plan to open two new offices this year.
example.zh: 我們計畫今年開設兩間新辦公室。

example.en: The yearly fee can be paid in two parts.
example.zh: 年費可以分兩次繳納。

example.en: The company will celebrate its tenth anniversary in June.
example.zh: 公司將在六月慶祝成立十週年。

example.en: The quarterly report shows a rise in profits.
example.zh: 季度報告顯示獲利上升。

extra_vocab.en: an official check of a company's records to make sure they are correct
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡，annual audit 指公司每年一次的稽核，會計團隊要保留已簽署合約的副本，供稽核人員檢查。audit 也可以當動詞，意思是「稽核、查帳」。

example.en: Our company undergoes two audits every year by outside firms.
example.zh: 我們公司每年接受外部機構的兩次稽核。

example.en: The firm will audit all branch offices this autumn.
example.zh: 這家公司今年秋天會稽核所有分公司。

example.en: She audits the supplier's records twice a year.
example.zh: 她每年查核供應商的紀錄兩次。

example.en: Last year's accounts were audited by an independent firm.
example.zh: 去年的帳目是由一家獨立公司稽核的。

example.en: The team is auditing the travel expenses this week.
example.zh: 團隊本週正在查核差旅費用。

example.en: An external auditor will visit our office next Tuesday.
example.zh: 一位外部稽核員下週二會來我們辦公室。

example.en: All departments must prepare their records for the annual audit.
example.zh: 所有部門都必須為年度稽核準備好紀錄。

example.en: An outside firm will conduct an audit of our accounts.
example.zh: 一家外部公司將對我們的帳目進行稽核。

example.en: The internal audit found several errors in the expense reports.
example.zh: 內部稽核發現費用報告中有幾處錯誤。

example.en: The factory passed the audit without any major problems.
example.zh: 這家工廠順利通過稽核，沒有重大問題。

examples.en: The finance team is getting ready for next month's audit.
examples.zh: 財務團隊正在為下個月的稽核做準備。

examples.en: Please send me the signed contracts before the audit begins.
examples.zh: 請在稽核開始前把已簽署的合約寄給我。

examples.en: A quality audit showed that the supplier follows our standards.
examples.zh: 品質稽核顯示供應商有遵守我們的標準。

examples.en: The manager asked us to audit last year's travel expenses.
examples.zh: 經理要我們查核去年的差旅費用。

confusable.diff: inspection 多指到現場檢查物品、設備或環境；audit 是檢查帳目、文件與制度是否正確。

example.en: The inspection of the new machines will start at nine tomorrow.
example.zh: 新機器的檢查明天九點開始。

confusable.diff: review 是一般的檢視或審閱，比較不正式；audit 是有固定流程的正式稽核。

example.en: Please review the draft contract and send me your comments.
example.zh: 請審閱合約草稿，並把你的意見寄給我。

example.en: The auditor asked to see all the payment records.
example.zh: 稽核員要求查看所有付款紀錄。

example.en: She works in the accounting department of a large bank.
example.zh: 她在一家大銀行的會計部門工作。

example.en: The safety inspection will take place on Tuesday morning.
example.zh: 安全檢查將在星期二早上進行。

example.en: The audit checks our compliance with company policy.
example.zh: 這次稽核會檢查我們是否遵守公司政策。

derived.link: audit + -or，做事的人，像 actor、visitor；負責稽核的人

example.en: The annual audit will begin on the first Monday of March.
example.zh: 年度稽核將在三月第一個星期一開始。

example.en: An outside firm will audit our accounts every year.
example.zh: 一家外部公司每年都會查核我們的帳目。

senses.en: an official check of a company's money records

example.en: The financial audit showed that all the payments were correct.
example.zh: 財務稽核顯示所有付款都正確無誤。

senses.en: a check to see if a company follows its rules or standards
senses.distinguish: 不一定查帳，也可以查流程、品質或安全是否符合標準，前面常加 quality、safety。

example.en: The supplier passed the safety audit with a very high score.
example.zh: 供應商以很高的分數通過了安全稽核。

extra_vocab.zh: 庫存；庫存清單；存貨盤點
extra_vocab.en: all the goods that a company has in stock, or a list of them
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡放在 management software 前面，當作名詞修飾語（inventory management software），指「庫存管理軟體」。多益常見於倉儲、零售與採購情境。

example.en: Retailers reduce their inventories after the holiday season ends.
example.zh: 假期旺季結束後，零售商會降低他們的庫存。

example.en: Good inventory management helps us avoid running out of products.
example.zh: 良好的庫存管理能幫助我們避免商品缺貨。

example.en: The staff will take inventory at the end of the month.
example.zh: 員工會在月底盤點庫存。

example.en: Better inventory control reduced our storage costs this year.
example.zh: 更好的庫存控制降低了我們今年的倉儲成本。

example.en: We have more than 500 units in inventory right now.
example.zh: 我們目前庫存有五百多件。

examples.en: The warehouse manager checks the inventory every Monday morning.
examples.zh: 倉庫經理每週一早上檢查庫存。

examples.en: Our summer inventory will arrive in the stores next week.
examples.zh: 我們的夏季存貨下週會送到各家門市。

examples.en: High inventory levels are costing the company too much money.
examples.zh: 過高的庫存水準讓公司花費太多錢。

confusable.diff: 兩者常可互換；stock 較口語，也可指股票；inventory 較正式，也指「庫存清單」或「盤點」。

example.en: Our stock price rose after the company launched its new product.
example.zh: 公司推出新產品後，我們的股價上漲了。

confusable.diff: supply 是「供應量、補給」；inventory 是公司目前實際持有的貨品。

example.en: The factory has a steady supply of parts from two vendors.
example.zh: 這家工廠有兩家廠商穩定供應零件。

example.en: This item is currently out of stock.
example.zh: 這項商品目前缺貨。

example.en: The goods are kept in a warehouse near the port.
example.zh: 貨物存放在靠近港口的倉庫裡。

derived.link: 同一個詞幹 invent-，是這一組字最基礎的動詞，意思是做出以前沒有的東西
invent + -ion，把「發明」這個動作變成名詞，像 decide → decision
invent + -or，做事的人，像 actor、visitor
invent + -ive，形容「有發明力的」，像 creative、active

senses.en: all the goods that a company has in stock

example.en: The store keeps a large inventory of winter coats.
example.zh: 這家店備有大量冬季外套的庫存。

senses.en: a list of all the goods or items that a company has
senses.distinguish: 指「一份清單」，常搭配 send、update、check 等動詞。

example.en: Please send me the inventory of office supplies by Friday.
example.zh: 請在週五前把辦公用品的庫存清單寄給我。

senses.en: the act of counting all the goods in a store or warehouse
senses.distinguish: 常見 take inventory 或 inventory count，指清點貨品的動作。

example.en: Inventory will take all day on Saturday, so we close early.
example.zh: 盤點星期六會花一整天，所以我們提早打烊。

extra_vocab.en: regular care and repair of equipment or software that is done or paid for each year
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡 annual maintenance fee 指軟體合約的「年度維護費」，與一次性的初期費用分開，每年一月另外請款。maintenance 是名詞，這裡作為 fee 的修飾詞。
extra_vocab.pattern: annual maintenance + fee / contract / check

examples.en: The annual maintenance contract covers repairs and software updates.
examples.zh: 年度維護合約涵蓋維修與軟體更新。

examples.en: The elevator needs an annual maintenance check by a licensed company.
examples.zh: 電梯需要由有執照的公司進行年度維護檢查。

examples.en: We have included annual maintenance costs in next year's budget.
examples.zh: 我們已把年度維護費用編入明年的預算。

similar.diff: regular maintenance 是「定期維護」，不限一年一次；annual maintenance 指每年一次。

example.en: Regular maintenance of the machines happens every three months.
example.zh: 機器的定期維護每三個月進行一次。

similar.diff: 意思相同；annual 較正式，常用於合約與公文。

example.en: The yearly maintenance contract is renewed each January.
example.zh: 年度維護合約每年一月續約。

confusable.diff: annual 是形容詞（annual fee）；annually 是副詞（paid annually），放在動詞後。

example.en: The annual fee must be paid annually, not monthly.
example.zh: 這筆年費必須按年支付，而不是按月。

extra_vocab.en: sent a bill to someone to ask for payment
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡是被動語態 will be billed，意思是「（這筆費用）將另外開帳單請款」。bill 當動詞時，常見句型是 bill + 人 + for + 費用，或被動 be billed。

example.en: We will bill the client once the work is finished.
example.zh: 工作完成後，我們會向客戶開立帳單。

example.en: The agency bills clients for every extra hour worked.
example.zh: 這家代理商會就每一小時額外工時向客戶收費。

example.en: The supplier billed us for the wrong quantity last month.
example.zh: 供應商上個月向我們開了錯誤數量的帳單。

example.en: Billing errors can cause delays in customer payments.
example.zh: 帳務錯誤可能造成客戶付款延遲。

example.en: The company will bill us for the extra service.
example.zh: 公司會就額外服務向我們請款。

example.en: Customers are billed monthly for their internet service.
example.zh: 客戶的網路服務按月計費。

example.en: Please contact the billing department about this mistake.
example.zh: 關於這個錯誤，請聯絡帳務部門。

example.en: Please enter your billing address at checkout.
example.zh: 結帳時請輸入您的帳單地址。

examples.en: You were billed twice for the same order last week.
examples.zh: 你上週同一筆訂單被收了兩次費用。

examples.en: The hotel billed my credit card for the wrong amount.
examples.zh: 飯店用我的信用卡扣了錯誤的金額。

confusable.diff: charge 是「收費、扣款」；bill 強調「寄出帳單請對方付款」，不一定馬上扣款。

example.en: The hotel will charge your credit card when you check in.
example.zh: 你辦理入住時，飯店會直接從你的信用卡扣款。

confusable.diff: invoice 作動詞是「開立發票／請款單」，多用於公司之間；bill 較一般，也可對個人。

example.en: Our company will invoice the client after the work is finished.
example.zh: 工作完成後，我們公司會向客戶開立請款單。

example.en: The electricity bill is higher this month.
example.zh: 這個月的電費帳單比較高。

example.en: The billing system will be updated tonight.
example.zh: 帳務系統將於今晚更新。

example.en: We will send the invoice by email.
example.zh: 我們會用電子郵件寄出請款單。

derived.link: bill + -ing，把「開帳單」這件事變成名詞，像 meeting、building
over-（過多）+ bill，開出過多的帳單，像 overtime、overload

example.en: The vendor will bill us at the end of each month.
example.zh: 供應商會在每個月底向我們開帳單。

example.en: Please pay the electricity bill before the due date.
example.zh: 請在到期日之前繳清電費帳單。

senses.en: to send someone a bill to ask for payment

example.en: The clinic will bill your insurance company directly.
example.zh: 診所會直接向你的保險公司請款。

senses.en: to describe something in advertising or news in a certain way
senses.distinguish: 常用被動 be billed as + 名詞，後面沒有金額，也不是請款。

example.en: The conference is billed as the largest in the industry.
example.zh: 這場會議被宣傳為業界規模最大的一場。

senses.en: a piece of paper money
senses.distinguish: 常見於美式英語，前面會有金額，如 a ten-dollar bill。

example.en: The machine only accepts five-dollar and ten-dollar bills.
example.zh: 這台機器只收五美元和十美元的紙鈔。

senses.en: a plan for a new law that is discussed by lawmakers
senses.distinguish: 常搭配 pass、sign、a bill，出現在新聞或政府相關情境。

example.en: The new bill would lower taxes for small businesses.
example.zh: 這項新法案會降低小型企業的稅負。

extra_vocab.en: especially; used to point to one important thing in a larger group
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡放在句首，用來從「請仔細檢閱合約」這個大範圍中，點出最需要注意的一項（提前終止條款）。語感是「其中特別要留意的是…」，後面常接逗號。
extra_vocab.pattern: In particular, + 句子 ／ 名詞 + in particular

examples.en: Sales improved last quarter, in particular in the online market.
examples.zh: 上一季銷售成長，尤其是在網路市場。

examples.en: Please read the safety rules. In particular, note the new exit plan.
examples.zh: 請閱讀安全規定，特別要留意新的逃生路線。

examples.en: Customers liked the service, and the fast delivery in particular.
examples.zh: 顧客喜歡這項服務，尤其喜歡快速送貨。

similar.diff: especially 是副詞，可放在句中修飾；in particular 常放句首或句尾，語氣較正式、較強調。

example.en: Sales rose last quarter, especially in the online market.
example.zh: 上一季銷售上升，尤其是網路市場。

similar.diff: specifically 強調「明確指出某一項」；in particular 強調「特別重要的一項」。

example.en: The manager specifically asked us to check the safety rules.
example.zh: 經理明確要求我們檢查安全規定。

confusable.diff: particularly 是副詞，放在形容詞或動詞前（particularly useful）；in particular 是片語，通常獨立使用。

example.en: The new software is particularly useful for small warehouses.
example.zh: 這套新軟體對小型倉庫特別有用。

extra_vocab.en: the act of ending something, such as a contract or a job
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡是合約用語，early termination 指「提前終止合約」，也就是未滿期限就取消服務，因此會有額外費用。多益合約與人事情境中常見，語氣正式。

example.en: Several terminations were reported during the company restructuring last year.
example.zh: 去年公司重整期間，通報了數起終止案件。

example.en: We may terminate this agreement with thirty days' notice.
example.zh: 我們可以提前三十天通知來終止這份協議。

example.en: The contract terminates automatically if payment is not received.
example.zh: 如果沒有收到款項，合約會自動終止。

example.en: The supplier terminated the agreement after repeated late payments.
example.zh: 在多次延遲付款後，供應商終止了協議。

example.en: Terminating the contract early would cost us extra fees.
example.zh: 提前終止合約會讓我們多付額外費用。

example.en: Either side may request termination of the contract in writing.
example.zh: 任何一方都可以書面要求終止合約。

example.en: We must send a termination notice thirty days in advance.
example.zh: 我們必須提前三十天寄出終止通知。

example.en: A termination fee applies if you cancel in the first year.
example.zh: 若您在第一年內取消，需支付解約費。

example.en: The termination of employment will take effect on March 1.
example.zh: 終止僱用將於三月一日生效。

examples.en: Early termination may cause extra costs for both companies.
examples.zh: 提前終止可能讓兩家公司都產生額外費用。

examples.en: The employee received a letter about the termination of his job.
examples.zh: 那位員工收到一封關於終止他工作的信。

examples.en: The company decided to terminate the agreement with the supplier.
examples.zh: 公司決定終止與供應商的協議。

confusable.diff: cancellation 是取消訂單、預約或服務；termination 多指終止合約或僱用關係，較正式。

example.en: Please confirm the cancellation of the hotel booking by e-mail.
example.zh: 請用電子郵件確認取消飯店訂房。

confusable.diff: expiration 是「到期」，時間到了自然結束；termination 是主動提前結束，或依條款終止。

example.en: The expiration date of the contract is printed on page one.
example.zh: 合約的到期日印在第一頁。

example.en: You may terminate the service at any time.
example.zh: 您可以隨時終止這項服務。

example.en: Please cancel my order before it ships.
example.zh: 請在出貨前取消我的訂單。

example.en: Our contract will expire at the end of June.
example.zh: 我們的合約將在六月底到期。

derived.link: 最基礎的詞幹；terminate + -ion 變成名詞「終止」，像 educate → education、locate → location
termin（終點）+ -al，指路線的終點，像 airport terminal（機場航廈）

senses.en: the act of ending a contract or an agreement

example.en: The termination date in the contract is December thirty-first.
example.zh: 合約中的終止日期是十二月三十一日。

senses.en: the act of ending someone's job
senses.distinguish: 主語或對象是員工或工作時，指解僱；常見 termination letter。

example.en: The company explained the reason for her termination in a letter.
example.zh: 公司在信中說明了她被解僱的原因。

extra_vocab.en: one part of a contract or law that gives a rule or condition
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇指合約裡的一條「條款」。the clause concerning early termination 就是專門談提前終止合約的那一條，簽約前要特別看清楚。

example.en: Please review all clauses in the agreement before signing.
example.zh: 簽約前請審閱協議中的所有條款。

example.en: The termination clause requires thirty days' written notice.
example.zh: 終止條款要求提前三十天以書面通知。

example.en: Our lawyer asked us to add a clause about late fees.
example.zh: 我們的律師要求我們加入一項關於逾期費用的條款。

example.en: The contract includes a clause that protects customer data.
example.zh: 這份合約包含一項保護客戶資料的條款。

examples.en: The last clause says either side can end the contract.
examples.zh: 最後一條條款說明任何一方都可以終止合約。

examples.en: Please see the clause on page three for payment rules.
examples.zh: 付款規定請參閱第三頁的條款。

examples.en: A clause has a subject and a verb.
examples.zh: 子句包含一個主詞和一個動詞。

confusable.diff: term 常指合約中的「條件、條款內容」（terms and conditions），可複數泛指；clause 是合約中一條一條的「條文」。

example.en: Please read the terms of the contract before you sign it.
example.zh: 簽約前請先閱讀合約的條款內容。

confusable.diff: 文法上 phrase 是沒有「主詞＋動詞」的詞組；clause 則有主詞和動詞。

example.en: The words "on time" are a phrase, because they have no verb.
example.zh: 「on time」這幾個字是片語，因為裡面沒有動詞。

example.en: This provision applies to all new employees.
example.zh: 這項規定適用於所有新進員工。

example.en: Please read the terms before you sign.
example.zh: 簽名前請先閱讀條款。

example.en: One condition of the offer is a signed contract.
example.zh: 這項提案的條件之一是簽妥合約。

example.en: Both companies signed the agreement last week.
example.zh: 兩家公司上週簽署了這份協議。

senses.en: one part of a contract that gives a rule or condition

example.en: The payment clause says all invoices are due in thirty days.
example.zh: 付款條款規定所有請款單須在三十天內付清。

senses.en: a group of words with a subject and a verb
senses.distinguish: 在英文文法或寫作的情境出現，如 main clause（主要子句）。

example.en: In this sentence, the clause after "because" gives the reason.
example.zh: 在這個句子裡，because 後面的子句說明了原因。

extra_vocab.zh: 餘額、尾款；平衡（動詞：使平衡）
extra_vocab.en: the money that is still left to pay or still in an account
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇指付款後「剩下的尾款」。the remaining balance 就是頭期款 40% 付完後，剩下要在安裝後三十天內付清的金額。

example.en: The system balances the accounts automatically every night.
example.zh: 系統每晚會自動結算帳目使其相符。

example.en: The finance team balanced the budget before the deadline.
example.zh: 財務團隊在截止日前使預算達到收支平衡。

example.en: Balancing work and family is not always easy for managers.
example.zh: 對主管來說，兼顧工作與家庭並不總是容易。

example.en: The remaining balance is due at the end of the month.
example.zh: 剩餘款項須在月底前付清。

example.en: Please pay the balance before the machine is shipped.
example.zh: 請在機器出貨前付清尾款。

example.en: Check your account balance before you place the order.
example.zh: 下訂單前請先確認你的帳戶餘額。

example.en: The balance due on this invoice is two thousand dollars.
example.zh: 這張發票的應付餘額是兩千美元。

examples.en: We will send you a bill for the balance next week.
examples.zh: 我們下週會寄給你尾款的帳單。

examples.en: Your balance is shown at the top of the statement.
examples.zh: 你的餘額顯示在對帳單的最上方。

examples.en: We must balance cost and quality in this project.
examples.zh: 我們在這個專案中必須兼顧成本與品質。

confusable.diff: remainder 泛指「剩下的部分」（時間、物品都可以）；balance 在財務上特指「帳戶餘額或尚未付清的金額」。

example.en: We will use the remainder of the budget for staff training.
example.zh: 我們會把預算剩下的部分用在員工訓練上。

example.en: We paid a deposit to reserve the meeting room.
example.zh: 我們付了訂金來預訂會議室。

example.en: The first payment is due when the contract is signed.
example.zh: 第一筆款項在簽約時到期。

example.en: You can pay the fee in three installments.
example.zh: 你可以分三期付這筆費用。

example.en: The invoice shows the total amount and the due date.
example.zh: 請款單上列有總金額和到期日。

derived.link: un-（不）+ balanced，不平衡的，像 unhappy、unable 的 un-
im-（不）+ balance，變成「不平衡」的名詞，像 impossible 的 im-

example.en: Please check the balance before you transfer the money.
example.zh: 轉帳之前，請先確認餘額。

example.en: The accountant balances the books at the end of each month.
example.zh: 會計人員每個月底都會結清帳目。

senses.en: the money that is still left to pay or still in an account

example.en: The balance on your account is shown on the screen.
example.zh: 你的帳戶餘額顯示在螢幕上。

senses.en: a good mix of two or more things
senses.distinguish: 和金額無關，常見 work-life balance，意思是工作與生活的平衡。

example.en: She tries to keep a good balance between work and family.
example.zh: 她努力在工作和家庭之間保持良好的平衡。

senses.en: to give the right amount of attention to two or more things
senses.distinguish: 後面常接兩件事，如 balance A and B；和結算帳目的用法不同。

example.en: The new schedule balances the needs of staff and customers.
example.zh: 新的班表兼顧了員工與顧客的需求。

extra_vocab.zh: 合約、契約（動詞 /kənˈtrækt/：簽約承包；收縮）
extra_vocab.en: a written agreement between people or companies that the law can enforce
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇是名詞，作主旨的標題字：Updated Software Contract 是「更新後的軟體合約」。後面 Under the contract 與 signed contract 都是同一個字。

example.en: We signed three contracts with new suppliers this month.
example.zh: 我們這個月與新供應商簽了三份合約。

example.en: The firm contracts with outside agencies for its printing work.
example.zh: 這家公司把印刷工作外包給外部機構。

example.en: We contracted an outside agency to handle our payroll.
example.zh: 我們委託一家外部機構處理我們的薪資作業。

example.en: They are contracting with a new vendor for office supplies.
example.zh: 他們正與一家新廠商簽約採購辦公用品。

example.en: All managers must sign a contract before work begins.
example.zh: 所有經理必須在開工前簽署合約。

example.en: We plan to renew the contract next spring.
example.zh: 我們打算明年春天續約。

example.en: Either side may terminate the contract with written notice.
example.zh: 任何一方都可以書面通知終止合約。

example.en: Under the contract, the supplier must deliver on time.
example.zh: 依據合約，供應商必須準時交貨。

examples.en: Please send the signed contract back to me today.
examples.zh: 請今天把簽好的合約寄回給我。

examples.en: The supplier offered us a one-year contract.
examples.zh: 供應商向我們提出一年期的合約。

examples.en: Her contract ends in March, so she must decide soon.
examples.zh: 她的合約三月到期，所以她得盡快決定。

examples.en: The company contracts with a local firm for cleaning.
examples.zh: 這家公司與一家當地公司簽約負責清潔。

confusable.diff: 拼法很像：contact /ˈkɑːntækt/ 是「聯絡、接觸」；contract 是「合約」，中間多一個 r。

example.en: Please contact the supplier if you have questions about the delivery.
example.zh: 如果對交貨有疑問，請聯絡供應商。

confusable.diff: agreement 是較廣的「協議」，不一定有法律效力；contract 是正式、有法律約束力的合約。

example.en: The two managers reached a verbal agreement, but nothing is signed yet.
example.zh: 兩位經理口頭上達成了協議，但還沒有簽任何文件。

example.en: We reached an agreement on the delivery date.
example.zh: 我們在交貨日期上達成了協議。

example.en: The two firms made a deal on prices.
example.zh: 兩家公司就價格達成了交易。

example.en: The terms of the contract are clear.
example.zh: 合約的條款很清楚。

example.en: We sent a proposal to the client on Monday.
example.zh: 我們週一把提案寄給了客戶。

derived.link: contract + -or，做事的人，像 actor、visitor；簽約承包工作的人或公司
contract + -ual，變成形容詞，字尾像 annual（文章裡也出現過）

example.en: The contract must be signed by both sides before March.
example.zh: 這份合約必須在三月之前由雙方簽署。

example.en: The city contracted a local firm to repair the road.
example.zh: 市政府委託一家當地公司修補道路。

extra_vocab.zh: 預算（動詞：編列預算；形容詞：低價的）
extra_vocab.en: the amount of money a person or company plans to spend
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇指公司為新軟體編列的「預算」。approved the budget 表示財務部已核准這筆預算，後面的合約付款才能進行。

example.en: Each department must submit its budgets by the end of March.
example.zh: 每個部門都必須在三月底前提交預算。

example.en: We budgeted five thousand dollars for the training program.
example.zh: 我們為這項訓練計畫編列了五千美元的預算。

example.en: Careful budgeting helps small businesses avoid cash problems.
example.zh: 謹慎的預算編列能幫助小型企業避免資金問題。

example.en: The board will approve the budget on Friday.
example.zh: 董事會將在週五核准預算。

example.en: The project went over budget by ten percent.
example.zh: 這個專案超出預算百分之十。

example.en: Please keep the event within budget.
example.zh: 請讓活動維持在預算範圍內。

example.en: The budget cut forced us to delay hiring.
example.zh: 預算刪減迫使我們延後招聘。

examples.en: The budget for next year will be discussed on Monday.
examples.zh: 明年的預算將在週一討論。

examples.en: Please send your budget request to finance by Friday.
examples.zh: 請在週五前把你的預算申請寄給財務部。

examples.en: We booked a budget hotel near the airport.
examples.zh: 我們訂了機場附近一間平價旅館。

examples.en: We need to budget carefully for travel this year.
examples.zh: 我們今年必須謹慎編列差旅預算。

confusable.diff: budget 是「預計可以花的額度」；cost 是「實際花掉的費用」。

example.en: The total cost of the repairs was higher than we expected.
example.zh: 維修的總費用比我們預期的高。

example.en: The cost of the new system is very high.
example.zh: 新系統的成本非常高。

example.en: Travel expenses must be reported every month.
example.zh: 差旅費用必須每個月申報。

example.en: We need more funds to finish the project.
example.zh: 我們需要更多資金來完成這個專案。

example.en: The sales forecast helps us plan the budget.
example.zh: 銷售預測幫助我們規劃預算。

example.en: The marketing budget for next quarter was approved yesterday.
example.zh: 下一季的行銷預算昨天已獲核准。

example.en: Each department must budget for training costs this year.
example.zh: 每個部門今年都必須為訓練費用編列預算。

example.en: The airline offers budget fares on many short routes.
example.zh: 這家航空公司在許多短程航線提供平價機票。

senses.en: the amount of money a person or company plans to spend

example.en: Our travel budget is much smaller than last year's.
example.zh: 我們的差旅預算比去年少很多。

senses.en: a written plan that shows how money will be spent
senses.distinguish: 指一份文件或計畫，常搭配 prepare、submit、attach。

example.en: Please attach a detailed budget to your project proposal.
example.zh: 請在專案提案中附上詳細的預算表。

extra_vocab.en: needing to be paid or done at a certain time
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡是形容詞，放在 are 後面當補語：all invoices are due in thirty days，意思是「請款單必須在三十天這個期限內付清」。合約與請款情境很常見，後面常接 on／by + 日期或 in + 一段時間。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: be due to + 原形動詞表示「預定要…」；due to + 名詞則是「由於…」，兩者意思不同，不要搞混。

example.en: The club uses the dues to cover its monthly costs.
example.zh: 這個社團用會費來支付每月的開銷。

example.en: Please write the due date clearly on every invoice.
example.zh: 請把到期日清楚寫在每一張請款單上。

example.en: Your account is past due, so please pay today.
example.zh: 您的帳戶已逾期，請於今天付款。

example.en: Production stopped for two hours due to a lack of parts.
example.zh: 由於缺少零件，生產停了兩個小時。

example.en: The new manager is due to join us on Monday.
example.zh: 新經理預定週一加入我們。

examples.en: Our office rent is due on the first day of every month.
examples.zh: 我們的辦公室租金每個月一號到期。

examples.en: The final report is due next Friday, so please start early.
examples.zh: 最終報告下週五要交，所以請提早開始。

examples.en: The meeting was moved to Tuesday due to heavy rain.
examples.zh: 由於大雨，會議改到了星期二。

confusable.diff: expire 是「有效期限結束」，如合約、優惠券；due 是「該付款或完成的時間點」。

example.en: The coupon will expire at the end of this month.
example.zh: 這張優惠券會在本月底失效。

confusable.diff: owe 是動詞「欠（款）」；due 是形容詞，描述款項到期了或該付了。
confusable.usage: owe 是動詞，句型是 owe + 人 + 錢（We owe the supplier $500）；due 是形容詞，要搭配 be 動詞（The payment is due）。

example.en: We owe the supplier ten thousand dollars for the parts.
example.zh: 我們欠供應商一萬美元的零件款。

example.en: Please send the invoice to the accounting team.
example.zh: 請把請款單寄給會計團隊。

example.en: We must meet the deadline for the tax report.
example.zh: 我們必須趕上稅務報告的截止日期。

example.en: We received your payment this morning, thank you.
example.zh: 我們今天早上收到了您的款項，謝謝。

example.en: The company still owes us for the last order.
example.zh: 公司還欠我們上一筆訂單的款項。

derived.link: over-（超過）+ due，超過了到期日，像 overtime、overload 的 over-

example.en: The balance is due within fourteen days of delivery.
example.zh: 餘額須在交貨後十四天內付清。

pos_uses.zh: （常用複數 dues）會費、應繳款項

example.en: Members must pay their annual dues by the end of March.
example.zh: 會員必須在三月底前繳交年費。

senses.en: needing to be paid or done at a certain time

example.en: All payments are due within fourteen days of the invoice date.
example.zh: 所有款項須在請款單日期後十四天內付清。

senses.en: expected to happen or arrive at a certain time
senses.distinguish: 常用 be due to + V 或 be due + 時間，指「預計會發生或抵達」，不是付款。

example.en: The delivery truck is due to arrive at noon.
example.zh: 送貨卡車預計中午抵達。

extra_vocab.en: ending a contract or service before the planned end date
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡指合約中的「提前終止」條款：如果部門在最初十二個月結束前取消服務，就會被加收費用。這是合約與租約中很常見的用語，語氣正式，常和 clause、fee、penalty 一起出現。
extra_vocab.pattern: early termination of + 合約／服務；early termination clause／fee／penalty
extra_vocab.grammar_note: early termination 在這裡是不可數名詞，不加 a 也不加 s；後面要接「終止的對象」時用 of（early termination of the contract），不用 for。

examples.en: Early termination of the lease will result in a penalty.
examples.zh: 提前終止租約將會產生違約金。

examples.en: Please check whether early termination carries any extra fee.
examples.zh: 請確認提前終止是否需要支付額外費用。

examples.en: The early termination clause protects the vendor from sudden losses.
examples.zh: 提前終止條款可以保護廠商免於突然的損失。

similar.diff: 意思幾乎相同；cancellation 較口語，常指訂單、預約或服務，termination 較正式，常指合約或僱用關係。

example.en: Early cancellation of the service requires thirty days' written notice.
example.zh: 提前取消這項服務必須在三十天前以書面通知。

similar.diff: terminate early 是動詞用法，主詞通常是簽約的一方；early termination 是名詞，用來指這件事或這條條款。

example.en: Either side may terminate early by giving thirty days' written notice.
example.zh: 任何一方都可以提前三十天書面通知而提前終止。

confusable.diff: expiration 是合約期限屆滿、自然結束；early termination 是還沒到期就提前結束。

example.en: The contract's expiration date is December 31, so no fee applies.
example.zh: 合約的到期日是十二月三十一日，所以不收取費用。

confusable.diff: early renewal 是提前「續約」，合約會延續下去；early termination 是提前「結束」合約，兩者方向相反。

example.en: Early renewal of the contract gives you a five percent discount.
example.zh: 提前續約可享有百分之五的折扣。

extra_vocab.text: Under the contract, the company will pay 40 percent of the total fee when the agreement is signed and the remaining balance within thirty days after installation.
extra_vocab.zh: 依照合約規定，公司將在協議簽署時支付總費用的百分之四十，其餘尾款則在安裝完成後三十天內付清。
extra_vocab.note: 正式的合約付款條款說明，語氣客觀中性，用來清楚交代「何時付多少」的時程，讓區域經理了解預算如何分期支出。
extra_vocab.structure: Under + 文件, 主詞 + will pay + 比例 + of + 總額 + when + 子句 ＋ and ＋ 餘額（省略 will pay）＋ within + 期間 + after + 事件

grammar.explain: under 在這裡表示「依據、按照（合約、規定、法律）」，不是「在…下面」。常見搭配：under the terms of、under the agreement、under company policy。

grammar.point: and 後面省略重複的動詞
grammar.explain: and the remaining balance 後面省略了 will pay（the company will pay … and (will pay) the remaining balance …），兩筆款項共用同一個動詞，讀長句時要先補回來。

grammar.point: within ＋ 期間 ＋ after ＋ 事件
grammar.explain: within thirty days 是「三十天以內」，after installation 說明從哪個時間點開始算。合起來是「安裝之後的三十天內」，不是剛好第三十天。

extra_vocab.pattern: Under + 文件, 主詞 + will pay + 比例 + when + 事件 + and + 餘額 + within + 期間 + after + 事件

paraphrase.en: According to the contract, the company must pay 40 percent of the total fee at signing and the rest within thirty days of installation.
paraphrase.zh: 根據合約，公司必須在簽約時支付總費用的百分之四十，其餘則在安裝後三十天內付清。

paraphrase.en: As stated in the agreement, 40 percent of the fee is due at signing, and the balance is due within thirty days after installation.
paraphrase.zh: 如協議所述，費用的百分之四十在簽約時到期，尾款則在安裝後三十天內到期。

examples.en: Under the agreement, we will pay half now and the rest within ten days.
examples.zh: 依照協議，我們現在先付一半，其餘在十天內付清。

examples.en: Under the plan, the client pays 30 percent upfront and the balance after delivery.
examples.zh: 依照這個方案，客戶先付百分之三十，尾款在交貨後支付。

extra_vocab.text: In particular, check the clause concerning early termination
extra_vocab.zh: 尤其請仔細檢查關於提前終止的條款。
extra_vocab.note: 緊接在「請仔細審閱合約」之後，從整份合約中點出最需要留意的一項；語氣客氣但明確，是對區域經理的重點提醒。
extra_vocab.structure: In particular, + V（祈使句）＋ the + N（條款）＋ concerning + N（主題）

grammar.explain: check the clause… 是祈使句，主詞 you 被省略，直接用原形動詞開頭，用於指示或提醒。前面的 In particular 先把注意力從「整份合約」縮小到其中一項。
concerning 當介系詞，意思是「關於」，放在名詞後面修飾它：the clause concerning early termination 就是「關於提前終止的那條條款」。比 about 正式，常見於合約與公文。

extra_vocab.pattern: In particular, + V + the + N + concerning + 主題

paraphrase.en: Please pay special attention to the clause about early termination.
paraphrase.zh: 請特別留意關於提前終止的條款。

paraphrase.en: Above all, make sure you read the section on ending the contract early.
paraphrase.zh: 最重要的是，請務必讀一下關於提前結束合約的那一段。

examples.en: In particular, review the section regarding payment terms.
examples.zh: 尤其請審閱關於付款條件的那一段。

examples.en: In particular, confirm the details concerning the delivery schedule.
examples.zh: 尤其請確認關於交貨時程的細節。

extra_vocab.en: about; related to something
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡 concerning 是介系詞，意思等於 about，用來說明 clause 的內容：「有關提前終止的條款」。比 about 正式，常見於合約、公告與公文。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: concerning 當介系詞時，後面直接接名詞，不需要再加 about 或 of；也常放在名詞後面修飾它，如 the clause concerning early termination。

forms.label: 第三人稱單數／名詞複數

example.en: This report concerns the recent changes in our shipping costs.
example.zh: 這份報告與我們近期運費的變動有關。

example.en: The delay concerned the customers more than the extra cost.
example.zh: 比起額外費用，延遲更讓顧客擔心。

example.en: Please send us all information concerning the damaged shipment.
example.zh: 請把所有有關受損貨物的資訊寄給我們。

example.en: The company has a new policy concerning business travel.
example.zh: 公司有一項有關出差的新政策。

example.en: I will call you tomorrow concerning the matter we discussed.
example.zh: 關於我們討論過的那件事，我明天會打電話給你。

example.en: Several employees voiced concerns about the new overtime rules.
example.zh: 幾位員工對新的加班規定表達了擔憂。

example.en: There is growing concern over the rising cost of raw materials.
example.zh: 大家對原料成本上升的擔憂越來越多。

examples.en: I have a few questions concerning the delivery schedule.
examples.zh: 我有幾個關於交貨時程的問題。

examples.en: Please read the section concerning payment terms before you sign.
examples.zh: 簽約前請先閱讀有關付款條款的部分。

examples.en: We will discuss the new rules concerning overtime pay at noon.
examples.zh: 我們中午會討論有關加班費的新規定。

examples.en: Employees with questions concerning the move should contact the HR office.
examples.zh: 對搬遷有疑問的員工請聯絡人事部門。

examples.en: The latest sales figures for the Asian market are concerning.
examples.zh: 亞洲市場最新的銷售數字令人擔憂。

examples.en: This change will not concern the design department at all.
examples.zh: 這項變更完全不會牽涉到設計部門。

confusable.diff: concerned 是形容詞，指「擔心的」或「有關的」；concerning 是介系詞，意思是「關於」。
confusable.usage: concerning 後面直接接名詞（concerning the clause）；concerned 常用 be concerned about，或放在名詞後面如 the people concerned。

example.en: The manager is concerned about the rising cost of materials.
example.zh: 經理對原料成本上升感到擔心。

confusable.diff: considering 也是介系詞，但意思是「考慮到」，不是「關於」。

example.en: Considering the high cost, we decided to wait until next year.
example.zh: 考慮到成本很高，我們決定等到明年。

similar.diff: 和 concerning 幾乎同義，常出現在電子郵件開頭，語氣一樣正式。

example.en: I am writing regarding the invoice you sent last week.
example.zh: 我寫信是想詢問你上週寄來的請款單。

similar.diff: 最口語、最通用，正式文件裡常用 concerning 或 regarding 取代。

example.en: We have several questions about the new contract terms.
example.zh: 我們對新的合約條款有幾個問題。

similar.diff: 比 concerning 更正式，通常放在句首，後面接名詞。

example.en: With regard to payment, please contact the finance department.
example.zh: 關於付款，請聯絡財務部門。

example.en: Regarding your request, we will reply by Friday.
example.zh: 關於你的要求，我們會在星期五前回覆。

example.en: Please attach all relevant documents to your application.
example.zh: 請把所有相關文件附在申請書上。

example.en: This matter should be handled by the legal team.
example.zh: 這件事應該由法務團隊處理。

example.en: We need to solve this payment issue before the audit.
example.zh: 我們必須在稽核前解決這個付款問題。

example.en: Please check the clause concerning early termination fees.
example.zh: 請檢查有關提前終止費用的條款。

example.en: The new rule concerns all department managers in our region.
example.zh: 這項新規定與我們區域的所有部門經理有關。

example.en: Safety is our main concern during the installation.
example.zh: 安裝期間，安全是我們最關心的事。

senses.en: to be about something or to involve it
senses.distinguish: concerning 是 concern 的 -ing 形，在文章裡當介系詞用，意思就是「關於」。

example.en: This email concerns the changes to your service contract.
example.zh: 這封電子郵件是關於你服務合約的變更。

senses.en: to make someone worry
senses.distinguish: 主詞通常是事情，受詞是人，如 The delay concerns us。

example.en: The late payment concerns the finance manager very much.
example.zh: 這筆逾期付款讓財務經理非常擔心。

senses.en: a worry, or something that is important to you
senses.distinguish: 當名詞時常和 have、raise、express 一起用。

example.en: Several customers raised concerns about the late delivery.
example.zh: 幾位客戶對延遲交貨表達了擔憂。

items.tag: 簡報／提案：新專案提案簡報

level.why: 以一般商務提案簡報為情境，句型包含 Let me begin by、One of the key benefits is、Our next step is to 等 TOEIC 常見簡報用語；字彙涵蓋 proposal、estimate、allocate、approval 等預算與專案審核相關詞彙。

items.passage:
Good morning, everyone, and thank you for making time for this meeting. I'd like to introduce our proposal for the new customer portal project.

Let me begin by explaining the problem. Currently, customers must call our support team to check an order status or request an invoice. As a result, our staff spend nearly half of each day answering routine questions, and customers often wait more than ten minutes to reach someone.

Our proposal is to launch an online portal where customers can track shipments, download invoices, and submit service requests at any time. One of the key benefits is a significant reduction in call volume. In addition, the portal will give managers real-time reports on response times.

We estimate that the project will take six months and require a budget of $120,000. Most of this amount will cover software development, and we will allocate the rest to staff training. We expect the investment to pay for itself within two years.

Our next step is to obtain approval from the finance department. If the proposal is approved this month, we can begin the design phase in November.

That concludes today's presentation. Thank you for your time and attention. I'm happy to answer any questions.
items.zh:
各位早安，感謝大家撥空參加這場會議。我想向各位介紹我們的新客戶入口網站專案提案。

首先，讓我說明目前的問題。現在客戶必須打電話給客服團隊，才能查詢訂單狀態或索取發票。因此，我們的員工每天將近一半的時間都在回答例行問題，而客戶常常要等超過十分鐘才能聯絡到人。

我們的提案是推出一個線上入口網站，讓客戶隨時都能追蹤貨件、下載發票及提交服務需求。其中一項主要效益是來電量大幅減少。此外，這個入口網站也會提供主管有關回應時間的即時報表。

我們預估這個專案需要六個月，預算為 12 萬美元。大部分金額將用於軟體開發，其餘則分配給員工訓練。我們預期這筆投資可在兩年內回本。

我們的下一步是取得財務部門的核准。若提案在本月獲得通過，我們就可以在十一月開始進行設計階段。

以上就是今天的簡報內容。感謝各位撥空與關注。我很樂意回答任何問題。

vocab.col: submit a proposal / approve a proposal
estimate the cost / estimate the time

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the presentation?
opts: To announce a new company policy
To propose a customer portal project
To report last quarter's sales results
To introduce a new support manager
why: 文章沒有宣布任何公司政策。
正解：講者開場即表示要介紹新客戶入口網站專案的提案。
文章沒有報告銷售成果。
文章沒有介紹新的客服主管。

questions.q: According to the speaker, what is a current problem?
opts: Customers cannot download invoices at all.
Staff spend much of their time answering routine questions.
Managers do not want to attend meetings.
why: 費用是提案的一部分，並非目前的問題。
客戶可以索取發票，只是必須打電話，並非完全無法取得。
正解：員工每天將近一半的時間都在回答例行問題。
文章沒有提到主管不願開會。

questions.q: What will the team do next?
opts: Get approval from the finance department
Ask customers to complete a survey
why: 正解：下一步是取得財務部門的核准。
設計階段要等提案通過後、十一月才開始。
文章沒有提到增聘客服人員。
文章沒有提到客戶問卷。

questions.q: The marketing team is hoping to secure ______ for the new advertising campaign.
why: approve 為動詞，此處需要名詞作 secure 的受詞。
approved 為過去式或形容詞，不適合當受詞。
approving 為動名詞或現在分詞，語意與結構不合。
正解：approval 為名詞，secure approval 表示「取得核准」。

questions.q: We ______ that the new system will reduce the number of customer calls by 30 percent.
why: expecting 缺少助動詞，不能單獨作述語動詞。
正解：主詞 We 後接現在式動詞 expect，再接 that 子句。
to expect 為不定詞，不能直接作述語動詞。
expectation 為名詞，無法接 that 子句作動詞。

questions.q: The project will begin in November ______ the proposal is approved this month.
why: although 表示讓步，語意不符。
unless 表示「除非」，與句意相反。
正解：if 引導條件子句，表示「若提案本月通過」。
despite 後面須接名詞或動名詞，不能接完整子句。

presentation_phrases.phrase: I'd like to introduce...
presentation_phrases.usage: 正式簡報／產品發表的開場句

presentation_phrases.phrase: Let me begin by explaining...
presentation_phrases.usage: 開始介紹產品概念或背景

presentation_phrases.phrase: One of the key features is...
presentation_phrases.usage: 介紹產品功能與設計特色

presentation_phrases.phrase: In addition,...
presentation_phrases.usage: 補充另一項產品特色或資訊

presentation_phrases.phrase: As a result,...
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明設計帶來的結果或使用者效益

presentation_phrases.phrase: Our next step is to...
presentation_phrases.usage: 介紹產品開發、測試或上市計畫

presentation_phrases.phrase: That concludes today's presentation.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 以上就是今天的發表內容。
presentation_phrases.usage: 正式簡報結尾

presentation_phrases.phrase: Thank you for your time and attention.
presentation_phrases.usage: 正式產品發表或商務簡報收尾

extra_vocab.en: to give a part of money, time, or resources to a certain person or use
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇簡報裡，allocate the rest to staff training 是說預算大部分用在軟體開發，剩下的撥給員工訓練。常用句型是 allocate A to B（把 A 分配給 B），也可以用 allocate A for B（把 A 撥作 B 用途）。

example.en: The finance team allocates a fixed amount to each department monthly.
example.zh: 財務團隊每月撥給各部門固定的金額。

example.en: We allocated three engineers to the portal project last week.
example.zh: 我們上週指派了三位工程師到入口網站專案。

example.en: Allocating enough time for testing will prevent delays later.
example.zh: 為測試預留足夠的時間，能避免日後延誤。

example.en: The allocation of seats for the workshop will be announced Monday.
example.zh: 工作坊的座位分配將在週一公布。

example.en: Department heads must submit their budget allocations before the end of October.
example.zh: 各部門主管必須在十月底前提交他們的預算分配。

example.en: The board agreed to allocate funds for a new training center.
example.zh: 董事會同意撥款興建新的訓練中心。

example.en: We need to allocate resources more carefully this quarter.
example.zh: 這一季我們需要更謹慎地分配資源。

example.en: Please allocate time each week to update the project report.
example.zh: 請每週安排時間更新專案報告。

example.en: Part of the budget was allocated to marketing.
example.zh: 一部分預算被分配給行銷部門。

examples.en: The finance department will allocate money to each team.
examples.zh: 財務部門會把經費分配給各個團隊。

examples.en: How should we allocate the remaining budget this year?
examples.zh: 我們今年該如何分配剩下的預算？

examples.en: Each new employee is allocated a desk and a laptop.
examples.zh: 每位新進員工都會分配到一張桌子和一台筆記型電腦。

examples.en: The company allocated extra space in the warehouse for the new stock.
examples.zh: 公司在倉庫多撥出一塊空間放新進的貨。

confusable.diff: assign 多指指派人去做某項工作或任務；allocate 多指分配金錢、時間、空間等資源。

example.en: The manager will assign two engineers to the new project.
example.zh: 經理會指派兩位工程師負責這個新專案。

confusable.diff: distribute 是把東西分發給很多人或地點，例如傳單、產品；allocate 是依計畫決定各部分的用途或份額。

example.en: Staff will distribute the brochures to visitors at the entrance.
example.zh: 工作人員會在入口處把宣傳手冊發給訪客。

example.en: The allocation of funds will be decided on Friday.
example.zh: 經費的分配將在星期五決定。

example.en: Our budget for advertising is quite limited this year.
example.zh: 我們今年的廣告預算相當有限。

example.en: Staff time is our most valuable resource.
example.zh: 員工的時間是我們最寶貴的資源。

example.en: The manager assigned two engineers to the new project.
example.zh: 經理指派兩位工程師負責這個新專案。

derived.link: allocate + -ion，把「分配」這個動作變成名詞，像 educate → education、locate → location
re-（再次）+ allocate，重新分配，像 rewrite、return

extra_vocab.en: to get something, often by asking for it or by working for it
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇簡報裡，obtain approval from the finance department 是說要先取得財務部門的核准，才能往下進行。obtain 比 get 正式，常用在 approval、permission、information 這類書面或商務的情境。

example.en: She obtains approval from her supervisor before every purchase.
example.zh: 她每次採購前都會先取得主管的核准。

example.en: The team obtained the permit after waiting for three weeks.
example.zh: 團隊等了三週後取得了許可證。

example.en: Obtaining a work visa usually takes about a month.
example.zh: 取得工作簽證通常要花大約一個月。

example.en: These certificates are obtainable only through the HR office.
example.zh: 這些證明書只能透過人資室取得。

example.en: You must obtain approval from your manager before booking the trip.
example.zh: 訂行程之前，你必須先取得主管的核准。

example.en: Visitors need to obtain permission before taking photos in the lab.
example.zh: 訪客在實驗室拍照前需要先取得許可。

example.en: You can obtain more information from our Web site.
example.zh: 你可以從我們的網站取得更多資訊。

example.en: The company hopes to obtain a license to sell its products overseas.
example.zh: 公司希望取得執照，把產品賣到海外。

examples.en: We still need to obtain the final figures from the sales team.
examples.zh: 我們還需要從業務團隊拿到最終的數字。

examples.en: I am writing to ask how I can obtain a copy of the contract.
examples.zh: 我寫信是想請問如何取得合約的副本。

examples.en: It was hard to obtain enough materials during the shortage.
examples.zh: 在短缺期間，很難取得足夠的材料。

examples.en: Travelers should obtain a visa before they leave for the conference.
examples.zh: 旅客在出發參加會議前應先取得簽證。

confusable.diff: get 是最口語、最常用的字；obtain 比較正式，多用在公文、電子郵件和簡報裡，常需要透過申請或努力才拿到。

example.en: Please get some coffee before the meeting starts at nine.
example.zh: 請在九點開會前先去拿些咖啡。

confusable.diff: acquire 多指長時間累積取得，例如技能、經驗，或公司收購別家公司；obtain 多指一次性取得核准、資料、許可等。

example.en: The firm plans to acquire a smaller rival next year.
example.zh: 這家公司計畫明年收購一家規模較小的對手。

example.en: The parts are easily obtainable from local suppliers.
example.zh: 這些零件很容易從當地供應商那裡取得。

example.en: The plan is waiting for approval from the director.
example.zh: 這項計畫正在等待主任的核准。

example.en: Employees need permission to work from home.
example.zh: 員工需要獲得許可才能在家工作。

example.en: The firm plans to acquire a smaller competitor next year.
example.zh: 這家公司計畫明年收購一家規模較小的競爭對手。

derived.link: obtain + -able，可以被…的，像 readable、available
un-（不）+ obtainable，像 unhappy、unable

extra_vocab.zh: 訂單狀態、訂單處理進度
extra_vocab.en: information about where an order is, such as processing or shipped
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡是客戶打電話給客服最常問的事：想知道訂單目前處理到哪一步（處理中、已出貨等）。order 在這裡當形容詞，修飾 status。
extra_vocab.pattern: check / track / update + order status

examples.en: You can check your order status on our Web site.
examples.zh: 您可以在我們的網站上查詢訂單狀態。

examples.en: We will e-mail you whenever your order status changes.
examples.zh: 每當您的訂單狀態有變動，我們都會寄電子郵件通知您。

examples.en: I'm calling to ask about the status of my order.
examples.zh: 我打電話來詢問我訂單的狀態。

examples.en: The system shows the order status in real time.
examples.zh: 系統會即時顯示訂單狀態。

similar.diff: order tracking 偏重「追蹤貨物位置」；order status 範圍較廣，包含處理中、已付款、已出貨等階段。

example.en: Order tracking shows exactly where your package is right now.
example.zh: 訂單追蹤能讓您確切知道包裹現在在哪裡。

similar.diff: shipping status 只指出貨與運送階段；order status 涵蓋從下單到送達的整個過程。

example.en: The shipping status will change to delivered tomorrow morning.
example.zh: 出貨狀態明天早上會變成已送達。

confusable.diff: order number 是訂單編號，用來查詢；order status 是查到的「狀態」結果。

example.en: Your order number is printed at the top of the confirmation e-mail.
example.zh: 您的訂單編號印在確認郵件的最上方。

extra_vocab.zh: 線上入口平台、線上服務平台
extra_vocab.en: a website where users log in to use services over the Internet
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡是整份提案要推出的產品，客戶可全天候在上面追蹤出貨、下載發票、提出服務需求。online 強調「在網路上自助辦理」，可減少打電話給客服。
extra_vocab.pattern: launch / use / log in to an online portal

examples.en: We plan to launch an online portal early next year.
examples.zh: 我們計畫在明年初推出線上入口平台。

examples.en: Customers can pay their bills through the online portal.
examples.zh: 客戶可以透過線上入口平台繳付帳單。

examples.en: Please register on the online portal to receive your documents.
examples.zh: 請在線上入口平台註冊以接收您的文件。

examples.en: Applicants must submit their forms through the online portal.
examples.zh: 應徵者必須透過線上入口平台提交表格。

similar.diff: customer portal 指服務對象是客戶；online portal 只強調在網路上，使用者可以是客戶、員工或學生。

example.en: Clients can download invoices from the customer portal anytime.
example.zh: 客戶隨時都能從客戶入口平台下載請款單。

similar.diff: mobile app 是安裝在手機上的應用程式；online portal 通常在網頁瀏覽器中使用。

example.en: Our mobile app lets users check their orders from a phone.
example.zh: 我們的手機應用程式讓使用者能用手機查看訂單。

confusable.diff: online store 是網路商店，目的是販售商品；online portal 是辦理服務與查詢資料的入口。

example.en: Our online store sells office chairs and desks at low prices.
example.zh: 我們的網路商店以低價販售辦公椅和辦公桌。

extra_vocab.en: the number of phone calls a company receives in a period of time
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 reduction in call volume 指入口平台上線後，客戶不必再打電話查詢，客服接到的電話會變少。這是客服中心與營運報告的常用詞。
extra_vocab.pattern: high / low call volume；reduce / increase call volume

examples.en: The new system should reduce our call volume by thirty percent.
examples.zh: 新系統應該能讓我們的來電量減少百分之三十。

examples.en: Call volume is usually highest on Monday mornings.
examples.zh: 來電量通常在週一早上最高。

examples.en: High call volume may cause longer waiting times today.
examples.zh: 今天來電量大，可能造成等候時間較長。

examples.en: We hired more staff because of the rise in call volume.
examples.zh: 由於來電量增加，我們多聘了一些員工。

similar.diff: number of calls 是日常說法；call volume 較專業，常用於報告與客服中心管理。

example.en: The number of calls doubled after the product launch.
example.zh: 產品上市後，來電的數量成長了一倍。

similar.diff: workload 是整體工作量，不限於電話；call volume 只指電話數量。

example.en: The staff's workload increased after the new product launch.
example.zh: 新產品上市後，員工的工作量增加了。

confusable.diff: volume 也有「音量」的意思，但在 call volume 裡是「數量」，指來電的多寡，不是聲音大小。

example.en: Please lower the volume of the speaker during the meeting.
example.zh: 開會期間請把喇叭的音量調小。

extra_vocab.en: happening or shown at the same time as the event itself
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 real-time reports 指管理者能隨時看到最新的回應時間資料，不必等每週或每月彙整後才拿到報告。放在名詞前面當形容詞時要加連字號。

example.en: Support staff prefer real time over daily summaries when handling urgent complaints.
example.zh: 處理緊急客訴時，客服人員偏好即時資訊而非每日摘要。

example.en: Managers can follow customer calls in real time from the control room.
example.zh: 主管可以在控制室即時追蹤客戶來電。

example.en: The team uses real-time data to plan daily deliveries.
example.zh: 團隊使用即時資料來規劃每日的配送。

example.en: You will receive real-time updates about your shipment.
example.zh: 您會收到關於貨物的即時更新。

example.en: Real-time tracking lets customers see where their order is.
example.zh: 即時追蹤讓客戶能看到訂單目前的位置。

example.en: Sales figures are shown on the screen in real time.
example.zh: 銷售數字會即時顯示在螢幕上。

examples.en: The dashboard gives us real-time information on customer requests.
examples.zh: 這個儀表板提供我們客戶需求的即時資訊。

examples.en: Managers can make faster decisions with real-time reports.
examples.zh: 管理者有了即時報告，就能更快做決定。

examples.en: Our app offers real-time chat with a support agent.
examples.zh: 我們的應用程式提供與客服人員的即時對話。

confusable.diff: on time 是「準時」，指不遲到；real-time 是「即時」，指資料與事件同步發生，兩者意思不同。

example.en: Please make sure the documents arrive on time for the meeting.
example.zh: 請確保文件準時送達會議現場。

confusable.diff: live 常指現場直播或正在進行的節目；real-time 強調資料或資訊同步更新，不一定有影像。

example.en: The CEO will give a live speech at the opening ceremony.
example.zh: 執行長將在開幕典禮上發表現場演說。

example.en: Customers expect an instant reply to their messages.
example.zh: 客戶期待訊息能立即獲得回覆。

example.en: The report is updated instantly after each sale.
example.zh: 每筆銷售後，報告會立刻更新。

example.en: Please update the sales figures before the meeting.
example.zh: 請在會議前更新銷售數字。

example.en: The company will hold a live online presentation.
example.zh: 公司將舉辦一場線上直播簡報。

extra_vocab.en: to follow the progress or position of something over time
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡是動詞，track shipments 指客戶可在入口網站上「追蹤貨物」的運送狀態。商務情境中也常用來指追蹤進度、銷售數字或費用。

example.en: The app tracks every shipment from the warehouse to the customer.
example.zh: 這個應用程式追蹤每一批貨從倉庫到客戶手中的過程。

example.en: We tracked the missing parcel to a regional sorting center.
example.zh: 我們追蹤到遺失的包裹在一處區域分揀中心。

example.en: Tracking each project's hours helps us bill clients correctly.
example.zh: 記錄每個專案的工時，有助於我們正確向客戶請款。

example.en: You can track your package with the number in this email.
example.zh: 你可以用這封郵件中的編號追蹤包裹。

example.en: We will send you a tracking number once the order ships.
example.zh: 訂單出貨後，我們會寄給您追蹤編號。

example.en: This software helps small companies track expenses more easily.
example.zh: 這套軟體幫助小公司更輕鬆地追蹤支出。

example.en: It is hard to keep track of every order by hand.
example.zh: 要用手工記錄每一筆訂單很困難。

examples.en: Customers can track the status of their repair online.
examples.zh: 顧客可以在線上追蹤維修的進度。

examples.en: We use a simple chart to track sales each week.
examples.zh: 我們用一張簡單的圖表追蹤每週的銷售。

examples.en: The company is on track to meet its goal this year.
examples.zh: 公司今年有望達成目標。

confusable.diff: trace 是「查出來源或下落」，常用於找出遺失物或問題原因；track 是持續追蹤目前的進度或位置。

example.en: We could not trace the missing package to any warehouse.
example.zh: 我們無法查出這個遺失的包裹在哪一座倉庫。

confusable.diff: monitor 是持續「監看、監控」狀況；track 更強調記錄變化或位置。

example.en: Managers monitor the call center from a large screen all day.
example.zh: 主管整天透過一個大螢幕監看客服中心的狀況。

example.en: The tracking system shows where each package is now.
example.zh: 追蹤系統會顯示每個包裹目前的位置。

example.en: Managers monitor the project every week.
example.zh: 主管每週監控專案的狀況。

example.en: Please report your progress to the team on Friday.
example.zh: 請在週五向團隊報告你的進度。

derived.link: track + -er，做事的東西或人，像 printer、computer、worker
track + -ing，把「追蹤」這件事變成名詞，像 meeting、building

example.en: The software helps managers track project costs every week.
example.zh: 這套軟體幫助主管每週追蹤專案成本。

example.en: The train was delayed because of repairs on the track.
example.zh: 火車因為軌道維修而誤點。

senses.en: to follow where something is or how it is changing

example.en: Customers can track their parcels from the warehouse to the door.
example.zh: 客戶可以追蹤包裹從倉庫到家門口的過程。

senses.en: to keep records of numbers over time
senses.distinguish: 對象是銷售額、支出、工時等數字，重點是持續記錄而不是找位置。

example.en: We track our sales figures every month to find trends.
example.zh: 我們每個月記錄銷售數字，以找出趨勢。

senses.en: the direction or path that something is following
senses.distinguish: 常見 on track（照進度）、off track（偏離進度），不是指實際的鐵軌。

example.en: The project is on track to finish before the deadline.
example.zh: 這個專案有望在截止日前完成。

extra_vocab.en: the act of making something smaller in size, amount, or price
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡是名詞，a significant reduction in call volume 指「來電量大幅減少」，是提案簡報中說明專案效益的常見說法。後面常接 in 表示減少的對象。

example.en: Several cost reductions helped the company reach its yearly target.
example.zh: 幾項成本降低措施幫助公司達成年度目標。

example.en: We plan to reduce delivery times by using a second warehouse.
example.zh: 我們計畫利用第二座倉庫來縮短交貨時間。

example.en: Online ordering reduces the number of calls our staff receive.
example.zh: 線上訂購減少了我們員工接到的來電數量。

example.en: The new software reduced our processing time by half.
example.zh: 新軟體把我們的處理時間縮短了一半。

example.en: Reducing waste is a priority for the whole production team.
example.zh: 減少浪費是整個生產團隊的優先要務。

example.en: We saw a reduction in costs after changing suppliers.
example.zh: 更換供應商後，我們看到成本下降。

example.en: Cost reduction is the main goal of this project.
example.zh: 降低成本是這個專案的主要目標。

example.en: The store announced a price reduction on all winter coats.
example.zh: 這家店宣布所有冬季外套降價。

example.en: The new process led to a significant reduction in errors.
example.zh: 新流程使錯誤大幅減少。

examples.en: A ten percent reduction in staff hours would save money.
examples.zh: 員工工時減少百分之十就能省下經費。

examples.en: The supplier offered a reduction for orders over 1,000 units.
examples.zh: 供應商對超過一千件的訂單提供折扣。

examples.en: Our factory plans a reduction in energy use next year.
examples.zh: 我們的工廠計劃明年減少能源使用。

confusable.diff: decrease 作名詞指數量「下降」這個現象；reduction 常強調是刻意或透過行動造成的減少。

example.en: A decrease in orders last month surprised the sales team.
example.zh: 上個月訂單減少，讓業務團隊很意外。

confusable.diff: discount 專指價格折扣；reduction 範圍較廣，可指價格、數量、成本、時間等的減少。

example.en: Customers receive a discount when they buy in large amounts.
example.zh: 客戶大量購買時可以享有折扣。

example.en: We want to reduce the time customers wait on the phone.
example.zh: 我們想縮短顧客在電話上等待的時間。

example.en: The shop is open at reduced hours this week.
example.zh: 這家店本週縮短營業時間。

example.en: Sales decreased slightly in the second quarter.
example.zh: 第二季的銷售額略微下降。

derived.link: 最基礎的詞幹；reduce 把字尾 e 換成 -tion 變成名詞「減少」，像 produce → production、introduce → introduction

senses.en: the act of making something smaller in size or amount

example.en: The reduction in call volume saved the team many hours.
example.zh: 來電量的減少替團隊省下了許多時間。

senses.en: a lower price than the usual price
senses.distinguish: 出現在訂單、價格或付款情境，且常和 get、offer 一起用時，指折扣。

example.en: Customers get a ten percent reduction when they pay in advance.
example.zh: 客戶提前付款可享九折優惠。

extra_vocab.en: official permission to do something or to go ahead with a plan
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡指財務部門對提案的「正式核可」。obtain approval 是簡報中常見的說法，語氣正式，表示下一步要先拿到上級或部門的同意。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: approval 通常是不可數名詞，不加 s，也不加 a；常見用法是 approval from + 人／部門，或 approval of/for + 計畫。

example.en: Several approvals are needed before the new system goes live.
example.zh: 新系統上線前，需要經過幾道核准。

example.en: The team obtained approval to hire two new engineers.
example.zh: 團隊取得了僱用兩名新工程師的核准。

example.en: Before ordering, you should seek approval from your supervisor.
example.zh: 下訂單之前，你應該先向主管尋求核准。

example.en: The budget is still pending approval from the finance team.
example.zh: 這筆預算仍在等待財務團隊核准。

example.en: We cannot change the schedule without written approval from the client.
example.zh: 沒有客戶的書面核准，我們不能更改時程。

example.en: The director will give final approval on Friday.
example.zh: 主任會在星期五給予最終核准。

examples.en: We need approval from the board before we sign the contract.
examples.zh: 簽約之前，我們需要董事會的核准。

examples.en: Please send us your approval by email as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 請盡快用電子郵件寄給我們你的核准。

examples.en: Purchases over $5,000 require approval from the department manager.
examples.zh: 超過五千美元的採購需要部門經理核准。

confusable.diff: approve 是動詞「批准」，approval 是它的名詞形式。
confusable.usage: approve 後面直接接受詞（approve a plan）；approve of 則是「贊成、認同」，語意不同。

example.en: The manager will approve the travel request tomorrow morning.
example.zh: 經理明天早上會批准這份出差申請。

confusable.diff: proof 是「證明、證據」，拼法有點像但意思完全不同。

example.en: We need proof of payment before we ship the order.
example.zh: 出貨之前，我們需要付款證明。

similar.diff: permission 是一般的「允許」，較口語；approval 多用於計畫、預算等需要正式核可的事。

example.en: You need permission to enter the storage room.
example.zh: 進入儲藏室需要許可。

similar.diff: authorization 更正式，強調「授權」某人做某事，常見於付款、系統或簽核流程。

example.en: The payment needs authorization from the finance manager.
example.zh: 這筆付款需要財務經理授權。

example.en: Both companies signed the agreement last week.
example.zh: 兩家公司上週簽了協議。

example.en: The form needs your signature before we can process it.
example.zh: 這份表格需要你的簽名我們才能處理。

derived.link: 詞幹 approve（批准），加 -al 變成名詞 approval，像 arrive → arrival
approve + -d，「被批准的」，如 approved supplier（核准供應商）
dis-（不）+ approve，像 dislike、disagree
dis-（不）+ approval，approval 的相反

extra_vocab.en: to guess how much, how long, or how many, using the facts you have
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡是動詞，後面接 that 子句，用來說明專案「預估」要花六個月和 12 萬美元。語氣客觀、有根據，很適合用在提案和報告裡。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: estimate 可以接 that 子句（We estimate that…），也常用被動 be estimated to + V（The project is estimated to take six months）。

example.en: The finance team estimates that costs will rise by five percent.
example.zh: 財務團隊估計成本會上漲百分之五。

example.en: The repair cost was estimated at about two thousand dollars.
example.zh: 維修費用被估計大約是兩千美元。

example.en: Estimating the delivery time correctly helps us avoid customer complaints.
example.zh: 正確估計送貨時間，有助於我們避免客訴。

example.en: We received three estimates from different contractors for the repair work.
example.zh: 我們收到三家承包商針對維修工程提供的估價。

example.en: Can you estimate the cost of shipping these samples overseas?
example.zh: 你能估計一下把這些樣品寄到海外的成本嗎？

example.en: The project is estimated to cost $50,000 in total.
example.zh: 這個專案據估計總共要花五萬美元。

example.en: Could you give me a rough estimate by noon?
example.zh: 你能在中午前給我一個粗略的估計嗎？

example.en: Please send a cost estimate for the office renovation.
example.zh: 請寄一份辦公室整修的成本估價單。

examples.en: We estimate that sales will grow by ten percent next year.
examples.zh: 我們預估明年銷售額會成長百分之十。

examples.en: The vendor estimates that delivery will take about two weeks.
examples.zh: 供應商預估交貨大約要兩週。

examples.en: Analysts estimate that the market will double within five years.
examples.zh: 分析師估計市場會在五年內成長一倍。

examples.en: It is estimated that the new office will open in May.
examples.zh: 據估計，新辦公室會在五月開幕。

confusable.diff: estimate 是用資料推算大概的數字；evaluate 是評斷好壞或表現。

example.en: We will evaluate each supplier before we sign any contract.
example.zh: 簽任何合約之前，我們會先評估每家供應商。

similar.diff: forecast 強調預測未來的趨勢，常用於銷售、天氣；estimate 多用於推算成本、時間、數量。

example.en: Analysts forecast that sales will rise in the fourth quarter.
example.zh: 分析師預測第四季銷售會上升。

similar.diff: calculate 是精確算出結果；estimate 只是大約推算，不一定精確。

example.en: Please calculate the exact total before you send the invoice.
example.zh: 寄發票之前，請先算出精確的總額。

example.en: We asked three suppliers for a quote on the new printers.
example.zh: 我們向三家供應商詢問新印表機的報價。

example.en: The marketing budget for this year is already approved.
example.zh: 今年的行銷預算已經核准了。

example.en: The sales figures for March are better than expected.
example.zh: 三月的銷售數字比預期好。

derived.link: estimate + -ion，把「估計」變成名詞，像 decide → decision
under-（低於）+ estimate，估得比實際低
over-（超過）+ estimate，估得比實際高

example.en: We estimate that the repairs will take three days.
example.zh: 我們估計維修需要三天。

example.en: The contractor gave us an estimate of $8,000.
example.zh: 承包商給了我們八千美元的估價。

senses.en: to guess an amount, cost, or time using the facts you have

example.en: Managers estimate that the move will take two weekends.
example.zh: 經理們估計搬遷需要兩個週末。

senses.en: to judge how much something is worth
senses.distinguish: 後面直接接物品和價值（estimate the value of…），而不是接 that 子句。

example.en: An agent will estimate the value of our old warehouse.
example.zh: 仲介會評估我們舊倉庫的價值。

extra_vocab.en: a plan or idea that you officially suggest to other people
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡是這場簡報的主題：公司內部要請上級或財務部門核准的「提案」。常和 submit、approve、accept 一起用，語氣正式。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: proposal 後面可接 for + 名詞／V-ing，或接 to + V（a proposal to cut costs）。

example.en: The committee reviewed three proposals for the new marketing campaign.
example.zh: 委員會審閱了三份新行銷活動的提案。

example.en: Please submit your proposal to the sales director by Friday.
example.zh: 請在星期五前把你的提案交給業務主任。

example.en: The client accepted our proposal without any major changes.
example.zh: 客戶接受了我們的提案，沒有大幅修改。

example.en: The committee rejected the proposal because it cost too much.
example.zh: 委員會因為成本太高而否決了這份提案。

example.en: We wrote a proposal for a new employee training program.
example.zh: 我們寫了一份新的員工訓練計畫提案。

examples.en: Our proposal includes a clear plan and a realistic budget.
examples.zh: 我們的提案包含明確的計畫和實際的預算。

examples.en: Thank you for reviewing our proposal; we look forward to your reply.
examples.zh: 謝謝您審閱我們的提案，期待您的回覆。

examples.en: The supplier sent a proposal for the new delivery contract.
examples.zh: 供應商寄來了新交貨合約的提案。

confusable.diff: purpose 是「目的」；proposal 是「提案」，拼法和發音有點像，意思不同。

example.en: The purpose of this meeting is to review the budget.
example.zh: 這場會議的目的是檢視預算。

similar.diff: suggestion 是較隨意的建議；proposal 通常是有計畫、需要正式討論或核准的提案。

example.en: Do you have a suggestion for reducing our shipping costs?
example.zh: 你有降低運費的建議嗎？

similar.diff: plan 是「計畫」本身；proposal 是把計畫提出來請別人同意。

example.en: We need a clear plan before we start the project.
example.zh: 開始專案之前，我們需要一個明確的計畫。

example.en: The proposal includes a budget of $120,000.
example.zh: 這份提案包含十二萬美元的預算。

example.en: Both sides must sign the contract before the project starts.
example.zh: 專案開始前，雙方都必須簽合約。

derived.link: 詞幹 propose（提出），去 e 加 -al 變名詞 proposal，像 approve → approval
propose + -d，「被提出的」，如 the proposed budget（提議的預算）

items.tag: 簡報開場：嬰兒推車與汽座設計介紹

level.why: 口語開場白，句子短而清楚，主要使用 walk you through、focus on、looking forward to 等常見簡報用語；字彙以設計與產品相關的基礎商務詞為主。

items.passage:
Thank you, Miranda.

Good morning, everyone. It's a pleasure to meet you all in person.

I'm Boyd, an industrial designer.

Today, I'll walk you through the design thinking behind three strollers and one car seat. I'll highlight the key features, demonstrate how they work, and explain the thinking behind each design.

Some of you may have already seen the samples, so I'll focus on the design concepts, key functions, and the ideas behind them.

I'm looking forward to sharing our ideas with you and hearing your thoughts and feedback.

With that, let's get started with our first stroller.
items.zh:
謝謝你，Miranda。

各位早安，很榮幸能與大家當面見面。

我是 Boyd，是一位工業設計師。

今天我會帶各位了解三款嬰兒推車和一款汽車安全座椅背後的設計思維。我會強調主要特色、示範它們如何運作，並說明每一款設計背後的想法。

各位當中有些人可能已經看過樣品，所以我會著重在設計概念、主要功能，以及這些設計背後的想法。

我很期待與各位分享我們的想法，也期待聽到大家的意見與回饋。

那麼，我們就從第一款推車開始吧。

vocab.col: walk you through the process / walk you through the steps
vocab.zh: 逐步向你說明、帶你了解

vocab.col: highlight the benefits / highlight key points
demonstrate a product / demonstrate how it works
look forward to meeting / look forward to hearing

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the speaker's talk?
opts: To announce a recall of several strollers
To introduce the design ideas behind several baby products
To ask the audience to buy the samples
To report last quarter's sales results
why: 文中沒有提到任何產品召回。
正解：講者說要帶大家了解三款推車與一款汽座背後的設計思維，並說明各項設計的想法。
講者只提到有些人看過樣品，並沒有要求聽眾購買。
文中沒有報告任何銷售成果。

questions.q: What does the speaker say he will focus on?
opts: The design concepts and key functions
why: 講者沒有提到價格或銷售計畫。
講者沒有談到製造時程。
講者沒有提到運費。
正解：因為有些人已看過樣品，講者表示會著重在設計概念、主要功能與背後的想法。

questions.q: Before the launch, the designer will ______ how the new folding system works.
why: 正解：助動詞 will 後面要接原形動詞，demonstrate 表示「示範」。
demonstration 是名詞，不能直接接在 will 後面當動詞。
demonstrative 是形容詞，無法接 how 子句當受詞。
demonstrating 是動名詞／現在分詞，不能接在 will 後面。

questions.q: We are looking forward to ______ your feedback on the new design.
why: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面不能接原形動詞 receive。
received 是過去式／過去分詞，文法與語意都不符。
正解：look forward to 後面要接動名詞，所以用 receiving。
to 已經在 looking forward to 裡，再加 to receive 會重複且文法錯誤。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Thank you for the introduction, ...
presentation_phrases.usage: 被主持人介紹後，開口前的第一句致謝

presentation_phrases.phrase: It's a pleasure to meet you all.
presentation_phrases.usage: 與客戶或合作夥伴初次見面的開場問候

presentation_phrases.phrase: I'll walk you through ...
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明簡報架構或產品設計流程

presentation_phrases.phrase: I'll highlight the key features.
presentation_phrases.usage: 預告簡報重點

presentation_phrases.phrase: I'll focus on ...
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明本次簡報的聚焦範圍

presentation_phrases.phrase: Some of you may have already seen ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 各位當中有些人可能已經看過……
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明哪些內容會簡略帶過

presentation_phrases.phrase: I'm looking forward to hearing your feedback.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我期待聽到各位的意見。
presentation_phrases.usage: 邀請聽眾回饋

presentation_phrases.phrase: With that, let's get started.
presentation_phrases.usage: 結束開場、進入正題的轉場句

extra_vocab.zh: 帶你一步一步了解、向你逐項說明
extra_vocab.en: to explain something to someone step by step
extra_vocab.note: Boyd 用這個片語預告接下來會按順序介紹三款嬰兒推車和一款汽座的設計想法，語氣親切、不生硬，是簡報開場很常見的說法。
extra_vocab.pattern: walk + 人 + through + 內容
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 人要放在 walk 和 through 中間（walk you through），不能寫成 walk through you；要說明的內容放在 through 後面，可以接名詞或 how 子句。

examples.en: Let me walk you through the schedule for next week.
examples.zh: 讓我向你說明下週的行程。

examples.en: She will walk us through the new sales plan.
examples.zh: 她會帶我們逐項了解新的銷售計畫。

examples.en: Our manager walked me through the software on my first day.
examples.zh: 我上班第一天，主管帶我逐步熟悉這套軟體。

examples.en: I can walk you through the steps if you have questions.
examples.zh: 如果你有問題，我可以一步一步向你說明。

similar.diff: 意思幾乎相同，語氣也一樣自然，可以直接替換。

example.en: I will take you through the main points of the report.
example.zh: 我會帶你了解這份報告的重點。

similar.diff: 強調「引導」，常用在操作步驟或流程，語氣稍微正式一點。

example.en: This video will guide you through the setup process.
example.zh: 這支影片會引導你完成設定流程。

similar.diff: 偏向把內容快速複習或檢查一遍，沒有「一步步帶領」的感覺。

example.en: Let's go over the budget before the meeting ends.
example.zh: 會議結束前，我們再把預算檢視一遍。

confusable.diff: go through 是自己逐一檢查或經歷某事，沒有「帶別人了解」的意思；walk you through 是你帶著對方一起看。

example.en: We need to go through all the documents before Friday.
example.zh: 我們必須在星期五前把所有文件逐一檢查完。

extra_vocab.en: to make people notice something important
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡是動詞，Boyd 說會「強調」每款產品的主要特色。簡報裡常用來預告接下來要特別說明的重點。

example.en: She highlights the key results at every team meeting.
example.zh: 她在每次團隊會議都會強調關鍵成果。

example.en: The manager highlighted the risks in the new plan.
example.zh: 經理強調了新計畫中的風險。

example.en: He is highlighting the important dates in the schedule.
example.zh: 他正在標出行程表上的重要日期。

example.en: Our director will highlight the importance of safety training.
example.zh: 我們的主任會強調安全訓練的重要性。

example.en: Please highlight key points in your presentation slides.
example.zh: 請在你的簡報投影片中強調重點。

example.en: The survey helped highlight a problem with our service.
example.zh: 這份調查幫忙突顯了我們服務上的問題。

examples.en: The report highlights the main reasons for the sales drop.
examples.zh: 這份報告強調了銷售下滑的主要原因。

examples.en: I'd like to highlight three points before we vote.
examples.zh: 投票之前，我想先強調三個重點。

examples.en: Please highlight any changes in the revised contract.
examples.zh: 請標出修訂版合約中的所有變更。

similar.diff: 意思相近，語氣稍正式；emphasize 偏向用言語強調看法，highlight 偏向讓重點被看見。

example.en: The CEO emphasized that quality comes before speed.
example.zh: 執行長強調品質比速度重要。

similar.diff: 指出某件事讓大家注意，語氣比 highlight 口語、較不強調「重要」。

example.en: She pointed out a mistake in the budget.
example.zh: 她指出預算中有一個錯誤。

example.en: We should emphasize the benefits to our customers.
example.zh: 我們應該強調對客戶的好處。

example.en: The manager stressed the need to finish on time.
example.zh: 經理強調必須準時完成。

example.en: He mentioned the new price during the call.
example.zh: 他在電話中提到了新價格。

derived.link: highlight + -er，做事的工具或人，像 printer、teacher；螢光筆就是用來標出重點的筆

example.en: He highlighted the best features of the new product.
example.zh: 他強調了這項新產品最棒的特色。

example.en: The highlight of the trip was the factory tour.
example.zh: 這趟行程的亮點是參觀工廠。

senses.en: to make people notice something important

example.en: The chart highlights how sales grew this year.
example.zh: 這張圖表突顯了今年銷售如何成長。

senses.en: to mark words with a bright color so they are easy to see
senses.distinguish: 句中出現文件、文字、顏色時，通常是這個「標記」的意思。

example.en: Highlight the deadlines in yellow so no one misses them.
example.zh: 把截止日期用黃色標出來，這樣大家才不會漏掉。

extra_vocab.en: to show how something works
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡是「示範」的意思，Boyd 說會實際演示這些推車和汽座怎麼運作，讓聽眾看得更清楚。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: demonstrate 後面可以直接接名詞（demonstrate the product），也可以接 how 子句（demonstrate how it works）；how 子句裡用一般句子的順序，不要倒裝。

example.en: The video demonstrates how to fold the stroller.
example.zh: 這支影片示範如何折疊推車。

example.en: Our engineer demonstrated the new machine to the clients.
example.zh: 我們的工程師向客戶示範了這台新機器。

example.en: She is demonstrating the app on the big screen.
example.zh: 她正在大螢幕上示範這個應用程式。

example.en: Next, I will demonstrate how to install the car seat.
example.zh: 接下來，我會示範如何安裝汽座。

example.en: The sales team will demonstrate a product at the fair.
example.zh: 業務團隊會在展覽上展示一項產品。

example.en: The test will demonstrate the ability to work under pressure.
example.zh: 這項測驗能展現在壓力下工作的能力。

examples.en: I will demonstrate how the folding system works.
examples.zh: 我會示範這個折疊系統是如何運作的。

examples.en: Can you demonstrate the new software for our team?
examples.zh: 你可以為我們團隊示範這套新軟體嗎？

examples.en: These results demonstrate that customers prefer the lighter model.
examples.zh: 這些結果顯示客戶比較喜歡較輕的款式。

similar.diff: 意思更廣、更口語，demonstrate 通常是有步驟地實際操作給人看。

example.en: Please show me how the system works.
example.zh: 請讓我看看這個系統怎麼運作。

similar.diff: 偏向把東西擺出來給人看，不一定說明怎麼使用。

example.en: We will display our new products at the entrance.
example.zh: 我們會在入口處陳列新產品。

example.en: The data shows that sales are growing slowly.
example.zh: 數據顯示銷售正在緩慢成長。

example.en: The test results prove that the design is safe.
example.zh: 測試結果證明這個設計是安全的。

example.en: Could you explain the main steps to the team?
example.zh: 你可以向團隊解釋主要的步驟嗎？

derived.link: demonstrate + -ion，把動作變成名詞，像 prepare → preparation、present → presentation
demonstrate + -or，做事的人，像 actor、visitor

senses.en: to show how something works

example.en: He demonstrated how the car seat locks into place.
example.zh: 他示範了汽座如何固定到定位。

senses.en: to show that something is true
senses.distinguish: 主詞是資料、結果、報告，後面接 that 子句時，通常是「證明」的意思。

example.en: The survey demonstrates that customers want simpler designs.
example.zh: 這份調查顯示客戶想要更簡單的設計。

extra_vocab.en: an important or useful part of a product
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡是名詞，key features 指產品最重要的特色與功能。Boyd 會把每款推車的賣點一項項說明。

example.en: The new phone has many useful features for travelers.
example.zh: 這支新手機有許多對旅客很實用的功能。

example.en: The new model features a lighter frame.
example.zh: 新款以更輕的車架為特色。

example.en: Our product was featured in a popular business magazine.
example.zh: 我們的產品被刊登在一本熱門的商業雜誌上。

example.en: We launched a new line featuring a simple design.
example.zh: 我們推出了以簡約設計為特色的新系列。

example.en: Safety is the key feature of this car seat.
example.zh: 安全是這款汽座的主要特色。

example.en: Every model comes with a new safety feature.
example.zh: 每個型號都配有新的安全功能。

example.en: Customers love the new feature on our mobile app.
example.zh: 客戶很喜歡我們手機應用程式上的新功能。

example.en: The hotel room has a special feature for guests.
example.zh: 這間飯店客房有為住客設計的特別功能。

examples.en: I will explain each feature of the new stroller.
examples.zh: 我會說明這款新推車的每一項特色。

examples.en: Which features are most important to your customers?
examples.zh: 對你們的客戶來說，哪些功能最重要？

examples.en: The ad focuses on the main feature of the product.
examples.zh: 這則廣告聚焦在產品的主要特色。

confusable.diff: feature 是產品的特色或賣點；function 是某個部分或某項設計「實際的作用」。

example.en: The main function of this button is to lock the wheels.
example.zh: 這個按鈕的主要作用是鎖住輪子。

similar.diff: 指事物本來就有的特性，比較中性、正式；feature 常用來強調吸引人的賣點。

example.en: Light weight is a key characteristic of this bag.
example.zh: 重量輕是這個包包的主要特性。

similar.diff: 專指能吸引客人購買的優點，行銷語氣比 feature 更強。

example.en: Low price is the biggest selling point of our product.
example.zh: 低價是我們產品最大的賣點。

example.en: This tool has several functions for office work.
example.zh: 這項工具有數種辦公用途的功能。

example.en: The main benefit is that it saves time.
example.zh: 主要的好處是能節省時間。

example.en: Color is an option you can choose at checkout.
example.zh: 顏色是你可以在結帳時選擇的選項。

example.en: The folding system is the best feature of this stroller.
example.zh: 折疊系統是這款推車最棒的特色。

pos_uses.zh: 以……為特色、由……主演或刊登

example.en: The new model will feature a larger battery.
example.zh: 新型號將以更大的電池為特色。

senses.en: an important or useful part of a product

example.en: The camera has a feature that fixes dark photos.
example.zh: 這台相機有一項可以修正暗照片的功能。

senses.en: a long article about one subject in a newspaper or magazine
senses.distinguish: 出現在報紙、雜誌、新聞的語境時，通常是「專題報導」，不是產品功能。

example.en: The magazine ran a feature on our new office.
example.zh: 這本雜誌刊登了一篇關於我們新辦公室的專題報導。

extra_vocab.en: to feel happy about something that will happen soon
extra_vocab.note: Boyd 在開場用這句表達對接下來分享與討論的期待，是簡報與商業信件裡很常見、客氣有禮的說法。
extra_vocab.pattern: look forward to + V-ing／N
extra_vocab.grammar_note: look forward to 裡的 to 是介系詞，後面要接名詞或 V-ing（looking forward to meeting you），不能接動詞原形。

examples.en: I'm looking forward to hearing your questions after the talk.
examples.zh: 我期待在演講結束後聽到你們的問題。

examples.en: We look forward to working with your team next month.
examples.zh: 我們期待下個月與貴團隊合作。

examples.en: I look forward to your reply.
examples.zh: 期待您的回覆。

examples.en: She is looking forward to the trip to Singapore.
examples.zh: 她很期待這趟新加坡之行。

similar.diff: 更口語、更興奮，後面接動詞原形，不太適合很正式的信件。

example.en: I can't wait to show you our new design.
example.zh: 我迫不及待要讓你看我們的新設計。

similar.diff: 強調很想做某件事，後面接動詞原形，語氣比 look forward to 更積極。

example.en: Our team is eager to start the new project.
example.zh: 我們團隊很渴望開始這個新專案。

confusable.diff: look for 是「尋找」某樣東西，和「期待」完全不同。

example.en: We are looking for a new supplier in Asia.
example.zh: 我們正在亞洲尋找新的供應商。

extra_vocab.en: comments about something that help make it better
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡指聽眾對簡報與產品設計的意見。Boyd 希望聽到大家的想法與回饋，用來改進設計。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: feedback 是不可數名詞，不加 s，也不能說 a feedback；要說一則意見可用 a piece of feedback。

example.en: Please give feedback on the draft by Friday.
example.zh: 請在星期五前針對草稿提供意見。

example.en: We received positive feedback from most of our customers.
example.zh: 我們收到大多數客戶的正面回饋。

example.en: Customer feedback helps us improve our service every year.
example.zh: 客戶意見每年都幫助我們改善服務。

example.en: Do you have any feedback on the new schedule?
example.zh: 你對新的時程有任何意見嗎？

examples.en: We would like your feedback before we finish the design.
examples.zh: 在完成設計之前，我們想聽聽你的意見。

examples.en: Thank you for your feedback on our proposal.
examples.zh: 謝謝您對我們提案的意見。

examples.en: My manager gives me useful feedback every month.
examples.zh: 我的主管每個月都給我實用的回饋。

confusable.diff: feedback 是對已經做出的成果給意見；advice 是在做決定之前給建議。
confusable.usage: 兩個字都是不可數名詞，都不加 s，也都不能說 a feedback、an advice。

example.en: I need your advice before I choose a new supplier.
example.zh: 在我選擇新供應商之前，我需要你的建議。

similar.diff: comments 是一則一則的意見，可數；feedback 是整體的回饋，不可數。

example.en: Please send your comments about the report by Monday.
example.zh: 請在星期一前寄出你對報告的意見。

similar.diff: input 指大家提供的想法或資訊，語氣較中性；feedback 通常是對成果的反應。

example.en: We value your input on the new project.
example.zh: 我們重視你對新專案的意見。

example.en: She made a helpful comment about the schedule.
example.zh: 她對時程提出了很有幫助的意見。

example.en: We would like to hear your opinion on the plan.
example.zh: 我們想聽聽你對這個計畫的看法。

example.en: The product received a good review online.
example.zh: 這項產品在網路上得到好評。

example.en: Do you have any suggestions for the next meeting?
example.zh: 你對下次會議有任何建議嗎？

items.tag: 辦公室列印設備故障通知

level.why: 文章結合設備故障、替代方案與工作安排，包含被動語態、分詞構句與條件句，並需要整合故障原因、處理時程及員工應採取的措施。字彙較抽象，且干擾資訊彼此接近，符合約 680 分的閱讀難度。

items.passage:
To: All Office Staff
Subject: Temporary Change to Printing Services

The main printer on the third floor is currently being serviced after a paper-feeding problem was discovered during this morning's maintenance check. Although the technician expects the repair to be completed by 3:00 P.M., employees are asked to use the second-floor printer for urgent documents in the meantime.
