example.en: Your renewal is due next week, so please check the payment details.
example.zh: 您的續約下週到期，請確認付款資料。

example.en: We decided to renew the contract for another year.

senses.en: to continue something for another period of time

extra_vocab.en: to choose not to ask for a payment or follow a rule

example.en: Our bank waives the monthly fee when you keep a minimum balance.

example.en: The waiver explains which risks the visitor accepts when using the equipment.

example.en: They will waive the delivery charge for orders over 100 dollars.

examples.en: The hotel waived the cancellation fee after the flight was canceled.
examples.zh: 班機取消後，飯店免除了取消費。

confusable.diff: refund 是把已付的錢退還；waive 是一開始就不收取費用，不涉及退款。

example.en: The shop gave us a full refund after the order arrived late.
example.zh: 訂單延遲送達後，商店給了我們全額退款。

confusable.diff: cancel 是取消整件事（訂單、合約）；waive 只是免除其中某項費用或要求，合約仍然有效。

example.en: Please cancel my order if it cannot ship before Monday.
example.zh: 如果週一前無法出貨，請取消我的訂單。

derived.link: waive + -er，做動作的東西或文件，像 printer；指免除權利或費用的文件

extra_vocab.en: a fixed length of time, such as the length of a contract
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，a longer term 是「較長的合約期間」。男子認為只要簽比較久的合約，廠商可能願意降低費率。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 指合約「期間」時用單數（a three-year term）；指「條款、條件」時一定用複數 terms（the terms of the contract）。

example.en: The vendor agreed to change several terms of the service contract.
example.zh: 廠商同意更改服務合約的幾項條款。

example.en: We are looking for a long-term partner for this project.

example.en: A short-term contract gives us more flexibility.
example.zh: 短期合約讓我們更有彈性。

example.en: Please read the terms and conditions before you sign.
example.zh: 簽名前請先閱讀條款與條件。

example.en: In terms of price, this vendor is the best choice.

examples.en: The term of this agreement is two years.
examples.zh: 這份協議的期間是兩年。

examples.en: We should review the terms before we renew.
examples.zh: 續約之前，我們應該先檢視條款。

confusable.diff: team 是「團隊」，拼法和 term 只差一個字母，要小心看清楚。

example.en: The legal team will review the contract terms.
example.zh: 法務團隊會審查合約條款。

similar.diff: period 是一般的「一段期間」；term 特指合約、任期或學期等有固定長度的期間。

example.en: The trial period lasts for thirty days.
example.zh: 試用期為期三十天。

similar.diff: duration 較正式，指「持續多久」；term 強調有固定起訖的期限。

example.en: The duration of the service is twelve months.
example.zh: 這項服務的期間為十二個月。

example.en: The contract will expire at the end of June.
example.zh: 這份合約會在六月底到期。

example.en: The renewal notice was sent last week.
example.zh: 續約通知上週已寄出。

example.en: The duration of the training is three days.
example.zh: 訓練的時間為三天。

senses.en: a fixed length of time

example.en: The term of the lease is three years.
example.zh: 租約的期間是三年。

senses.en: the rules and conditions of an agreement
senses.distinguish: 一定用複數 terms，常搭配 contract、agreement、payment。

example.en: The payment terms are thirty days from the invoice date.
example.zh: 付款條件是發票日起三十天。

senses.en: a word or phrase used for a special subject
senses.distinguish: 常和 technical、legal 連用，指專業術語。

example.en: Please explain this technical term to the client.
example.zh: 請向客戶說明這個技術術語。

extra_vocab.en: money you must pay when you break a rule or agreement
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，carry a penalty 是「附帶罰款」：男子請女子查看提早解約會不會被罰款或收違約金。這是續約或解約討論中很實際的問題。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 常用 penalty for + 名詞或 V-ing（a penalty for late payment）；「被罰」常說 pay a penalty、incur a penalty，或事情 carry a penalty。

example.en: Late deliveries may result in penalties under this agreement.
example.zh: 依據這份協議，延遲交貨可能會被處以罰款。

example.en: We had to pay a penalty for the late delivery.
example.zh: 我們必須為延遲交貨支付罰款。

example.en: A late penalty of five percent applies after the due date.
example.zh: 逾期後會加收百分之五的罰款。

example.en: The contract includes an early termination penalty of $2,000.
example.zh: 合約包含兩千美元的提前解約違約金。

example.en: You can cancel the booking without penalty before Friday.
example.zh: 星期五前取消預訂不會被罰。

examples.en: Breaking this agreement may result in a heavy penalty.
examples.zh: 違反這份協議可能會被處以重罰。

examples.en: Please note that late payments will incur a penalty.
examples.zh: 請注意，逾期付款會被收取罰款。

similar.diff: fine 常是政府或主管機關開出的「罰金」；penalty 範圍較廣，也包含合約中的違約金。

example.en: The company paid a fine for breaking the safety law.
example.zh: 公司因違反安全法規而繳了罰金。

similar.diff: surcharge 是「額外加收的費用」，不一定是處罰；penalty 帶有「違規被罰」的意思。

example.en: A fuel surcharge was added to the bill.
example.zh: 帳單上加收了燃料附加費。

example.en: A cancellation fee applies after the deadline.
example.zh: 截止日之後取消要收取取消費。

example.en: There is no charge for the first repair.
example.zh: 第一次維修免費。

example.en: The deposit will be returned after the contract ends.
example.zh: 訂金會在合約結束後退還。

derived.link: penal- 表示「處罰」，加 -ize 變動詞，像 organize、realize

items.tag: 簡報／提案：線上培訓平台提案簡報

level.why: 以員工培訓改採線上平台的提案簡報為情境，內容需整合現況問題、解決方案、成本比較與後續步驟。句型含 because、while、although、until 等連接詞與被動語態，字彙屬中高階商務用語，但整體結構清楚，難度略低於上一週 D7。

items.passage:
Good morning, everyone, and thank you for making time for today's meeting. I'd like to walk you through our proposal to replace our in-person training workshops with an online learning platform.

As you can see from last year's survey, employees spent an average of twelve working days attending workshops, and many reported that the sessions were difficult to fit around their regular duties. Moreover, because instructors must be hired for each session, the cost of training has risen steadily. To address these concerns, we recommend a platform that would allow staff to complete courses at their own pace, while managers track progress through a single dashboard.

The annual subscription is quoted at 36,000 dollars, which is roughly 30 percent lower than what we currently spend. Although some employees may need time to adjust, we believe the flexibility will outweigh the initial inconvenience.

If the proposal is approved today, the first step will be to select a vendor by the end of this month. I'd like to stress that no agreement will be signed until the legal team has reviewed the draft. That concludes my presentation, and I'd be glad to take any questions.
items.zh:
各位早安，感謝大家撥冗參加今天的會議。我想帶大家了解我們的提案：以線上學習平台取代目前的實體培訓工作坊。

如同大家從去年的問卷調查中所看到的，員工平均花了十二個工作天參加工作坊，而且許多人表示，這些課程很難安排在日常職務之間。此外，由於每場課程都必須聘請講師，培訓成本一直在穩定上升。為了解決這些問題，我們建議採用一個平台，讓員工能依自己的步調完成課程，同時讓主管透過單一儀表板追蹤進度。

年度訂閱費的報價為三萬六千美元，大約比我們目前的支出低百分之三十。雖然有些員工可能需要時間適應，但我們相信這種彈性的好處會超過初期的不便。

如果提案今天獲得核准，第一步就是在本月底前選定廠商。我想特別強調，在法務團隊審閱完草案之前，不會簽署任何協議。以上就是我的簡報，我很樂意回答各位的問題。

vocab.col: address a concern / address an issue
adjust to change / adjust a schedule
outweigh the risks / outweigh the costs

questions.q: According to the speaker, why has the cost of training risen?
opts: Employees attend workshops for too many days.
Instructors must be hired for each session.
The online platform requires a subscription.
Managers need extra time to track progress.
why: 員工平均花十二個工作天參加工作坊，是造成安排困難的問題，但並未被說成成本上升的原因。
正解：每場課程都必須聘請講師，因此培訓成本持續上升。
訂閱費是新平台的費用，不是目前培訓成本上升的原因。
主管追蹤進度是新平台的功能，與目前成本上升無關。

questions.q: What is suggested about the cost of the proposed platform?
opts: It will be paid in monthly installments.
It includes fees for external instructors.
It is lower than current training expenses.
why: 文中沒有提到分期付款，只說明是年度訂閱費。
平台讓員工自行完成課程，文中沒有提到包含外聘講師費用。
報價是三萬六千美元的年度訂閱費，並非依課程計價。
正解：年度訂閱費大約比目前支出低百分之三十。

questions.q: What must happen before an agreement is signed?
opts: The legal team must review the draft.
Employees must finish the online courses.
Managers must approve the dashboard design.
The survey must be repeated this year.
why: 正解：說話者強調在法務團隊審閱完草案之前，不會簽署任何協議。
員工完成線上課程是平台上線後的事，與簽署協議無關。
文中提到儀表板是讓主管追蹤進度的功能，並沒有要求先核准設計。
問卷是去年的資料，文中沒有要求重新調查。

questions.q: The team has proposed a platform ______ will reduce training costs.
why: who 用來指人，而 platform 是事物。
whose 表示所屬關係，後面需接名詞，不符合句型。
正解：which 是指事物的關係代名詞，在子句中作主詞。
what 不能作為前面有先行詞的關係代名詞。

questions.q: The company's ______ on external trainers has increased significantly over the past three years.
why: depend 是動詞，不能放在 company's 之後作名詞。
正解：dependence 是名詞，dependence on 表示「對…的依賴」。
dependent 是形容詞，不能直接接在所有格之後作主詞。
dependently 是副詞，詞性不符。

questions.q: ______ the proposal is approved, the team will begin selecting a vendor immediately.
why: Unless 表示「除非」，會變成提案沒通過才開始選廠商，語意相反。
Although 表示讓步，與前後因果順序不符。
Whether 需搭配 or not 或名詞子句，不適合引導這種時間條件。
正解：Once 表示「一旦」，說明提案核准後立即開始選廠商。

extra_vocab.en: in a regular way, without stopping or changing suddenly
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，has risen steadily 表示培訓成本「一路穩定上升、沒有停過」。語感是持續、有規律的變化，常用來描述數字或趨勢，比 suddenly（突然地）更強調過程平穩。

example.en: We need a steady supply of parts to keep the line running.
example.zh: 我們需要穩定的零件供應，才能讓生產線持續運轉。

example.en: Sales were steadier this quarter than during the same period last year.
example.zh: 這一季的銷售比去年同期更穩定。

example.en: Online orders have been our steadiest source of income this year.
example.zh: 線上訂單是我們今年最穩定的收入來源。

example.en: Revenue grew more steadily after we improved our pricing plan.
example.zh: 改善定價方案之後，營收成長得更穩定。

example.en: Of all our regions, the north has grown most steadily.
example.zh: 在我們所有的地區中，北區成長得最穩定。

example.en: Prices have risen steadily over the past three years.
example.zh: 過去三年來物價持續穩定上漲。

example.en: Our profits grew steadily during the first half of the year.
example.zh: 我們的利潤在上半年穩定成長。

example.en: Customer satisfaction improved steadily after we changed the service process.
example.zh: 調整服務流程後，客戶滿意度穩定提升。

example.en: Office costs declined steadily after we moved to a smaller building.
example.zh: 搬到較小的大樓後，辦公室成本持續下降。

examples.en: Our team worked steadily through the afternoon to meet the deadline.
examples.zh: 我們團隊整個下午持續不間斷地工作，以趕上截止期限。

examples.en: Demand for our service has increased steadily since the launch.
examples.zh: 自推出以來，市場對我們服務的需求持續增加。

examples.en: The rain fell steadily all morning, so the outdoor event was moved indoors.
examples.zh: 雨整個早上下個不停，所以戶外活動改到室內舉行。

confusable.diff: gradually 強調「慢慢地、一點一點地」改變；steadily 強調「持續、穩定、不中斷」。兩者有時可互換，但 steadily 更著重過程平穩。

example.en: Employees gradually got used to the new software over several weeks.
example.zh: 員工花了幾週的時間，慢慢習慣了新軟體。

confusable.diff: constantly 是「經常、不斷重複」，多用於一再發生的事（常帶抱怨）；steadily 指穩定地朝同一方向變化。

example.en: The phone rings constantly during the morning, so we cannot focus.
example.zh: 電話整個早上響個不停，所以我們無法專心。

example.en: We have a steady flow of new customers every month.
example.zh: 我們每個月都有穩定的新客戶。

example.en: The company wants a stable income from its services.
example.zh: 公司希望從服務中獲得穩定的收入。

example.en: Job stability is important to many of our employees.
example.zh: 工作穩定對許多員工來說很重要。

derived.link: 最基礎的形容詞，steady + -ly（y 換 i）變成副詞，像 easy → easily
steady + -ness，變成名詞，像 happiness、kindness
un-（不）+ steady，像 unhappy、unable

extra_vocab.en: to change to fit a new situation, or to make a small change
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，need time to adjust 是「需要時間適應」新系統。這個用法常出現在導入新制度或新流程的說明中。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: adjust to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接名詞或 V-ing（adjust to working online）；表示「調整某物」時直接接受詞（adjust the schedule）。

example.en: The system adjusts course deadlines when staff change their schedules.
example.zh: 員工更改行程時，系統會自動調整課程截止日。

example.en: We adjusted the budget after the vendor raised its prices.
example.zh: 廠商調漲價格後，我們調整了預算。

example.en: Adjusting to the new platform took most employees about two weeks.
example.zh: 大多數員工花了大約兩週才適應新平台。

example.en: New employees usually adjust to the system within a week.

items.tag: 訪客登記與門禁流程修訂公告

level.why: 公告使用 which 非限定子句、although 插入分詞構句與過去完成被動（had not been consistently enforced），並需整合生效日、事前申請時限、實驗室樓層的授權條件與退卡規定。干擾項多取自文中出現過的人員與單位（接待櫃台、保全、被接待的員工），需精確區分。

items.passage:
NOTICE TO ALL EMPLOYEES: Revised Visitor Access Procedures

Effective Monday, October 19, all visitors to the headquarters campus must be registered at the concierge desk in the main lobby, which will replace the self-service kiosks in use since March. Because several visitors were found in restricted areas last quarter, the security team concluded that the previous system, although convenient, had not been consistently enforced.

Under the revised procedure, employees expecting a guest must submit a request at least one business day in advance. Requests involving the laboratory floors will be processed only after written authorization has been obtained from the relevant department head. Visitors will be issued temporary badges, which must be returned at checkout, and any badge not returned will be reported to the host.

Contractors needing access for more than two days should contact Security directly, since extended access requires a separate review.
items.zh:
全體員工注意：訪客進出程序修訂

自 10 月 19 日星期一起，所有到訪總部園區的訪客都必須在大廳的接待櫃台完成登記，該櫃台將取代自三月起使用的自助服務機台。由於上一季有數名訪客被發現出現在管制區域，保全團隊判定，先前的制度雖然方便，卻未被一致地落實執行。

依照修訂後的程序，預期有訪客到訪的員工必須至少提前一個工作日提出申請。涉及實驗室樓層的申請，必須在取得相關部門主管的書面授權之後才會受理。訪客將領取臨時識別證，並須在離場時歸還，任何未歸還的識別證都會通報給接待該訪客的員工。

需要進出超過兩天的承包商，應直接聯絡保全部門，因為延長進出權限需要另行審查。

vocab.zh: 接待服務員、服務台人員

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the notice?
opts: To introduce a new self-service kiosk system for visitors
To announce changes in how guests are registered and approved
To report a security incident that occurred on the laboratory floors
To explain how contractors can obtain permanent employee badges
why: 自助服務機台是被接待櫃台「取代」的舊制度，並非新制度。
正解：公告說明訪客改在接待櫃台登記，並新增事前申請與授權規定，重點是訪客登記與核准方式的變更。
公告只提到上一季有訪客出現在管制區域，並未報告單一事件，也不是主旨。
承包商只在最後一句被提到，且是要求其聯絡保全，並未談到永久識別證。

questions.q: What does the notice suggest about the previous visitor system?
opts: It was introduced at the beginning of last quarter.
It was too inconvenient for most visitors to use.
It was not applied in a uniform manner.
It was replaced because of rising equipment costs.
why: 文中只說機台自三月起使用，並未說是上一季才開始；上一季是發現訪客闖入管制區的時間。
文中說舊制度 although convenient，也就是方便的，因此並非不便。
正解：had not been consistently enforced 表示舊制度沒有被一致地落實，即執行不統一。
文中沒有提到設備成本，更換的原因是安全管理上的缺失。

questions.q: Who must give written approval before a guest can visit the laboratory floors?
opts: The head of the relevant department
why: 接待櫃台負責訪客登記，但文中並未說它負責簽核實驗室樓層的授權。
保全團隊是檢討舊制度並處理承包商長期進出的單位，並非核准實驗室訪客的人。
接待訪客的員工只負責提出申請，並在訪客未歸還識別證時被通報。
正解：實驗室樓層的申請須先取得 relevant department head 的書面授權才會受理。

questions.q: All visitors are required to ______ their badges to the front desk before leaving the premises.
why: 正解：be required to 之後接原形動詞，return 符合文法，意思是「歸還」。
returns 是第三人稱單數或名詞複數，不能接在 to 之後作不定詞。
returned 是過去式或過去分詞，不能放在不定詞 to 之後。
returning 是動名詞或現在分詞，be required to 後面不接 -ing 形式。

questions.q: Access to the server room is granted ______ to employees who have completed the safety training.
why: exclusive 是形容詞，不能修飾動詞 is granted，也不能放在 to 之前。
exclude 是動詞原形，句中已有動詞 is granted，不能再放一個動詞。
正解：exclusively 是副詞，修飾 is granted，表示「僅限於」完成訓練的員工。
exclusion 是名詞，放在此處無法修飾動詞，語意也不通。

questions.q: Please submit your guest request ______ Friday at noon to ensure that the badge is ready on Monday.
why: until 表示動作持續到某時間點，而 submit 是一次性動作，不能搭配。
正解：by 表示「最遲在某時間點之前」，與 submit 這類一次性動作搭配，表示截止時間。
since 表示「自從」，用於說明起點，不能表示截止時間。
while 是連接詞，後面要接子句，不能直接接 Friday at noon。

extra_vocab.en: official permission to do something
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，written authorization 指相關部門主管的書面許可，必須先取得，實驗室樓層的訪客申請才會被受理。authorization 是不可數名詞，強調正式、有憑據的許可，常用於存取權限、付款與簽核流程。

example.en: All building authorizations are stored in the central security database.
example.zh: 所有大樓的授權紀錄都存放在中央保全資料庫。

example.en: Only the finance director can authorize payments over ten thousand dollars.
example.zh: 只有財務長可以批准超過一萬美元的付款。

example.en: The head of security authorizes every request for after-hours access.
example.zh: 保全主管會批准每一件下班後進入的申請。

example.en: The director authorized the budget increase after reviewing the report.
example.zh: 主任審閱報告後，批准了預算增加。

example.en: She is authorizing the new vendor to deliver supplies to our site.
example.zh: 她正在授權新廠商把物資送到我們的場地。

example.en: Unauthorized visitors will be asked to leave the building immediately.
example.zh: 未經授權的訪客會被要求立刻離開大樓。

example.en: You need written authorization to enter the storage area.
example.zh: 進入倉儲區需要書面授權。

example.en: Please obtain authorization from your manager before ordering new equipment.
example.zh: 訂購新設備之前，請先取得主管的授權。

example.en: Copying these files without authorization is not allowed.
example.zh: 未經授權不得複製這些檔案。

example.en: Enter the authorization code to complete the payment.
example.zh: 請輸入授權碼以完成付款。

examples.en: Purchases above 5,000 dollars require authorization from the finance director.
examples.zh: 超過五千美元的採購需要財務長的授權。

examples.en: The system will deny access if your authorization has expired.
examples.zh: 如果您的授權已到期，系統會拒絕存取。

examples.en: I am writing to request authorization for the overseas trip.
examples.zh: 我來信是想申請這趟海外出差的批准。

confusable.diff: permission 是日常、一般的「允許」（ask for permission）；authorization 較正式，通常由有權限的人或部門核發，常有書面或系統記錄。

example.en: You must ask permission before taking photos inside the factory.
example.zh: 在工廠內拍照之前，你必須先徵求許可。

confusable.diff: approval 是對計畫、預算或文件的「核准」；authorization 強調給予某人做某事的權限或資格。

example.en: The plan is still waiting for approval from the board.
example.zh: 這項計畫仍在等待董事會的核准。

example.en: Only the manager can authorize overtime pay.
example.zh: 只有經理可以批准加班費。

example.en: She has the authority to sign contracts.
example.zh: 她有簽署合約的權限。

example.en: You must ask permission before using the meeting room.
example.zh: 使用會議室之前必須先徵求許可。

derived.link: 最基礎的詞幹，原意是「創造者、有權的人」
author + -ity，有權的狀態，像 active → activity
author + -ize，使某人有權，像 organize、modernize
un-（不）+ authorized，像 unhappy、unable

senses.en: official permission to do something

example.en: You need authorization from your manager to enter the lab.
example.zh: 進入實驗室需要主管的授權。

senses.en: official approval of a payment
senses.distinguish: 出現在刷卡、付款情境時，指銀行對交易的核准。

example.en: The bank sent an authorization for the credit card payment.
example.zh: 銀行核發了這筆信用卡付款的授權。

extra_vocab.en: the land and buildings that belong to a company or school
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，the headquarters campus 指總部的整個園區，包含多棟建築與周邊場地，而不是單一棟大樓。campus 本來多指大學校園，現在也常用於大型企業或科技公司的辦公園區。

example.en: The firm has offices on three campuses across the region.
example.zh: 這家公司在區域內三個園區都設有辦公室。

example.en: The company opened a new corporate campus near the airport.
example.zh: 公司在機場附近開設了新的企業園區。

example.en: Employees can find several restaurants on campus.
example.zh: 員工可以在園區內找到幾家餐廳。

example.en: Please call campus security if you see anything unusual.
example.zh: 如果看到任何異常情況，請聯絡園區保全。

example.en: New hires will join a campus tour on their first day.
example.zh: 新進員工第一天會參加園區導覽。

examples.en: Parking on campus will be limited during the renovation.
examples.zh: 整修期間，園區內的停車位將受到限制。

examples.en: The firm visits several university campuses each spring to recruit graduates.
examples.zh: 這家公司每年春天會拜訪幾所大學校園，招募畢業生。

examples.en: The sales team will move to the new building on the east campus.
examples.zh: 業務團隊將搬到東園區的新大樓。

confusable.diff: premises 指公司或店面使用的土地與建築物，且永遠用複數（on the premises）；campus 指大型、有多棟建築的園區或校園。

example.en: Smoking is not allowed anywhere on the company premises.
example.zh: 公司場所內任何地方都禁止吸菸。

confusable.diff: headquarters 指公司的總部，是機構的中心；campus 是占地範圍，總部可能位於一個 campus 之中。

example.en: The company's headquarters is in Chicago, near the river.
example.zh: 公司總部位於芝加哥，靠近河邊。

example.en: The new training facility opens next month.
example.zh: 新的訓練設施下個月啟用。

example.en: Smoking is not allowed on the premises.
example.zh: 場所內禁止吸菸。

example.en: The headquarters is located in downtown Chicago.
example.zh: 總部位於芝加哥市中心。

senses.en: the land and buildings that belong to a company

example.en: The company's new campus has three office buildings.
example.zh: 公司的新園區有三棟辦公大樓。

senses.en: the grounds and buildings of a university or school
senses.distinguish: 談學校、學生時，指校園；談公司總部時，指園區。

example.en: Students must show their cards when entering the campus.
example.zh: 學生進入校園時必須出示學生證。

extra_vocab.zh: 接待人員、服務台人員、禮賓員
extra_vocab.en: a person at a hotel or building who helps guests with information and services
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，the concierge desk 是大廳裡負責訪客登記的人工服務台，取代原本的自助服務機台。concierge 原本多指飯店的禮賓人員，現在也用在辦公大樓或社區的接待與服務櫃台。

example.en: The hotel employs four concierges to assist guests during busy seasons.
example.zh: 這家飯店在旺季僱用四位禮賓人員協助賓客。

example.en: Please leave your package at the concierge desk.
example.zh: 請把您的包裹放在服務台。

example.en: The hotel concierge booked a table for our client dinner.
example.zh: 飯店禮賓人員為我們的客戶晚宴訂了位子。

example.en: The building offers concierge service from eight to six.
example.zh: 這棟大樓從八點到六點提供禮賓服務。

example.en: You can ask the concierge for directions to the station.
example.zh: 您可以請教服務人員前往車站的路線。

examples.en: The concierge arranged a taxi to the airport for us.
examples.zh: 禮賓人員為我們安排了前往機場的計程車。

examples.en: Visitors must sign in with the concierge before taking the elevator.
examples.zh: 訪客搭電梯之前，必須先向服務台簽到。

examples.en: Our concierge can recommend restaurants near the convention center.
examples.zh: 我們的服務人員可以推薦會議中心附近的餐廳。

confusable.diff: receptionist 主要負責接待來訪者、接電話與基本行政；concierge 更偏向提供資訊、訂位、叫車等服務，在公告中也可泛指訪客登記的服務台。

example.en: The receptionist answered the phone and greeted each visitor.
example.zh: 接待員接了電話，並向每位訪客問好。

confusable.diff: security guard 負責安全與巡邏；concierge 主要協助與服務，通常不負責執法或巡查。

example.en: A security guard checks every visitor's badge at the gate.
example.zh: 保全人員會在大門口檢查每位訪客的識別證。

example.en: The receptionist asked me to sign the visitor log.
example.zh: 接待員請我在訪客登記簿上簽名。

example.en: Please pick up your badge at reception.
example.zh: 請到櫃台領取您的識別證。

example.en: Guests may ask for assistance at the front desk.
example.zh: 賓客可在櫃台尋求協助。

extra_vocab.en: in the same way every time
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，had not been consistently enforced 表示舊制度並沒有被一致地執行，有時有人遵守、有時沒有，這正是出現問題的原因。consistently 多放在被動語態的 been 與過去分詞之間，也常用來描述績效或品質一直保持穩定。

example.en: Her consistent effort earned the team a quality award this year.
example.zh: 她始終如一的努力為團隊贏得今年的品質獎。

example.en: We check each batch to maintain consistency across all our products.
example.zh: 我們檢查每一批產品，以維持所有產品的一致性。

example.en: The inconsistent results forced us to repeat the entire test.
example.zh: 結果不一致，迫使我們把整個測試重做一遍。

example.en: The rules were applied inconsistently, which confused many employees.
example.zh: 規定執行得不一致，讓許多員工感到困惑。

example.en: Staff follow the procedure more consistently since we added reminders.
example.zh: 自從加了提醒之後，員工更一致地遵守這項程序。

example.en: She is the employee who most consistently arrives before the shift starts.
example.zh: 她是最始終如一在輪班開始前就到的員工。

example.en: Customer satisfaction has been consistently high this year.
example.zh: 今年的顧客滿意度一直維持高水準。

example.en: All managers must consistently apply the same rules.
example.zh: 所有主管都必須一致地適用相同的規定。

example.en: She consistently meets deadlines, even under pressure.
example.zh: 即使在壓力下，她也始終如期完成工作。

example.en: Our supplier consistently delivers products of good quality.
example.zh: 我們的供應商始終穩定供應品質良好的產品。

examples.en: The inspection process must be carried out consistently at every plant.
examples.zh: 每間工廠都必須一致地執行檢驗流程。

examples.en: Sales have consistently grown over the past three quarters.
examples.zh: 過去三季的銷售持續穩定成長。

examples.en: If we do not enforce the policy consistently, employees will ignore it.
examples.zh: 如果我們不一致地執行這項政策，員工就會忽視它。

confusable.diff: constantly 表示不斷地、一直發生（常帶有「太頻繁」的語氣）；consistently 強調每次都維持同樣的方式或水準。

example.en: The printer constantly breaks down, so we are replacing it.
example.zh: 這台印表機三天兩頭故障，所以我們要換掉它。

confusable.diff: regularly 指按固定的時間間隔發生（每週、每月）；consistently 指表現或做法前後一致，不一定有固定間隔。

example.en: The cleaning crew regularly checks the lobby every two hours.
example.zh: 清潔人員每兩小時定時巡視一次大廳。

example.en: We need a consistent approach to customer complaints.
example.zh: 我們需要一致的方式來處理客訴。

example.en: Consistency is important for product quality.
example.zh: 一致性對產品品質很重要。

example.en: We are looking for a reliable shipping partner.
example.zh: 我們正在尋找可靠的運輸夥伴。

derived.link: 最基礎的詞幹，con-（一起）+ sist（站），站在一起，意思穩定一致
consist + -ent，形容詞字尾，像 different、present
consistent 的 t 換成 -cy，變成名詞，像 urgent → urgency
in-（不）+ consistent，像 incorrect、incomplete

extra_vocab.zh: 退房手續、離場結帳（登出）、結帳
extra_vocab.en: the time or place where you finish and leave, or pay
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，returned at checkout 指訪客離開時辦理離場手續的當下，必須歸還臨時識別證。checkout 在飯店是退房，在商店是結帳櫃台，在此文則是訪客離場的程序。要注意名詞 checkout 是一個字，動詞片語 check out 是兩個字。

example.en: Self-service checkouts have shortened the waiting time in our stores.
example.zh: 自助結帳櫃台縮短了我們門市的等候時間。

example.en: Visitors should check out at the front desk when they leave.
example.zh: 訪客離開時應在櫃台辦理離場手續。

example.en: Ms. Kim checked out early because of a schedule change.
example.zh: 金小姐因為行程變動而提早退房。

example.en: Guests checking out today can leave their bags at the desk.
example.zh: 今天退房的賓客可以把行李寄放在櫃台。

example.en: Please return your room key at checkout.
example.zh: 退房時請歸還您的房卡。

example.en: Checkout time is eleven in the morning.
example.zh: 退房時間是上午十一點。

example.en: Please bring your items to the checkout counter.
example.zh: 請把您的商品拿到結帳櫃台。

example.en: We can arrange a late checkout for an extra fee.
example.zh: 我們可以加價安排延後退房。

examples.en: Guests can leave their luggage at the front desk after checkout.
examples.zh: 賓客退房後可將行李寄放在櫃台。

examples.en: The online checkout accepts credit cards and mobile payments.
examples.zh: 線上結帳可使用信用卡與行動支付。

examples.en: All visitors must sign out at the desk during checkout.
examples.zh: 所有訪客在離場時都必須在櫃台簽退。

confusable.diff: check-in 是抵達時辦理登記或報到；checkout 是離開時辦理退房、離場或結帳，兩者相對。

example.en: Check-in begins at three, but checkout is at eleven.
example.zh: 辦理入住從三點開始，但退房時間是十一點。

confusable.diff: check out 是兩個字的動詞片語，表示「辦理退房」或「查看」；checkout 是一個字的名詞，指退房或結帳這件事或地點。

example.en: Please check out of your room before eleven o'clock.
example.zh: 請在十一點前辦理退房。

example.en: Check-in starts at three in the afternoon.
example.zh: 辦理入住從下午三點開始。

example.en: Please confirm the time of your departure.
example.zh: 請確認您的出發時間。

example.en: Visitors must register at the front desk.
example.zh: 訪客必須在櫃台登記。

derived.link: 最基礎的詞幹；check + out 合成名詞 checkout，指「辦完手續離開」

senses.en: the time when you finish your stay and leave

example.en: Please return your key at checkout.
example.zh: 退房時請歸還你的房卡。

senses.en: the place in a store where you pay
senses.distinguish: 談商店、賣場時，指付錢的地方。

example.en: The checkout is near the main entrance.
example.zh: 結帳櫃台就在大門口附近。

senses.en: the final step when you pay for an online order
senses.distinguish: 談網站、購物車時，指付款的最後步驟。

example.en: The online checkout accepts credit cards and mobile payments.
example.zh: 線上結帳可使用信用卡和行動支付。

items.tag: 海外參展出發前行程須知語音通知

level.why: 語音通知含 because、unless、so 等多層連接詞，並使用被動與完成式（has been moved、may be adjusted）及 expected to 結構，需整合行李限制、飯店入口變更、天氣與場地冷氣、晚宴時間與行事曆確認等多個資訊點。干擾項多取自文中出現過的物品與地點，需精確區分。

items.passage: Good afternoon, everyone. This is Rachel Kim from Travel Services with a few updates before Monday's departure for Lisbon. Because excessive baggage fees are charged by most European carriers, please limit yourselves to one checked bag, unless you are carrying display materials for the trade fair. The ongoing construction near the hotel has blocked the main entrance, so taxis will drop you at the side door on Rua Nova instead. The weather is expected to be mild, but the venue is heavily air-conditioned, so a light jacket is advisable. To maximize your time at the fair, the client dinner has been moved to seven o'clock. Finally, session times may be adjusted, so please check the shared calendar periodically. Thank you.
items.zh: 大家午安，我是旅遊服務部的瑞秋．金，在週一前往里斯本出發前，向大家說明幾項最新消息。由於大多數歐洲航空公司都會收取過高的行李費，請大家只攜帶一件託運行李，除非你要帶貿易展的展示用品。飯店附近持續進行的施工已封閉了正門，所以計程車會改在新街上的側門讓各位下車。當地天氣預計溫和，但會場冷氣很強，因此建議帶一件輕便外套。為了讓各位能充分運用展覽的時間，客戶晚宴已改到七點舉行。最後，場次時間可能會調整，所以請定期查看共用行事曆。謝謝。

vocab.zh: 持續進行的、現正進行的

questions.q: Why does the speaker ask the listeners to limit themselves to one checked bag?
opts: To make room for the display materials
To shorten the time spent at airport check-in
To avoid high baggage charges on European airlines
To comply with the hotel's storage policy
why: 展示用品是限制一件行李的「例外」，並不是限制行李的原因。
文中沒有提到辦理登機手續的時間問題。
正解：說話者說多數歐洲航空公司會收取 excessive baggage fees，所以請大家只帶一件託運行李。
文中沒有提到飯店有任何行李存放規定。

questions.q: Where will the taxis drop off the passengers at the hotel?
opts: At the main entrance of the hotel
At the entrance of the trade fair venue
At a side door of the hotel
why: 主要入口因施工而被封閉，所以計程車不會停在那裡。
文中提到的展覽會場是活動地點，並非計程車的下車處。
文中完全沒有提到地鐵站。
正解：因為正門被封閉，計程車會改在 Rua Nova 上的側門讓乘客下車。

questions.q: Why does the speaker recommend bringing a light jacket?
opts: The evenings in Lisbon are expected to be cold.
The venue is kept cool by air conditioning.
The client dinner will be held outdoors.
The weather forecast has recently changed.
why: 說話者說天氣預計溫和，並沒有說晚上會很冷。
正解：雖然天氣溫和，但會場 heavily air-conditioned，所以建議帶輕便外套。
文中只說晚宴改到七點，並未提到在戶外舉行。
文中沒有提到天氣預報有任何改變。

questions.q: Employees who ______ travel on business are reimbursed for meals within the daily limit.
why: 正解：frequently 是副詞，修飾動詞 travel，表示「經常出差」。
frequent 是形容詞或動詞，無法放在主詞 who 與動詞 travel 之間修飾動詞。
frequency 是名詞，不能修飾動詞。
frequenting 是動名詞或現在分詞，與 who 後的複數動詞結構不符。

questions.q: Passengers must present their passports ______ boarding the aircraft.
why: during 後面通常接名詞表示期間，與 boarding 搭配語意不自然，也不是表示「一登機就」的慣用語。
although 是連接詞，表示「雖然」，語意不通。
among 表示「在……之中」，後面接複數對象，語意不通。
正解：upon boarding 表示「一登機時」，是常見的介系詞加動名詞用法。

questions.q: The hotel offers a complimentary breakfast, ______ is served between six and ten.
why: that 不能用在帶逗號的非限定子句中。
what 是名詞子句的引導詞，不能放在先行詞 breakfast 之後作關係代名詞。
正解：which 可在逗號後作非限定關係代名詞，指代 breakfast，並在子句中作主詞。
whose 表示所有格，後面必須接名詞，語意與結構都不符。

extra_vocab.en: more than is necessary, normal, or reasonable
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，excessive baggage fees 指行李費用過高，是請大家只帶一件託運行李的原因。excessive 帶有負面語氣，表示超出合理範圍，常用來形容費用、使用量、等待時間或成本。

example.en: The meeting room was excessively cold, so we asked staff to adjust it.
example.zh: 會議室冷得過頭，所以我們請工作人員調整。

example.en: We donated the excess stock from last season to local charities.
example.zh: 我們把上一季多餘的庫存捐給了當地慈善機構。

example.en: Sales during the fair exceeded our expectations by a wide margin.
example.zh: 展覽期間的銷售遠遠超出我們的預期。

example.en: Customers complained about the excessive fees for late returns.
example.zh: 顧客抱怨逾期歸還的費用過高。

example.en: The excessive cost of the repair surprised the manager.
example.zh: 維修費用過高讓經理感到驚訝。

example.en: Excessive use of the printer may shorten its life.
example.zh: 過度使用印表機可能縮短它的壽命。

example.en: We apologize for the excessive delay in processing your order.
example.zh: 我們為處理您的訂單延誤過久致歉。

examples.en: The company will not reimburse excessive hotel charges during business trips.
examples.zh: 公司不會報銷出差期間過高的住宿費。

examples.en: Excessive noise from the construction site disturbed nearby offices.
examples.zh: 工地的過大噪音干擾了附近的辦公室。

examples.en: We should avoid excessive spending on advertising this quarter.
examples.zh: 本季我們應該避免在廣告上過度花費。

confusable.diff: extra 只是「額外的」，語氣中性；excessive 表示超出合理或必要的程度，帶有負面評價。

example.en: We charge an extra fee for rush delivery orders.
example.zh: 急件配送的訂單，我們會另外收費。

confusable.diff: extreme 指程度非常極端（extreme weather）；excessive 強調「過多、超過應有的量」。

example.en: Extreme weather forced us to cancel the outdoor sales event.
example.zh: 極端天氣迫使我們取消了戶外促銷活動。

example.en: Excess baggage will be charged an extra fee.
example.zh: 超重行李將加收費用。

example.en: Costs must not exceed the approved budget.
example.zh: 成本不得超出核定預算。

example.en: The hotel offers reasonable rates for groups.
example.zh: 這間飯店為團體提供合理的價格。

derived.link: 最基礎的動詞詞幹，ex-（向外）+ ceed（走），走過頭
exceed 的 -ceed 變成 -cess，像 proceed → process
excessive + -ly，變成副詞，像 quickly、carefully

extra_vocab.zh: 持續進行的、現正進行中的
extra_vocab.en: still happening and not yet finished
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，the ongoing construction 指飯店附近仍在進行、尚未完工的施工，因此正門被封閉。ongoing 放在名詞前面，強調事情目前還在進行，常用於專案、談判、工程、調查或支援服務。

example.en: Our ongoing project will be completed by the end of June.
example.zh: 我們進行中的專案將在六月底前完成。

example.en: Ongoing construction on Main Street is causing traffic delays.
example.zh: 主街持續進行的施工造成交通延誤。

example.en: The contract includes ongoing support for all users.
example.zh: 合約包含為所有使用者提供的持續性支援。

example.en: The pricing plan is still the subject of an ongoing discussion.
example.zh: 定價方案仍是持續討論的議題。

examples.en: The ongoing negotiations with the supplier may take another month.
examples.zh: 與供應商持續進行的協商可能還要再花一個月。

examples.en: Because of ongoing repairs, the east entrance is closed to visitors.
examples.zh: 由於維修仍在進行，東側入口不開放給訪客。

examples.en: Ongoing training helps employees keep up with new software.
examples.zh: 持續性的訓練能幫助員工跟上新軟體。

confusable.diff: continuing 強調「繼續、延續」，可用於中斷後再繼續的事（continuing education）；ongoing 強調現在正在進行、尚未結束的狀態。

example.en: The company offers continuing education courses for all employees.
example.zh: 公司為所有員工提供進修課程。

confusable.diff: current 指「目前的、現行的」（current price）；ongoing 指某件事正在持續發生、還沒完成。

example.en: Our current price list is posted on the Web site.
example.zh: 我們目前的價目表張貼在網站上。

example.en: The work will continue until the end of next week.
example.zh: 這項工作將持續到下週末。

example.en: The factory needs a continuous supply of power.
example.zh: 這間工廠需要不間斷的電力供應。

example.en: Please report your progress at Friday's meeting.
example.zh: 請在週五的會議中報告你的進度。

extra_vocab.zh: 溫和的、不嚴重的、不強烈的
extra_vocab.en: not strong, hot, cold, or serious
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，The weather is expected to be mild 表示當地天氣預計不會太冷也不會太熱，溫度宜人。mild 可形容天氣、味道、症狀或反應，意思是程度不強烈、不極端。

example.en: Next week's weather should be milder than what we had during the conference.
example.zh: 下週的天氣應該會比研討會期間更溫和。

example.en: March is the mildest month of the year in this region.
example.zh: 三月是這個地區一年中最溫和的月份。

example.en: The client was mildly surprised by the sudden change in the schedule.
example.zh: 客戶對行程的突然變動略感意外。

example.en: The mild weather made the outdoor event more enjoyable.
example.zh: 溫和的天氣讓戶外活動更加愉快。

example.en: Many tourists visit the region for its mild climate.
example.zh: 許多遊客因為這個地區的溫和氣候而前往。

example.en: A mild winter lowered the company's heating costs.
example.zh: 暖冬降低了公司的暖氣費用。

example.en: Employees with mild symptoms may work from home.
example.zh: 症狀輕微的員工可以在家工作。

examples.en: The forecast says it will be mild and sunny in Lisbon.
examples.zh: 預報說里斯本會是溫和的晴天。

examples.en: This sauce has a mild flavor, so it is suitable for everyone.
examples.zh: 這款醬料味道溫和，適合每個人。

examples.en: The customer sounded mildly annoyed but stayed polite throughout the call.
examples.zh: 客人聽起來有點不悅，但整通電話都保持禮貌。

confusable.diff: gentle 多形容人、動作或觸感的「輕柔、溫柔」；mild 多形容天氣、味道、症狀的「不強烈」。

example.en: She gave a gentle reminder about the report deadline.
example.zh: 她對報告的截止日做了委婉的提醒。

confusable.diff: moderate 指「中等程度的」，不太高也不太低；mild 指「程度偏輕、不強烈」。

example.en: We expect moderate growth in sales over the next year.
example.zh: 我們預期未來一年銷售會有適度成長。

example.en: We expect moderate growth in sales next year.
example.zh: 我們預期明年銷售會有適度成長。

example.en: Severe weather delayed several flights this morning.
example.zh: 惡劣天氣使今天早上多個航班延誤。

example.en: The manager gave a gentle reminder about the deadline.
example.zh: 經理對截止日期做了委婉的提醒。

derived.link: mild + -ly，變成副詞，像 quickly、carefully
mild + -ness，變成名詞，像 kindness、happiness

senses.en: not too hot and not too cold

example.en: The mild weather made the outdoor event more enjoyable.
example.zh: 溫和的天氣讓戶外活動更愉快。

senses.en: not serious
senses.distinguish: 形容症狀、批評、反應時，指程度輕，不是天氣。

example.en: Staff with mild symptoms may work from home.
example.zh: 症狀輕微的員工可以在家工作。

senses.en: not strong in taste
senses.distinguish: 形容食物、醬料、香料時，指味道不重。

example.en: This sauce has a mild flavor, so it suits everyone.
example.zh: 這款醬料味道溫和，適合每個人。

extra_vocab.en: to make something as large or as good as possible
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，To maximize your time at the fair 表示為了讓大家在展覽上能最充分地運用時間，所以把晚宴改到七點。maximize 後面常接 time、profit、efficiency 等，表示把某項資源發揮到最大。

example.en: A flexible schedule maximizes the number of sessions each guest can attend.
example.zh: 彈性的行程讓每位賓客能參加的場次達到最多。

example.en: The team maximized storage space by reorganizing the warehouse shelves.
example.zh: 團隊重新整理倉庫貨架，讓儲存空間達到最大。

example.en: Maximizing profit should not mean cutting product quality.
example.zh: 讓利潤最大化不應該意味著降低產品品質。

example.en: The maximum number of guests allowed in the hall is two hundred.
example.zh: 這間大廳允許的賓客人數上限是兩百人。

example.en: The new pricing plan is designed to maximize profits.
example.zh: 新的定價方案是為了讓利潤最大化而設計的。

example.en: Automation can help us maximize efficiency in the warehouse.
example.zh: 自動化能幫助我們讓倉庫的效率達到最高。

example.en: We should maximize the use of the available meeting rooms.
example.zh: 我們應該充分利用現有的會議室。

example.en: Plan your schedule carefully to maximize your time during the trip.
example.zh: 請仔細安排行程，好在旅途中充分運用時間。

examples.en: Let's keep the agenda short to maximize time for questions.
examples.zh: 我們把議程縮短，好讓提問的時間最大化。

examples.en: The team used social media to maximize the reach of the campaign.
examples.zh: 團隊利用社群媒體，讓活動的觸及範圍最大化。

examples.en: Ordering in bulk helps maximize savings on shipping costs.
examples.zh: 大量訂購有助於讓運費的節省達到最大。

confusable.diff: increase 只是「增加」，不一定到達最高點；maximize 表示盡可能達到最大或最佳程度。

example.en: We plan to increase prices by five percent next year.
example.zh: 我們計畫明年把價格調漲百分之五。

confusable.diff: minimize 是反義詞，表示使降到最小（minimize costs）；maximize 是使達到最大。

example.en: Careful planning will minimize delays during the office move.
example.zh: 周詳的規劃能把搬遷辦公室時的延誤降到最低。

example.en: The maximum capacity of the room is fifty people.
example.zh: 這間會議室的最大容納人數是五十人。

example.en: We want to minimize delays during the shipment.
example.zh: 我們想把運送過程中的延誤減到最少。

example.en: The new software improved the efficiency of our team.
example.zh: 新軟體提升了我們團隊的效率。

derived.link: 最基礎的詞幹；maximum 去掉 um 加 -ize，使達到最大，像 minimum → minimize
maximize + -ation，把動作變成名詞，像 organize → organization

extra_vocab.zh: 定期地、週期性地、不時地
extra_vocab.en: from time to time, again and again after a period of time
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，check the shared calendar periodically 表示因為場次時間可能調整，所以要隔一段時間就回去看一次行事曆。periodically 指每隔一段時間重複發生，間隔不一定固定，比 regularly 稍微寬鬆。

example.en: Periodic software updates keep the booking system free from errors.
example.zh: 定期的軟體更新讓訂位系統不出錯。

example.en: Sales slowed down during the holiday period last December.
example.zh: 去年十二月的假期期間，銷售量減緩了。

example.en: The company subscribes to a trade periodical about consumer electronics.
example.zh: 公司訂閱了一份關於消費電子的業界期刊。

example.en: Please check the filters periodically and replace them when needed.
example.zh: 請定期檢查濾網，必要時更換。

example.en: The committee reviews the safety rules periodically.
example.zh: 委員會會定期檢討安全規定。

example.en: The website is updated periodically with new product details.
example.zh: 網站會定期更新新產品的資訊。

example.en: All elevators must pass a periodic inspection every year.
example.zh: 所有電梯每年都必須通過定期檢查。

examples.en: I will contact you periodically to report on our progress.
examples.zh: 我會定期與您聯絡，向您報告我們的進度。

examples.en: Employees should change their passwords periodically for security reasons.
examples.zh: 基於安全考量，員工應該定期更換密碼。

examples.en: The machines are cleaned periodically to prevent breakdowns.
examples.zh: 機器會定期清潔，以避免故障。

confusable.diff: regularly 指按固定間隔發生（每週、每月）；periodically 指每隔一段時間發生，但間隔不一定固定。

example.en: Our team reviews progress regularly, usually every second Monday.
example.zh: 我們團隊定時檢討進度，通常是每隔一個星期一。

confusable.diff: occasionally 指「偶爾」，頻率較低且無規律；periodically 帶有重複與週期的意思。

example.en: Our manager occasionally works from home on very busy weeks.
example.zh: 我們經理在特別忙碌的週次，偶爾會在家工作。

example.en: Periodic reviews keep the project on schedule.
example.zh: 定期的檢討能讓專案按進度進行。

example.en: The sale will last for a short period.
example.zh: 這次特賣只會持續一小段期間。

example.en: We hold team meetings regularly on Mondays.
example.zh: 我們固定在星期一舉行團隊會議。

derived.link: 最基礎的詞幹，指一段時間
period + -ic，形容詞字尾，像 economic、basic
periodic + -al，定期出版的東西，像 magazine

items.tag: 面試當天流程與面試小組說明

level.why: 人資在面試當天對應徵者的口說說明，使用被動、未來完成式（will have thoroughly reviewed）與 unless、because 等連接詞，需整合面試時間與形式、題目類型、錄音注意事項及後續午餐會的資格。干擾項多取自文中出現過的人物與活動，需精確區分。

items.passage: Good morning, and thank you for joining us for today's interviews. Each of you has been scheduled for a thirty-minute session with a panel of three managers, who will have thoroughly reviewed your applications beforehand. You will be asked to describe a project in which you automated a routine process, so please be prepared to explain the results. Because the session will be recorded for internal use only, please do not adjust the microphone on the table unless you are instructed to do so. Candidates who advance to the next round will be invited to a luncheon with the team tomorrow, which gives you a chance to ask about our workplace culture.
items.zh: 早安，感謝各位參加今天的面試。你們每位都已排定與三位主管組成的面試小組進行三十分鐘的面談，這些主管會在事前徹底審閱過各位的應徵資料。你們會被請求描述一項曾將例行流程自動化的專案，所以請準備好說明成果。由於面談會被錄音，僅供內部使用，除非有人指示，請不要調整桌上的麥克風。晉級下一輪的應徵者，明天將受邀與團隊共進午餐會，這能讓各位有機會詢問我們的職場文化。

vocab.col: automate a process / automate routine tasks

questions.q: What will the candidates be asked to do during the interview?
opts: Adjust the microphone on the table
Describe a project that improved a routine process
Present a plan for the team luncheon
why: 文中是面試小組事前審閱應徵資料，並非要應徵者審閱其他人的履歷。
麥克風是在被指示之前請大家不要調整的物品，並非面試要求做的事。
正解：應徵者會被請求描述一項將例行流程自動化的專案，並說明成果。
午餐會是晉級者的後續活動，面試中並未要求準備相關計畫。

questions.q: Who will be invited to the luncheon tomorrow?
opts: Candidates who move on to the next round
The three managers on the panel
why: 午餐會並非邀請所有人，只有晉級者才會受邀。
正解：文中說 candidates who advance to the next round 才會被邀請參加明天的午餐會。
三位主管是面試小組成員，文中並未說他們是受邀對象，午餐會是應徵者與團隊的聚會。
文中沒有提到有員工負責錄音，錄音僅供內部使用。

questions.q: Ms. Alvarez was ______ for the sales manager position after a strong second interview.
why: recommend 是原形動詞，was 之後不能直接接原形。
recommending 是現在分詞，會變成進行式，語意是她在推薦別人，與句意不符。
recommendation 是名詞，無法與 was 和 for 構成通順的句意。
正解：was recommended for 是被動語態，表示她「被推薦擔任」該職位。

questions.q: Applicants will be notified of the results ______ two weeks of the final interview.
why: 正解：within two weeks 表示「在兩週以內」，用來說明期限。
during 後面接特定事件或期間，不能搭配 two weeks of 表示期限。
while 是連接詞，後面要接子句，不能直接接 two weeks。
between 需搭配兩個對象（between A and B），句意與結構都不符。

extra_vocab.en: in a very careful way, without missing any details
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，thoroughly reviewed your applications 表示面試官在面試前已經仔細看完每位應徵者的資料，不會遺漏細節。thoroughly 強調做事「周全、徹底」，常放在過去分詞或動詞前面，如 thoroughly checked、thoroughly cleaned。

example.en: She gave a thorough explanation of the new hiring process.
example.zh: 她對新的招聘流程做了周詳的說明。

example.en: The client praised the thoroughness of our safety inspection report.
example.zh: 客戶稱讚我們安全檢查報告的周密。

example.en: Interviewers should read the applications more thoroughly before each session.
example.zh: 面試官在每場面試前應該更仔細地閱讀應徵資料。

example.en: She is the candidate who prepared most thoroughly for the technical questions.
example.zh: 她是為技術問題準備得最周全的應徵者。

example.en: Please thoroughly review the contract before you sign it.
example.zh: 簽署之前，請仔細審閱合約。

example.en: Each machine is thoroughly inspected before it leaves the factory.
example.zh: 每台機器在出廠前都會經過徹底檢查。

example.en: She was thoroughly prepared for the client presentation.
example.zh: 她為客戶簡報做了周全的準備。

example.en: The kitchen must be thoroughly cleaned every evening.
example.zh: 廚房每天晚上都必須徹底清潔。

examples.en: The team discussed the budget thoroughly before making a decision.
examples.zh: 團隊在做決定之前，對預算做了徹底的討論。

examples.en: All samples were thoroughly tested in our laboratory.
examples.zh: 所有樣品都在我們的實驗室中經過徹底測試。

examples.en: We apologize and will investigate the problem thoroughly.
examples.zh: 我們深感抱歉，並將徹底調查這個問題。

confusable.diff: carefully 強調小心、謹慎地做；thoroughly 強調涵蓋所有細節、做得徹底，兩者可以同時成立。

example.en: Please handle the glass samples carefully when you move them.
example.zh: 搬運玻璃樣品時，請小心處理。

confusable.diff: completely 表示「完全地」，說明程度（completely finished）；thoroughly 說明做事的周全程度，常搭配檢查、閱讀、清潔等動作。

example.en: The new office is completely ready for staff to move in.
example.zh: 新辦公室已經完全準備好讓員工搬進去。

example.en: The auditor made a thorough check of the accounts.
example.zh: 審計人員對帳目做了徹底的檢查。

example.en: Please read the instructions carefully.
example.zh: 請仔細閱讀說明。

example.en: The report is completely finished and ready to send.
example.zh: 報告已經完全完成，可以寄出了。

derived.link: 最基礎的形容詞，thorough + -ly 變成副詞，像 quick → quickly
thorough + -ness，變成名詞，像 kindness、happiness

extra_vocab.en: to use machines or computers to do a job without people
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，automated a routine process 指應徵者曾把一項重複性的例行工作改成由系統自動完成，這是面試官想了解的專案經驗。automate 的受詞通常是流程、工作或任務，常見於 IT、製造與行政自動化。

example.en: This tool automates the weekly sales report and saves two hours.
example.zh: 這項工具讓每週銷售報告自動產生，省下兩小時。

example.en: Our warehouse automated the sorting of parcels last winter.
example.zh: 我們的倉庫去年冬天把包裹分揀自動化了。

example.en: Automating routine tasks lets our staff focus on more creative work.
example.zh: 讓例行工作自動化，使我們的員工能專注在更有創意的工作。

example.en: Office automation reduced paperwork and sped up the approval process.
example.zh: 辦公室自動化減少了書面作業，加快了核准流程。

example.en: We plan to automate the invoice process next year.
example.zh: 我們計畫明年讓發票流程自動化。

example.en: This software can automate repetitive tasks in the office.
example.zh: 這套軟體可以讓辦公室裡的重複性工作自動化。

example.en: The factory decided to automate production on the main line.
example.zh: 工廠決定讓主要生產線的製造自動化。

example.en: An automated system sends a reminder to every customer.
example.zh: 自動化系統會寄提醒給每位客戶。

examples.en: I helped the finance team automate its monthly reporting.
examples.zh: 我協助財務團隊將月報告自動化。

examples.en: If we automate data entry, staff can focus on customer service.
examples.zh: 如果我們讓資料輸入自動化，員工就能專心做客戶服務。

examples.en: The call center automated its ticket assignment to shorten response times.
examples.zh: 客服中心將案件分派自動化，以縮短回應時間。

confusable.diff: automatic 是形容詞，說明東西本身會自動運作（automatic doors）；automate 是動詞，指把原本人工的流程改成自動。

example.en: The door has an automatic lock that closes at six.
example.zh: 這扇門有自動鎖，六點會自動上鎖。

confusable.diff: computerize 指改用電腦處理；automate 指讓整個工作不需要人介入、自動完成，範圍不限於電腦。

example.en: We plan to computerize our paper filing system this year.
example.zh: 我們計畫今年把紙本歸檔系統改為電腦化。

example.en: Automation has reduced the time needed for each order.
example.zh: 自動化縮短了每筆訂單所需的時間。

example.en: The system sends an automatic reply to every email.
example.zh: 系統會對每封電子郵件發出自動回覆。

example.en: Manual data entry takes too much time.
example.zh: 人工輸入資料花太多時間。

derived.link: auto-（自己）+ matic，自己會動的，像 automobile
automatic + -ally，變成副詞，像 basically
automate + -ion，把「自動化」變成名詞，像 decide → decision

extra_vocab.en: to tell someone what to do, officially or clearly
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，unless you are instructed to do so 表示除非面試官下指示，否則請不要調整麥克風，所以是「被指示去做」的被動用法。instruct 語氣正式，常用 instruct someone to + 動詞，或被動 be instructed to + 動詞。

example.en: The manual instructs users to turn off the device before cleaning it.
example.zh: 說明書指示使用者在清潔前先關閉裝置。

example.en: The receptionist instructed visitors to wait in the lobby until noon.
example.zh: 接待員指示訪客在大廳等到中午。

example.en: The trainer is instructing new employees about the safety procedures today.
example.zh: 講師今天正在向新進員工講解安全程序。

example.en: Please read the instruction card before you operate the machine.
example.zh: 操作機器前，請先閱讀說明卡。

example.en: The manager instructed the staff to submit reports by noon.
example.zh: 經理指示員工在中午前提交報告。

example.en: Visitors are instructed to wear their badges at all times.
example.zh: 訪客被要求隨時佩戴識別證。

example.en: Please leave the equipment as it is unless instructed otherwise.
example.zh: 除非另有指示，請維持設備現狀。

example.en: A trainer will instruct staff on the new safety rules.
example.zh: 講師會向員工說明新的安全規定。

examples.en: The director has instructed us to postpone the launch until May.
examples.zh: 主管已指示我們把上市延到五月。

examples.en: New employees will be instructed on how to use the system.
examples.zh: 新進員工將接受系統操作方式的指導。

examples.en: The client instructed the lawyer to review the contract carefully.
examples.zh: 客戶指示律師仔細審閱合約。

confusable.diff: teach 指長時間教授知識或技能；instruct 指告訴對方該怎麼做，多為具體步驟或正式命令。

example.en: She will teach a course on project management next month.
example.zh: 她下個月將教授一門專案管理課程。

confusable.diff: order 語氣更強硬，帶有命令意味；instruct 較中性正式，常用在上司對下屬或主辦單位對參與者的指示。

example.en: The judge ordered the company to pay a large fine.
example.zh: 法官命令這家公司繳納一筆高額罰款。

example.en: Please follow the instructions on the screen.
example.zh: 請依照螢幕上的指示操作。

example.en: The instructor will lead the workshop on Friday.
example.zh: 講師將在週五帶領工作坊。

example.en: All staff must follow the company's safety guidelines.
example.zh: 所有員工都必須遵守公司的安全準則。

derived.link: instruct + -ion，把「指示」變成名詞，像 decide → decision
instruct + -or，做事的人，像 actor、visitor
instruct + -ive，有…性質的，像 active、creative

senses.en: to tell someone what to do, clearly or officially

example.en: The manager instructed us to send the report today.
example.zh: 經理指示我們今天寄出報告。

senses.en: to teach someone how to do something
senses.distinguish: 後面接 on / in + 技能，指教人做事，不是下命令。

example.en: An engineer will instruct the staff on the new machine.
example.zh: 一位工程師會指導員工使用新機器。

extra_vocab.en: a device that records or makes a voice louder
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，the microphone on the table 是用來錄下面談內容的麥克風，所以請應徵者不要自行調整。microphone 是正式說法，口語和會議中常縮寫成 mic。

example.en: The sound crew tested all three microphones before the conference began.
example.zh: 音響人員在會議開始前測試了全部三支麥克風。

example.en: Please pass the mic to the next speaker in line.
example.zh: 請把麥克風傳給下一位發言者。

example.en: Could you adjust the microphone so everyone can hear you?
example.zh: 你能調整一下麥克風，讓大家都聽得到你嗎？

example.en: The speaker used a wireless microphone during the keynote.
example.zh: 講者在主題演講中使用無線麥克風。

example.en: Please speak into the microphone when you ask a question.
example.zh: 提問時請對著麥克風說話。

example.en: Remember to turn on the microphone before the online meeting starts.
example.zh: 線上會議開始前，記得打開麥克風。

examples.en: The microphone stopped working, so we moved to a smaller room.
examples.zh: 麥克風壞了，所以我們換到比較小的房間。

examples.en: Two microphones were placed in the aisles for audience questions.
examples.zh: 走道上放了兩支麥克風，供觀眾提問使用。

examples.en: Please mute your microphone when you are not speaking.
examples.zh: 不發言時，請將麥克風靜音。

confusable.diff: speaker 是喇叭，負責把聲音播放出來；microphone 是收音裝置，負責把聲音錄進去或放大。

example.en: The speaker on the wall is too quiet for the big room.
example.zh: 牆上的喇叭對這間大房間來說太小聲了。

confusable.diff: headset 是耳機加麥克風的組合；microphone 單指收音的裝置。

example.en: Call center staff wear a headset during their entire shift.
example.zh: 客服中心的員工整個班次都戴著耳機麥克風。

example.en: The speaker on the wall is too loud.
example.zh: 牆上的喇叭太大聲了。

example.en: Customer service staff wear a headset all day.
example.zh: 客服人員整天都戴著耳機麥克風。

example.en: Please lower the volume during the presentation.
example.zh: 簡報期間請把音量調小。

extra_vocab.en: a formal lunch, often for a meeting or special event
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，a luncheon with the team 是公司為晉級者安排的正式午餐聚會，讓應徵者與團隊交流、了解職場文化。luncheon 比 lunch 正式，常指有主題或目的的午餐活動，如商務午餐會、頒獎午宴。

example.en: The firm hosts two client luncheons each quarter at a nearby hotel.
example.zh: 公司每一季都在附近的飯店舉辦兩場客戶午餐會。

example.en: The chamber of commerce hosts a business luncheon every month.
example.zh: 商會每個月都會舉辦商務午餐會。

example.en: We scheduled a luncheon meeting with the new supplier.
example.zh: 我們和新供應商安排了一場午餐會議。

example.en: The company will hold an award luncheon for top sales staff.
example.zh: 公司將為業績最佳的業務人員舉辦頒獎午宴。

example.en: Our department will host a luncheon for visiting clients.
example.zh: 我們部門將為來訪的客戶舉辦午餐會。

examples.en: You are invited to a luncheon at noon on Friday.
examples.zh: 誠摯邀請您星期五中午參加午餐會。

examples.en: Vegetarian meals will be available at the luncheon on request.
examples.zh: 午餐會可依需求提供素食餐點。

examples.en: The retirement luncheon will take place in the main dining room.
examples.zh: 退休午宴將在主餐廳舉行。

confusable.diff: lunch 是日常的午餐，口語常用；luncheon 較正式，通常指有主題、有邀請的聚餐活動。

example.en: Let's grab a quick lunch before the afternoon meeting.
example.zh: 我們在下午會議前隨便吃個簡單的午餐吧。

items.tag: 充電轉接器新供應商評選備忘錄

level.why: 備忘錄使用 following、although、provided that、contingent upon 等連接結構，搭配被動與分詞構句，並需整合三家候選廠商、報價差異、工程評估、保固條件、相容性要求與決標前提。干擾項取自文中出現過的條件與單位（註冊期限、異議期限、大阪夥伴），需精確區分。

items.passage:
MEMO | Procurement Department
Re: Selection of a Supplier for Charging Adapters

Following a referral from our distribution partner in Osaka, the procurement team has evaluated three candidates to supply the charging adapters that will be bundled with the new travel kit. Although Korvex Components submitted the lowest quotation, its adapters use generic internal parts, which, according to the engineering report, may reduce reliability under repeated use. By contrast, Halden Electric's units, priced eight percent higher, include a lifetime warranty on every plug, provided that the product is registered within thirty days of purchase.

Because the plugs must be compatible with outlets in all four target markets, the order will be awarded to Halden, contingent upon a successful sample test by March 14. Any objection should be submitted to the department head before Friday.
items.zh:
備忘錄｜採購部
事由：充電轉接器供應商之選定

經由我們在大阪的經銷夥伴引薦後，採購團隊已評估三家候選廠商，由其供應將與新款旅行組合一起搭售的充電轉接器。雖然科維克斯零件公司提出了最低的報價，但其轉接器使用通用的內部零件，根據工程報告，這可能會降低反覆使用下的可靠度。相較之下，哈爾登電機的產品價格高出百分之八，每一個插頭都附終身保固，前提是產品須在購買後三十天內完成註冊。

由於插頭必須與四個目標市場的插座相容，這筆訂單將決標給哈爾登，但須以三月十四日前通過樣品測試為前提。如有任何異議，請於週五前向部門主管提出。

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the memo?
opts: To explain why a particular supplier is recommended for an order
To compare the prices of three different travel kits
To announce a revised warranty policy for customers
To request approval for an increase in the department budget
why: 正解：備忘錄比較三家候選廠商，並說明訂單將決標給哈爾登的理由。
被比較的是三家廠商的轉接器，並非三種旅行組合。
終身保固是哈爾登產品的條件，而非公司對客戶修改的保固政策。
文中沒有提到預算增加或需要核准預算。

questions.q: What must happen before the order is finalized?
opts: The distribution partner in Osaka must approve the choice.
Customers must register the product within thirty days.
Halden's samples must pass a test by March 14.
Korvex Components must lower its quotation.
why: 大阪的夥伴只是提供引薦，文中沒有說需要他們核准。
三十天內註冊是保固生效的條件，並非決標前的要求。
正解：訂單將決標給哈爾登，但須以三月十四日前通過樣品測試為前提。
科維克斯雖然報價最低，但文中沒有要求它降價，而是因可靠度疑慮未被選用。

questions.q: What is implied about Korvex Components' adapters?
opts: They were recommended by the Osaka partner.
They are less expensive but possibly less durable.
They cannot be used in the target markets.
why: 引薦來自大阪夥伴，但文中沒有說是引薦科維克斯，且與此題推論無關。
正解：科維克斯報價最低，但使用通用內部零件，工程報告指出可能降低反覆使用下的可靠度。
終身保固是哈爾登的產品條件，並非科維克斯。
相容性是挑選時的要求，文中並未說科維克斯的產品無法在目標市場使用。

questions.q: The supplier has agreed to ______ the defective units at no additional charge.
why: replacement 是名詞，agree to 後面要接原形動詞作不定詞。
replaced 是過去式或過去分詞，不能接在不定詞 to 之後。
replacing 是動名詞，agreed to 作為不定詞時後面不接 -ing。
正解：agreed to 之後接原形動詞 replace，表示同意免費更換瑕疵品。

questions.q: The shipment was delayed ______ a customs inspection at the port.
why: 正解：because of 是複合介系詞，後面接名詞片語 a customs inspection，表示原因。
because 是連接詞，後面要接完整子句，不能直接接名詞片語。
although 是連接詞，表示讓步，且後面也要接子句。
even though 同樣是連接詞，語意與結構都不符。

questions.q: The purchasing department places great emphasis on supplier ______.
why: rely 是動詞，介系詞 on 之後需要名詞，不能接動詞。
reliable 是形容詞，後面沒有名詞可以修飾，無法單獨作 on 的受詞。
正解：reliability 是名詞，作為介系詞 on 的受詞，supplier 修飾它，指「供應商的可靠度」。
reliably 是副詞，不能作介系詞的受詞。

extra_vocab.en: the act of telling someone about a person or company that can help them
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，a referral from our distribution partner 指由大阪經銷夥伴「介紹」了一批候選供應商。referral 常用於商務上的推薦、引介，也可指推薦人或被推薦的對象。

example.en: Most of our new clients come from referrals by satisfied customers.
example.zh: 我們大部分的新客戶都來自滿意顧客的推薦。

example.en: I will refer the customer to our technical support team.
example.zh: 我會把這位顧客轉介給我們的技術支援團隊。

example.en: The memo refers to a meeting that took place last Tuesday.
example.zh: 這份備忘錄提到上週二舉行的一場會議。

example.en: Our partner referred us to a reliable packaging supplier in Osaka.
example.zh: 我們的夥伴把我們介紹給大阪一家可靠的包裝供應商。

example.en: I am referring to the second quotation in the email.
example.zh: 我指的是電子郵件裡的第二份報價單。

example.en: Our referral program gives customers a discount for each new client.
example.zh: 我們的推薦計畫會為每位新客戶提供顧客折扣。

example.en: The agency charges a small referral fee for each introduction.
example.zh: 這家仲介公司每介紹一位就收取少許引薦費。

example.en: We received a referral from an existing client last week.
example.zh: 我們上週收到一位現有客戶的推薦。

example.en: New members can join only by referral at this time.
example.zh: 目前新會員只能透過推薦加入。

examples.en: We found the new supplier through a referral from a colleague.
examples.zh: 我們透過一位同事的推薦找到了新供應商。

examples.en: Many companies hire new staff through employee referrals.
examples.zh: 許多公司透過員工推薦來招聘新人。

examples.en: Customer referrals help us find new clients without extra advertising.
examples.zh: 客戶推薦幫助我們不用額外打廣告就找到新客戶。

confusable.diff: reference 是「參考資料」或「推薦信、介紹人」；referral 指「把人或業務介紹給別人」這個動作或其結果。

example.en: She listed her former manager as a reference on her résumé.
example.zh: 她在履歷上把前任主管列為推薦人。

confusable.diff: recommendation 是一般的「建議、推薦」；referral 多指把客戶、病人或供應商正式介紹給另一方。

example.en: The consultant made a recommendation to switch to a new supplier.
example.zh: 顧問建議改用新的供應商。

example.en: Please refer to the attached file for more details.
example.zh: 更多細節請參閱附件。

example.en: The applicant listed two references on his résumé.
example.zh: 應徵者在履歷上列了兩位推薦人。

example.en: I recommend that we choose the second supplier.
example.zh: 我建議我們選擇第二家供應商。

derived.link: 最基礎的動詞詞幹；refer + -al 變成名詞，像 arrive → arrival
refer + -ence，把動作變成名詞，像 prefer → preference

senses.en: the act of telling someone about a person or a company that can help

example.en: We found the new supplier through a referral from a colleague.
example.zh: 我們透過同事的推薦找到了新供應商。

senses.en: a person who has been sent to another specialist
senses.distinguish: 談醫療、客戶案件時，可指被轉介過來的人。

example.en: The clinic sees many referrals from local doctors.
example.zh: 這間診所接到許多當地醫生轉介來的病人。

extra_vocab.zh: 通用的、無品牌的、一般性的
extra_vocab.en: not special; without a brand name or a particular design
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，generic internal parts 指沒有特定品牌、非專屬設計的通用內部零件，言下之意是品質與可靠度較普通。generic 常帶有「沒有特色、不特別」的語感。

example.en: The product was labeled generically, so customers could not identify the brand.
example.zh: 這項產品的標示很籠統，所以顧客無法辨認品牌。

forms.label: 複數
forms.zh: 學名藥、無品牌商品（複數）

example.en: The hospital buys generics in bulk to lower its monthly costs.
example.zh: 醫院大量採購學名藥，以降低每月成本。

example.en: Some stores sell generic brand products at lower prices.
example.zh: 有些商店以較低的價格販售無品牌商品。

example.en: The hospital switched to a generic drug to save money.
example.zh: 醫院改用學名藥以節省經費。

example.en: "Software" is a generic term for computer programs.
example.zh: 「軟體」是電腦程式的通稱。

examples.en: The email sounded generic, so many readers ignored it.
examples.zh: 這封電子郵件聽起來很制式，所以許多讀者都忽略了它。

examples.en: Generic parts are cheaper, but they may not last as long.
examples.zh: 通用零件比較便宜，但可能用不了那麼久。

examples.en: Please avoid generic answers and give specific examples instead.
examples.zh: 請避免籠統的回答，改為提出具體的例子。

confusable.diff: general 是「一般的、大致的、整體的」；generic 指「通用的、無特定品牌或特色的」，常用於商品與零件。

example.en: The general manager will lead the meeting this afternoon.
example.zh: 總經理將主持今天下午的會議。

example.en: The general manager will lead the meeting.
example.zh: 總經理將主持這場會議。

example.en: Orders are generally delivered within three days.
example.zh: 訂單通常在三天內送達。

example.en: Generic parts are cheaper, but they may not last long.
example.zh: 通用零件比較便宜，但可能不耐用。

example.en: Pharmacies sell generics at lower prices than brand drugs.
example.zh: 藥局販售學名藥的價格比品牌藥低。

senses.en: without a brand name or a special design

example.en: The store sells generic batteries at half the price.
example.zh: 這家店以半價販售無品牌電池。

senses.en: not specific; the same for everyone
senses.distinguish: 形容信件、回答、建議時，指沒有針對性。

example.en: The reply was generic and did not answer my question.
example.zh: 這封回覆很制式，沒有回答我的問題。

extra_vocab.en: the whole time that a person lives or a product works
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，lifetime warranty 是「終身保固」，指只要產品還在使用期間內都提供保固。lifetime 放在名詞前當形容詞用，常見於保固、會員資格與獎項。

example.en: Different batteries have different lifetimes, so check the label before buying.
example.zh: 不同電池的使用壽命不同，購買前請先看標籤。

example.en: Every chair we sell comes with a lifetime warranty.
example.zh: 我們賣出的每張椅子都附終身保固。

example.en: He bought a lifetime membership at the business club.
example.zh: 他在商務俱樂部購買了終身會員資格。

example.en: The tool carries a lifetime guarantee against defects.
example.zh: 這項工具附有針對瑕疵的終身保證。

example.en: We track customer lifetime value to plan our marketing budget.
example.zh: 我們追蹤客戶終身價值來規劃行銷預算。

examples.en: The battery has a lifetime of about five years.
examples.zh: 這顆電池的使用壽命約為五年。

examples.en: The machine's lifetime depends on how often it is used.
examples.zh: 這台機器的使用壽命取決於使用的頻率。

examples.en: She received a lifetime achievement award at the conference.
examples.zh: 她在研討會上獲頒終身成就獎。

confusable.diff: lifelong 是形容詞，指「一輩子的」（如 lifelong friend）；lifetime 可當名詞「一生」，也可當形容詞放在名詞前（如 lifetime warranty）。

example.en: He built a lifelong friendship with his business partner.
example.zh: 他和商業夥伴建立了一輩子的友誼。

example.en: Regular cleaning can extend the life of the equipment.
example.zh: 定期清潔可以延長設備的壽命。

example.en: Learning is a lifelong process for every employee.
example.zh: 對每位員工來說，學習都是終身的過程。

derived.link: 最基礎的詞幹，life + time 合成「一生」
life + long（長），像 lifelong friend

example.en: The chair comes with a lifetime guarantee on the frame.
example.zh: 這張椅子的框架附終身保證。

example.en: Few people change careers more than once in a lifetime.
example.zh: 很少人在一生中換過一次以上的職業。

senses.en: the whole time that a person lives

example.en: He spent a lifetime building the family business.
example.zh: 他用一輩子的時間經營這家家族企業。

senses.en: the period of time that a product keeps working
senses.distinguish: 主詞是產品、設備時，指能用多久。

example.en: The battery has a lifetime of about five years.
example.zh: 這顆電池的使用壽命約為五年。

extra_vocab.en: the part that you put into a wall outlet to get electricity
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，plug 是名詞，指充電轉接器的「插頭」，所以 every plug 是每一個插頭（每件產品）。plug 也常當動詞，plug in 表示接上電源。

example.en: The shop stocks plugs for outlets used in more than ten countries.
example.zh: 這家店販售適用十多個國家插座的插頭。

example.en: She plugged the laptop into the outlet and started the demonstration.
example.zh: 她把筆電插上插座，開始示範。

example.en: He was plugging the cable into the wrong port when I arrived.
example.zh: 我到的時候，他正把線插進錯誤的插孔。

example.en: This power plug is designed for use in three countries.
example.zh: 這款電源插頭是為三個國家的使用而設計的。

example.en: Please plug in the printer and press the start button.
example.zh: 請接上印表機的電源並按下開始鍵。

example.en: Bring a plug adapter if you travel to Portugal.
example.zh: 如果你要去葡萄牙出差，請帶一個轉接插頭。

examples.en: Please plug the projector into the wall outlet before the meeting.
examples.zh: 請在會議開始前把投影機插到牆上的插座。

examples.en: You need a travel plug to charge your laptop in Europe.
examples.zh: 你在歐洲幫筆電充電需要一個旅行用插頭。

examples.en: Always pull out the plug before cleaning the machine.
examples.zh: 清潔機器前請務必先拔掉插頭。

confusable.diff: outlet（美式）指牆上的「插座」，是插頭插進去的地方；plug 是「插頭」，是插進插座的那一端。

example.en: Please plug the projector into the outlet near the screen.
example.zh: 請把投影機插到螢幕附近的插座上。

confusable.diff: socket 也是「插座」（英式較常用，也指燈座）；plug 是插入的「插頭」。

example.en: A loose socket caused the lamp to flicker all morning.
example.zh: 插座鬆脫使這盞燈整個早上一直閃爍。

example.en: Please unplug the device before you leave the office.
example.zh: 離開辦公室前請先拔掉這台裝置的插頭。

example.en: There is no outlet near my desk.
example.zh: 我的辦公桌附近沒有插座。

example.en: The socket in the meeting room does not work.
example.zh: 會議室裡的插座壞了。

example.en: I left my phone charger at the hotel.
example.zh: 我把手機充電器忘在飯店了。

derived.link: un-（反向）+ plug，拔掉，像 undo、unlock

example.en: Please check that the plug fits the wall outlet.
example.zh: 請確認插頭適合牆上的插座。

example.en: Please plug the projector into the outlet before noon.
example.zh: 請在中午前把投影機插上插座。

senses.en: the part that you put into a wall outlet

example.en: This plug is made for outlets in four countries.
example.zh: 這個插頭適用四個國家的插座。

senses.en: a piece of material that closes a hole
senses.distinguish: 談水槽、浴缸、孔洞時，指塞住開口的東西。

example.en: Please put the plug back in the sink after use.
example.zh: 使用後請把塞子放回水槽。

senses.en: to talk about a product to make people buy it

example.en: The host plugged the new speaker during the radio show.
example.zh: 主持人在廣播節目中宣傳了這款新喇叭。

extra_vocab.en: able to work or be used together with something else
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，the plugs must be compatible with outlets 指插頭必須能配合四個目標市場的插座規格使用。compatible 後面通常接 with，常見於設備、軟體與規格的相容性。

example.en: Engineers checked the compatibility of the plug with each local outlet.
example.zh: 工程師檢查了這個插頭與各地插座的相容性。

example.en: These old adapters are incompatible with the newest laptop models.
example.zh: 這些舊轉接器與最新的筆電機型不相容。

example.en: The second adapter is more compatible with European outlets than the first.
example.zh: 第二個轉接器比第一個更適用於歐洲的插座。

example.en: Of the three samples, this one is the most compatible with our devices.
example.zh: 在三個樣品中，這一個與我們的裝置最相容。

example.en: The new tablet is fully compatible with our current system.
example.zh: 新的平板電腦與我們目前的系統完全相容。

example.en: The app can be installed on all compatible devices.
example.zh: 這款應用程式可以安裝在所有相容的裝置上。

examples.en: Our devices are compatible with most operating systems.
examples.zh: 我們的裝置與大多數作業系統相容。

examples.en: The two managers have compatible working styles.
examples.zh: 這兩位經理的工作風格很合得來。

confusable.diff: suitable 是「適合的」，指適合某目的或場合；compatible 是「能一起運作、相容的」，強調兩者能配合。

example.en: This room is suitable for meetings of up to twenty people.
example.zh: 這個房間適合舉行最多二十人的會議。

example.en: We tested the compatibility of the software before launch.
example.zh: 我們在上市前測試了軟體的相容性。

example.en: The old files are incompatible with the new program.
example.zh: 舊檔案與新程式不相容。

example.en: An adapter lets you use the plug in other countries.
example.zh: 轉接器讓你能在其他國家使用這個插頭。

derived.link: compatible 去掉 le 加 -ility，變成名詞，像 able → ability
in-（不）+ compatible，像 incorrect、incomplete

senses.en: able to work or be used together

example.en: The new printer is compatible with our current system.
example.zh: 這台新印表機與我們目前的系統相容。

senses.en: able to work well with another person
senses.distinguish: 主詞是人或工作風格時，指合得來。

example.en: The two managers have compatible working styles.

items.tag: 新品運動襪行銷企劃書（素人體驗推廣）

level.why: 企劃書使用 following、Rather than、although 與 which 非限定子句，搭配被動與條件式預算釋出規則，需整合上次成效不佳的原因、新推廣對象、招募人數與期程、報酬安排及預算條件。干擾項取自文中出現過的做法與數字（購買廣告版位、六週測試、六月十二日報告），需精確區分。

items.passage:
CAMPAIGN BRIEF: Stridewell Performance Socks

Following disappointing results from last spring's launch, the marketing team proposes shifting the campaign away from mass promotional messages, which many subscribers reportedly treated as spam, and toward community-based outreach among amateur runners. Rather than purchasing additional advertising space, Stridewell will invest in the recruitment of fifty local running club members, who will be asked to test the new socks for six weeks and to share honest reviews on social media.

Participants will keep the products at no charge, although they will not be paid for their posts. A preliminary report on engagement is due on June 12, and the remaining budget will be released only if the sign-up rate among subscribers rises by at least ten percent.
items.zh:
活動企劃書：Stridewell 高效能運動襪

鑑於去年春季上市的成效不如預期，行銷團隊建議調整活動方向，不再大量發送促銷訊息（許多訂閱者據說將這些訊息當成垃圾郵件），改為在業餘跑者之間進行社群導向的推廣。Stridewell 不會再購買額外的廣告版位，而是投入資源招募五十位當地路跑社團成員，邀請他們試穿新款襪子六週，並在社群媒體上分享真實的使用心得。

參與者可免費保留試用的產品，但不會因發文而獲得酬勞。關於參與度的初步報告須在 6 月 12 日提交，只有在訂閱者的註冊率至少成長百分之十的情況下，剩餘預算才會被釋出。

vocab.col: a pair of socks / athletic sock

questions.q: What change does the marketing team propose?
opts: Increasing the number of promotional messages sent to subscribers
Buying more advertising space in running magazines
Engaging amateur runners instead of relying on mass promotions
Redesigning the socks after negative customer reviews
why: 提案是要減少大量促銷訊息，因為許多訂閱者把它們當成垃圾郵件，並非增加。
文中說 Rather than purchasing additional advertising space，也就是不再購買廣告版位。
正解：提案是從大量促銷訊息轉向在業餘跑者之間進行社群導向的推廣。
文中沒有提到要重新設計襪子，問題出在上次的推廣方式。

questions.q: What is indicated about the participants?
opts: They will keep the socks they test.
They will be paid for each social media post.
They will purchase the socks at a discount.
They will be hired as full-time employees.
why: 正解：Participants will keep the products at no charge，也就是免費保留試用的產品。
文中明確說他們不會因為發文而獲得酬勞。
參與者是免費保留產品，並不是以折扣價購買。
recruitment 指的是招募試用者，並非聘僱為正式員工。

questions.q: Under what condition will the remaining budget be released?
opts: If the preliminary report is submitted by June 12
If the sign-up rate among subscribers increases by at least ten percent
If all fifty participants complete the six-week test
If the results match those of last spring's launch
why: 六月十二日是初步報告的繳交期限，並非釋出預算的條件。
正解：只有在訂閱者的註冊率至少成長百分之十時，剩餘預算才會被釋出。
六週是試用期間，文中沒有說需要全部五十人完成才釋出預算。
上次春季上市的結果不理想，不可能以重現那樣的結果作為條件。

questions.q: Sales representatives are responsible ______ handling customer inquiries within one business day.
why: be responsible of 不是正確搭配，應使用 for。
at 通常表示地點或時間點，不能與 responsible 搭配表示負責的事項。
on 與 responsible 的搭配不成立，語意也不通。
正解：be responsible for 表示「負責……」，後面接動名詞 handling。

questions.q: The promotion is ______ to customers who have registered for the loyalty program.
why: avail 是動詞，意為「有益於」，放在 is 之後無法構成句意。
availably 不是正確的字，也不能作為 be 動詞後的補語。
正解：available 是形容詞，與 is 搭配，available to 表示「可供……使用」。
availability 是名詞，與 is 搭配後語意不通。

questions.q: Customer satisfaction scores have improved ______ since the new return policy was introduced.
why: 正解：significantly 是副詞，修飾動詞 have improved，表示明顯進步。
significant 是形容詞，不能修飾動詞 improved。
signify 是動詞，句中已有動詞，不能再接一個動詞。
significance 是名詞，不能修飾動詞，語意也不通。

extra_vocab.en: a person who runs, for sport or for exercise
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，amateur runners 指業餘跑者，是這款運動襪的目標客群，也就是行銷團隊想透過社群方式接觸的對象。runner 在運動品牌行銷中很常見，用來指有跑步習慣的消費者。

example.en: This sports drink is designed for long-distance runners.

confusable.diff: jogger 指以較慢速度輕鬆慢跑的人；runner 範圍更廣，包含一般跑者、比賽選手與長跑運動員。

example.en: Each racer must wear a number on the front of the shirt.
example.zh: 每位參賽者都必須在上衣前面別上號碼。

example.en: Our club runs together every Sunday morning.
example.zh: 我們社團每週日早上一起跑步。

example.zh: 跑步在上班族之間越來越受歡迎。

example.zh: 公司每年贊助一場十公里路跑。

run（跑）+ way（路），跑的路，像 airport runway

example.en: Athletic socks should be soft and keep your feet dry.

example.en: Wool socks sell best in the winter months.
example.zh: 羊毛襪在冬季銷量最好。

example.en: We now offer ankle socks in five different colors.
example.zh: 我們現在提供五種顏色的短襪。

examples.en: These socks are made from a material that absorbs sweat quickly.

confusable.diff: tights 是緊身褲襪，從腰部一直覆蓋到腳；sock 只包覆腳部到小腿。

example.en: The running shoe comes with a free pair of socks.

extra_vocab.en: unwanted messages, often advertisements, sent to many people
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，treated as spam 表示許多訂閱者把公司寄出的大量促銷訊息當成垃圾郵件，這也是上次行銷成效不佳的原因。spam 是不可數名詞，也可當動詞，指大量寄送不受歡迎的訊息。

example.en: The company spams thousands of users with ads every single day.
example.zh: 這家公司每天都用廣告轟炸數千名使用者。

example.en: Customers were spammed with offers after they joined the mailing list.
example.zh: 顧客加入郵寄名單後，就被促銷訊息轟炸。

example.en: Spamming your contact list will damage the reputation of your brand.
example.zh: 對聯絡人名單濫發訊息會損害你的品牌聲譽。

example.en: The IT department blocked the spammer's address after many complaints.
example.zh: 收到許多投訴後，資訊部門封鎖了發送垃圾郵件者的位址。

example.en: Our newsletter was blocked by the customer's spam filter.
example.zh: 我們的電子報被客戶的垃圾郵件過濾器擋下了。

example.en: Please check your spam folder if you do not see our reply.
example.zh: 如果沒有看到我們的回覆，請檢查您的垃圾郵件匣。

example.en: Too many customers marked the message as spam.
example.zh: 太多顧客把這封訊息標示為垃圾郵件。

example.en: We receive hundreds of spam emails every day.
example.zh: 我們每天都會收到數百封垃圾電子郵件。

examples.en: Sending too many offers can make customers see your brand as spam.
examples.zh: 寄送太多優惠，可能讓顧客把你的品牌視為垃圾訊息。

examples.en: Do not open attachments in spam messages from unknown senders.
examples.zh: 請勿開啟不明寄件者寄來的垃圾訊息中的附件。

examples.en: Our reply may have ended up in your spam folder.
examples.zh: 我們的回覆可能被歸到您的垃圾郵件匣了。

confusable.diff: junk mail 指不想要的廣告信，可以是紙本郵件，也可指電子郵件；spam 主要指大量寄發的電子垃圾訊息。

example.en: We throw away the junk mail that arrives every morning.
example.zh: 我們把每天早上送來的垃圾廣告信丟掉。

confusable.diff: phishing 是假冒身分騙取帳號或金錢的詐騙郵件，具有詐騙意圖；spam 只是不受歡迎的大量廣告，不一定是詐騙。

example.en: The IT team warned us about a phishing email asking for passwords.
example.zh: 資訊團隊警告我們有一封索取密碼的網路釣魚郵件。

example.en: The email filter blocks most unwanted messages.
example.zh: 電子郵件過濾器會擋下大部分不想要的訊息。

example.en: Please delete the junk in your inbox.
example.zh: 請刪除你收件匣裡的垃圾郵件。

example.en: You can block messages from unknown senders.
example.zh: 你可以封鎖不明寄件者的訊息。

derived.link: spam + -er，做事的人，像 worker、visitor

example.en: Our reply may have ended up in your spam folder.
example.zh: 我們的回覆可能被歸到您的垃圾郵件匣了。

extra_vocab.en: the process of finding and choosing people to join a company or a project
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，the recruitment of fifty local running club members 指招募五十位跑步社團成員來試穿並分享心得，並不是聘雇員工。recruitment 除了用在人才招聘，也可用在招募參與者、志工或試用者。

example.zh: 公司正在為社區路跑活動招募志工。

example.en: The recruiter will contact each candidate by phone this week.
example.zh: 招募人員本週會以電話聯絡每位候選人。

confusable.diff: hiring 指最後決定錄用並簽約僱用人員；recruitment 指尋找、吸引並挑選人選的整個過程，範圍較廣。

example.zh: 董事會昨天核准了聘僱五位工程師。
