items.tag: 服務合約修訂通知（費用調降與中斷補償）

level.why: 合約修訂通知含 in exchange for which、which will be capped、failing which 等關係子句與被動結構，並需整合費用、支援次數上限、中斷補償的計算方式與通報義務等多項條款。干擾項取自文中出現過的數字與處理方式（現金退款、費用調降、支援次數），需精確區分。

items.passage:
NOTICE OF CONTRACT AMENDMENT

Effective November 1, the service agreement between Brightline Hosting and Marlow Associates will be amended in three respects. First, the monthly fee will be reduced to 4,800 dollars, in exchange for which Marlow Associates will give up its right to unlimited on-site support visits, which will be capped at six per year. Second, any disruption lasting longer than four consecutive hours will entitle the client to a credit, which will be deducted from the following month's invoice rather than refunded in cash. Third, Brightline must alert the finance department within twenty-four hours of any outage, failing which the credit will be doubled.

All other provisions remain unchanged. Both parties are asked to sign and return the enclosed addendum by October 23.
items.zh:
合約修訂通知

自 11 月 1 日起，Brightline 主機代管公司與 Marlow 顧問公司之間的服務協議將在三方面進行修訂。第一，月費將降為 4,800 美元，作為交換，Marlow 顧問公司將放棄無限次現場支援服務的權利，現場支援將限制為每年六次。第二，任何持續超過連續四小時的服務中斷，客戶都有權獲得一筆抵用額，該金額將從下個月的發票中扣除，而不是以現金退還。第三，Brightline 必須在任何當機事件發生後二十四小時內通知財務部門，否則抵用額將加倍。

其他所有條款維持不變。請雙方於 10 月 23 日前簽署並寄回隨附的附加條款。

vocab.col: deduct from payment / deduct a fee
alert the staff / alert someone to a problem
entitle someone to a refund / be entitled to

questions.q: What is the purpose of the notice?
opts: To request payment of an overdue invoice
To inform a client of revisions to a service agreement
To announce the opening of a new support center
To propose ending the contract early
why: 文中提到的是下個月發票的抵扣，並沒有要求支付逾期款項。
正解：通知說明服務協議將在費用、支援次數與中斷補償等三方面修訂。
文中完全沒有提到新設支援中心，只有現場支援次數的限制。
通知是要雙方簽署附加條款，其他條款維持不變，並非提前終止合約。

questions.q: How will a credit for a long outage be applied?
opts: It will be refunded in cash within a month.
It will be applied to the annual support visits.
It will be added to the fee for the next quarter.
It will be subtracted from the next invoice.
why: 文中明確說抵用額不是以現金退還，而是從發票扣除。
每年六次的現場支援與抵用額無關，兩者是不同的條款。
抵用額是減少費用，而不是增加下一季的費用。
正解：抵用額將從下個月的發票中扣除，而不是以現金退還。

questions.q: What will happen if Brightline fails to report an outage within twenty-four hours?
opts: The credit given to the client will be doubled.
The monthly fee will be reduced further.
The number of support visits will increase.
why: 正解：failing which 指未在二十四小時內通報，抵用額將加倍。
月費調降是此次修訂的第一項內容，與未通報的後果無關。
文中沒有提到未通報會終止協議。
現場支援次數是被限制為每年六次，並不會因為未通報而增加。

questions.q: The finance team requested that all expense reports ______ before the end of the month.
why: 主詞 expense reports 是被提交的對象，使用主動的 submit 語意不通。
submits 是第三人稱單數，與複數主詞不一致，且語態也不對。
正解：request that 之後的子句用假設語氣，動詞為 (should) be + 過去分詞，這裡報告是被提交，所以用 be submitted。
submitting 是現在分詞，不能單獨作為子句的動詞。

questions.q: The contractor is ______ for any damages caused by delays in completing the work.
why: liability 是名詞，放在 be 動詞之後不能與 for 構成「負責」的語意。
正解：be liable for 表示「對……負責」，liable 是形容詞，與 is 搭配。
liably 不是常用字，也不能作為 be 動詞後的補語。
liabilities 是名詞複數，與單數主詞和語意都不符。

questions.q: Please review the contract carefully ______ signing it.
why: although 表示讓步，「儘管簽署」語意不符合提醒仔細閱讀合約的目的。
despite 是介系詞，意為「儘管」，語意上不合理。
unless 是「除非」，後面接 signing it 結構與語意都不通。
正解：before signing 表示「簽署之前」，符合提醒先仔細閱讀合約的語意。

extra_vocab.en: without any limit on how much or how many
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，unlimited on-site support visits 指客戶原本享有「不限次數」的到場支援服務，修訂後改為每年最多六次。unlimited 常見於合約與方案條款中，用來說明次數、用量或存取沒有上限。

example.en: The new contract will limit on-site visits to six per year.
example.zh: 新合約會把到場拜訪限制為每年六次。

example.en: The agreement sets clear limits on how often staff can visit.
example.zh: 這份協議對人員可到訪的頻率訂有明確的上限。

forms.label: 過去式／過去分詞／形容詞

example.en: Support hours are limited to weekdays under the new plan.
example.zh: 在新方案下，支援時段僅限於平日。

example.en: Limiting free visits helped the provider lower its monthly fee.
example.zh: 限制免費到訪的次數，讓服務商得以降低月費。

example.en: One limitation of this plan is the cap on support visits.
example.zh: 這個方案的一項限制是支援到訪次數有上限。

example.en: Members get unlimited access to all our training videos.
example.zh: 會員可以不限次數觀看我們所有的培訓影片。

example.en: This phone plan comes with unlimited data every month.
example.zh: 這個手機方案每個月都提供無限流量。

example.en: You can invite an unlimited number of guests to the webinar.
example.zh: 你可以邀請不限人數的來賓參加這場網路研討會。

examples.en: The plan gives you unlimited storage for all your company files.
examples.zh: 這個方案提供無限的儲存空間，讓你存放所有公司檔案。

examples.en: The package includes unlimited phone support for one full year.
examples.zh: 這個套裝方案包含為期一整年、不限次數的電話支援。

examples.en: Our company does not have an unlimited budget for travel.
examples.zh: 我們公司的差旅預算並不是沒有上限的。

confusable.diff: limitless 也是「無限的」，語氣較文學、較誇張，多形容可能性或潛力；unlimited 常用於合約、方案中的次數與用量。

example.en: The CEO spoke about the limitless potential of the new market.
example.zh: 執行長談到了這個新市場無限的潛力。

confusable.diff: unrestricted 強調「不受規定限制」（如不受限制的進出）；unlimited 強調「數量或次數沒有上限」。

example.en: Staff have unrestricted access to the building at all hours.
example.zh: 員工隨時都能不受限制地進出這棟大樓。

example.en: We have to limit the number of guests to fifty.
example.zh: 我們必須把賓客人數限制在五十人以內。

example.en: We have limited time to finish the report.
example.zh: 我們完成報告的時間有限。

example.en: The contract has a limitation on the number of visits.
example.zh: 合約對到訪次數設有限制。

derived.link: 最基礎的詞幹，un-（沒有）+ limit + -ed，沒有上限的
limit + -ation，把「限制」變成名詞，像 explore → exploration
limit + -less（沒有），像 careless、useless

extra_vocab.en: a problem that stops something from continuing in the normal way
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，any disruption lasting longer than four consecutive hours 指服務「中斷」超過連續四小時，客戶就能獲得補償點數。disruption 指讓正常運作被打亂或停止的問題，常用於服務、交通與生產。

example.en: Frequent disruptions to the network upset many of our clients.
example.zh: 網路頻繁中斷，讓我們許多客戶感到不滿。

example.en: Network repairs may disrupt access to our online portal.
example.zh: 網路維修可能會影響我們線上入口網站的存取。

example.en: A power cut disrupts production on the entire factory floor.
example.zh: 停電會使整個工廠生產線的作業中斷。

example.en: Server problems disrupted our online sales for several hours.
example.zh: 伺服器問題讓我們的線上銷售中斷了好幾個小時。

example.en: Please avoid disrupting the meeting with unrelated questions.
example.zh: 請不要用無關的問題打斷會議進行。

example.en: Constant noise from the street is disruptive to our daily work.
example.zh: 街上持續的噪音干擾了我們的日常工作。

example.en: The system update may cause disruption to online orders.
example.zh: 系統更新可能會對線上訂單造成中斷。

example.en: We will work at night to minimize disruption to customers.
example.zh: 我們會在夜間作業，把對客戶的干擾降到最低。

example.en: A service disruption lasted three hours yesterday morning.
example.zh: 昨天早上發生了持續三小時的服務中斷。

example.en: The move to the new office took place with minimal disruption.
example.zh: 搬到新辦公室的過程幾乎沒有造成干擾。

examples.en: Heavy snow led to serious disruption of flights across the region.
examples.zh: 大雪使整個地區的航班嚴重受到影響。

examples.en: A supply disruption forced the factory to stop work for two days.
examples.zh: 供應中斷迫使工廠停工兩天。

examples.en: Construction next door may be a disruption to our afternoon meeting.
examples.zh: 隔壁的施工可能會干擾我們下午的會議。

confusable.diff: interruption 多指短暫的「打斷」（如被電話打斷）；disruption 指讓整體運作被打亂、影響較大。

example.en: After a short interruption, the meeting started again at ten.
example.zh: 短暫中斷之後，會議在十點重新開始。

confusable.diff: outage 專指電力、網路或系統的「停止供應」；disruption 範圍更廣，任何讓正常運作中斷的問題都可以用。

example.en: The power outage left the whole office without internet today.
example.zh: 停電讓整間辦公室今天都沒有網路。

example.en: The strike disrupted deliveries to our stores.
example.zh: 罷工擾亂了我們門市的配送。

example.en: Loud phone calls can be disruptive in an open office.
example.zh: 在開放式辦公室裡，大聲講電話可能會造成干擾。

example.en: Please do not interrupt the speaker during the talk.
example.zh: 演講期間請不要打斷講者。

example.en: After a short interruption, the meeting started again.
example.zh: 短暫中斷之後，會議又重新開始。

derived.link: 最基礎的詞幹；disrupt + -ion 變成名詞，像 decide → decision
disrupt + -ive，有…性質的，像 active、creative

extra_vocab.en: to take away an amount from a total
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，be deducted from the following month's invoice 指補償點數會從下個月的請款單中「扣掉」，而不是退現金。deduct 常用結構是 deduct A from B，用於薪資、帳單和稅務。

example.en: The system deducts the monthly fee from your account automatically.
example.zh: 系統會自動從你的帳戶扣除月費。

example.en: A late fee was deducted from the supplier's final payment.
example.zh: 一筆逾期費用已從供應商的尾款中扣除。

example.en: Deducting the credit from next month's bill is simpler for us.
example.zh: 把補償額從下個月的帳單中扣除，對我們來說比較簡單。

example.en: Please check the deduction on your tax form carefully.
example.zh: 請仔細檢查你稅單上的扣除額。

example.en: Several deductions were listed at the bottom of the pay slip.
example.zh: 薪資單底部列出了幾項扣除額。

example.en: The company may deduct unpaid fees from your salary.
example.zh: 公司可能會從你的薪水中扣除未繳的費用。

example.en: Please deduct the cost of the damaged items from the invoice.
example.zh: 請從請款單上扣除受損商品的費用。

example.en: Business travel may qualify for a tax deduction.
example.zh: 商務差旅可能符合稅額扣除的資格。

examples.en: You can deduct travel expenses when you file your tax return.
examples.zh: 你在申報稅務時可以扣除差旅費用。

examples.en: The store will deduct ten percent if you pay in cash.
examples.zh: 如果你付現，店家會扣掉百分之十。

examples.en: Late fees will be deducted from your deposit.
examples.zh: 逾期費用會從你的押金中扣除。

confusable.diff: subtract 是數學上的「減」，強調計算；deduct 是從金額、薪資、帳單中「扣除」，用於商務與財務。

example.en: Subtract the discount from the total to find the final price.
example.zh: 把折扣從總額中減去，就能算出最後價格。

confusable.diff: reduce 是「降低、減少」整體的量；deduct 是明確「扣掉」某個金額。

example.en: We want to reduce shipping costs by ten percent.
example.zh: 我們想把運費成本降低百分之十。

example.en: The deduction will appear on your next pay slip.
example.zh: 這筆扣款會出現在你下一張薪資單上。

example.en: Subtract the discount from the total price.
example.zh: 從總價中減去折扣。

example.en: We plan to reduce our monthly costs by ten percent.
example.zh: 我們打算把每月成本降低百分之十。

example.en: Regular customers receive a five percent discount.
example.zh: 老客戶可享有百分之五的折扣。

derived.link: deduct + -ion，把「扣除」變成名詞，像 introduce → introduction
deduct + -ible，可以被…的，像 flexible、possible

extra_vocab.en: to tell someone about a problem or danger so they can act
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，alert 是動詞，Brightline must alert the finance department 指發生中斷後必須「在二十四小時內通知」財務部。alert 比 tell 更正式，帶有「提醒對方留意並採取行動」的語感。

example.en: The system alerts the team whenever sales drop below the target.
example.zh: 每當銷售額低於目標，系統就會通知團隊。

example.en: A customer alerted us to the error on her invoice.
example.zh: 一位顧客提醒我們她的請款單上有錯誤。

example.en: Alerting staff early helped us avoid a much bigger delay.
example.zh: 及早通知員工，幫助我們避免了更嚴重的延誤。

example.en: The receptionist watched alertly as visitors entered the lobby.
example.zh: 訪客進入大廳時，櫃檯人員保持警覺地留意著。

example.en: Please alert the team to any changes in the schedule.
example.zh: 行程若有任何變動，請通知團隊注意。

example.en: Drivers must stay alert during long business trips.
example.zh: 司機在長途出差途中必須保持警覺。

example.en: We sent a security alert to all users this morning.
example.zh: 我們今天早上對所有使用者發出了資安警示。

example.en: Hospitals were put on alert after the storm warning.
example.zh: 風暴警報發布後，各醫院進入戒備狀態。

examples.en: The system will alert the IT team if someone tries to log in.
examples.zh: 若有人嘗試登入，系統會通知資訊團隊。

examples.en: Please alert the manager as soon as a customer complains.
examples.zh: 只要有顧客投訴，請立刻通知經理。

examples.en: Travelers received an alert about the flight delay on their phones.
examples.zh: 旅客在手機上收到了航班延誤的通知。

examples.en: The new staff members seem alert and ready to learn.
examples.zh: 新進員工看起來機靈，也準備好要學習。

confusable.diff: warn 強調「警告」有危險或問題（如 warn about the risk）；alert 是「通知對方注意並採取行動」，語氣較中性。

example.en: The manual warns users not to open the machine while it runs.
example.zh: 手冊警告使用者，機器運轉時不要打開它。

confusable.diff: notify 是正式的「通知」某事已發生或將發生；alert 多帶有緊急、需要馬上留意的意味。

example.en: Please notify the manager when the delivery arrives at the dock.
example.zh: 貨物送達碼頭時，請通知經理。

example.en: The email warns users about a new virus.
example.zh: 這封電子郵件警告使用者注意一種新病毒。

example.en: We will notify you when your order ships.
example.zh: 您的訂單出貨時，我們會通知您。

example.en: You will receive a notification by email.
example.zh: 你會收到一封電子郵件通知。

example.en: The fire alarm rang during the morning meeting.
example.zh: 晨會期間，火災警報響了。

derived.link: alert + -ness，變成名詞，像 kindness、happiness

example.en: Please alert the manager as soon as a customer complains.
example.zh: 只要有顧客投訴，請立刻通知經理。

example.en: Everyone received a security alert on their phones.
example.zh: 每個人的手機都收到了資安警示。

example.en: The new staff members seem alert and ready to learn.
example.zh: 新進員工看起來很機靈，也準備好學習了。

senses.en: to tell someone about a problem so they can act

example.en: The system will alert the IT team if a server stops.
example.zh: 如果伺服器停止運作，系統會通知資訊團隊。

senses.en: a message that warns people about a problem
senses.distinguish: 指手機、系統發出的警示訊息。

example.en: The app sends an alert when the price drops.
example.zh: 價格下跌時，這個應用程式會發出提醒通知。

senses.en: a state of being ready for danger
senses.distinguish: 常見 on alert、be on alert，指提高戒備。

example.en: The staff were put on alert after the storm warning.
example.zh: 風暴警報發布後，工作人員進入戒備狀態。

extra_vocab.en: to give someone the right to have or do something
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，will entitle the client to a credit 是合約修訂裡的正式用語：服務中斷超過四小時，客戶就「有權」獲得一筆抵扣額度。語氣正式，常見於合約與公告。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: entitle A to B（B 是名詞）或 entitle A to + V；被動 be entitled to 後面也是接名詞或原形動詞，to 之後不接 V-ing。

example.en: The extended warranty entitles customers to free repairs for two years.
example.zh: 延長保固讓顧客有權享有兩年的免費維修。

example.en: The previous agreement entitled each branch to its own budget.
example.zh: 先前的協議讓每間分公司都有權擁有自己的預算。

example.en: The clause entitling the client to a refund was added last week.
example.zh: 賦予客戶退款權利的條款是上週加進去的。

example.en: All members are entitled to a free annual check-up.
example.zh: 所有會員都有權享有一次免費年度檢查。

example.en: This warranty entitles you to a full refund within thirty days.
example.zh: 這項保固讓你有權在三十天內全額退款。

example.en: Customers with a membership card are entitled to a discount.
example.zh: 持有會員卡的顧客有權享有折扣。

example.en: The contract entitles the client to receive monthly reports.
example.zh: 合約讓客戶有權每月收到報告。

examples.en: Late delivery entitles the buyer to cancel the order.
examples.zh: 延遲交貨讓買方有權取消訂單。

examples.en: Full-time staff are entitled to twenty days of paid leave.
examples.zh: 全職員工有權享有二十天的帶薪假。

confusable.diff: enable 是「使能夠做到」，強調能力或條件；entitle 是「使有權利」，強調資格或法律、合約上的權利。

example.en: The new software enables staff to work from home.
example.zh: 新軟體讓員工能夠在家工作。

similar.diff: qualify for 是主語「符合資格而能取得」；entitle 是某事物「賦予對方權利」，主語通常是合約或規定。

example.en: Employees qualify for a bonus after one year of service.
example.zh: 員工服務滿一年後有資格領取獎金。

similar.diff: authorize 是「授權、批准」某人做某事；entitle 是「賦予享有某利益的權利」。

example.en: The manager authorized the purchase of new equipment.
example.zh: 經理批准了購買新設備。

example.en: Only full-time staff are eligible for this benefit.
example.zh: 只有全職員工有資格享有這項福利。

example.en: You will receive a full refund within ten days.
example.zh: 你會在十天內收到全額退款。

derived.link: 詞幹 title；en-（使成為）+ title，原意是「給某人名分或頭銜」，後來變成「賦予權利」
entitle + -ment，把「賦予權利」變名詞，像 manage → management

senses.en: to give someone the right to get or do something

example.en: A valid receipt entitles you to a free repair.
example.zh: 有效的收據讓你有權免費維修。

senses.en: to give a title to a book, report, or film
senses.distinguish: 常用被動 be entitled + 標題，指書、報告或文件的標題。

example.en: The report is entitled Annual Review of Customer Service.
example.zh: 這份報告的標題是《客戶服務年度回顧》。

items.tag: 簡報／提案：輕量嬰兒推車新產品提案簡報

level.why: 提案簡報含 which 非限定子句、although 讓步結構、分詞與被動（was well received、has not fully recovered），並需整合市場需求、原型設計、供應商風險與建議、時程與預算等多段資訊。干擾項取自文中出現過的材質、月份與測試活動，需精確區分。

items.passage:
Good morning, everyone. Today I would like to propose that we develop a new lightweight stroller aimed at urban families. I will begin with the market opportunity, then outline the design, and finally walk you through the timetable and budget.

First, our surveys show that parents increasingly prefer strollers that fold with one hand and weigh under seven kilograms. However, most existing models are either too heavy or too fragile to be considered durable. Our prototype addresses both concerns by combining an aluminum frame with a sleek, elegant fabric finish, which was well received in last month's focus groups.

Second, regarding production, we plan to work with our current supplier, although we must acknowledge a risk. The earthquake last spring damaged part of its plant, and its capacity has not fully recovered. To reduce our exposure, I recommend qualifying a second supplier before the launch.

Finally, the timetable. Testing will be completed by March, and mass production is expected to begin in June. The total development cost is estimated at 450,000 dollars, of which 30 percent has already been approved.

That concludes my presentation. I would be happy to take any questions.
items.zh:
各位早安。今天我想提議開發一款針對都會家庭的全新輕量嬰兒推車。我會先從市場機會談起，接著說明設計，最後帶大家看時程與預算。

首先，我們的調查顯示，家長越來越偏好能單手收折、重量低於七公斤的推車。然而，現有的多數款式不是太重，就是太脆弱，稱不上耐用。我們的原型機以鋁製車架搭配俐落優雅的布料表面處理，解決了這兩個疑慮，這一點在上個月的焦點團體中獲得了良好的回響。

其次，關於生產，我們打算與現有供應商合作，不過必須承認其中有風險。去年春天的地震破壞了該供應商部分廠房，產能尚未完全恢復。為降低我們的風險，我建議在上市前先認證第二家供應商。

最後是時程。測試將在三月前完成，量產預計在六月開始。總開發成本預估為四十五萬美元，其中百分之三十已經獲得核准。

我的簡報到此結束。我很樂意回答大家的任何問題。

questions.q: What is the purpose of the presentation?
opts: To report on last month's focus group results
To announce the selection of a new supplier
To propose the development of a new product
To request additional funding for an existing product
why: 焦點團體只是用來說明原型獲得好評的佐證，並非簡報主旨。
說話者只是建議認證第二家供應商，並未宣布已選定新供應商。
正解：說話者開頭即表明要提議開發一款新的輕量嬰兒推車，其餘內容是說明市場、設計、風險與時程。
預算中只提到已有百分之三十獲得核准，並非要求為既有產品增加資金。

questions.q: What risk does the speaker mention regarding production?
opts: The supplier's production capacity has not fully recovered.
The prototype failed a safety test in March.
The focus groups disliked the fabric finish.
why: 正解：去年春天的地震損壞了現有供應商部分廠房，產能尚未完全恢復。
三月是測試預計完成的時間，文中沒有說原型安全測試失敗。
文中說家長越來越偏好輕量的推車，並非偏好較重的款式。
焦點團體對布料表面處理的反應良好，並非不喜歡。

questions.q: What does the speaker recommend doing before the launch?
opts: Postponing mass production until next year
Replacing the aluminum frame with a lighter material
Conducting additional focus groups with parents
why: 文中說量產預計六月開始，並沒有建議延後到明年。
鋁製車架是原型的設計，說話者沒有建議更換。
焦點團體是上個月已經進行過的活動，說話者並未建議再增加。
正解：為降低風險，說話者建議在上市前先認證第二家供應商。

questions.q: The committee will ______ the proposal at its next meeting.
why: considerate 是形容詞，意為「體貼的」，不能接在助動詞 will 之後作動詞。
正解：will 之後接原形動詞 consider，表示委員會將審議該提案。
considerably 是副詞，不能單獨作動詞，且後面不能接受詞 the proposal。
considered 是過去式或過去分詞，不能直接接在助動詞 will 之後。

questions.q: Please direct any questions ______ the presentation to Ms. Park in the marketing department.
why: 正解：regarding 在此作介系詞，意為「關於」，後面接 the presentation。
regarded 是過去分詞，語意為「被視為」，不能直接連接 the presentation。
regards 是名詞或第三人稱單數動詞，放在此處結構與語意都不符。
regard 是原形動詞或名詞，不能直接作為介系詞來修飾 questions。

questions.q: The project manager will present the findings ______ the board of directors on Friday.
why: at 通常接地點或時間點，present the findings at the board 語意不通。
from 表示來源，語意是「來自董事會」，與簡報的對象不符。
正解：present ... to 表示向某人報告，對象是董事會。
by 表示「由……」或「在……之前」，無法表示報告的對象。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Today I would like to propose that we develop...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 今天我想提議我們開發……
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於簡報開場，直接點出提案主題，that 子句內動詞用原形。

presentation_phrases.phrase: I will begin with..., then outline..., and finally walk you through...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我會先從……開始，接著概述……，最後帶大家看……
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於開場後預告簡報架構，幫助聽眾掌握順序。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Our surveys show that...
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於說明重點，引用調查或數據支持論點。

presentation_phrases.phrase: However, most existing models are either too ... or too ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 然而，現有的多數款式不是太……，就是太……
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於轉折，指出現有產品的不足，帶出自己提案的價值。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Our prototype addresses both concerns by combining...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我們的原型機透過結合……解決了這兩個疑慮
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於說明解決方案，by + 動名詞說明做法。

presentation_phrases.phrase: To reduce our exposure, I recommend...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 為降低我們的風險，我建議……
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於提出風險因應建議，帶出下一步行動。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Finally, the timetable.
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於轉入最後一個重點，提示聽眾簡報即將進入尾聲。

presentation_phrases.phrase: That concludes my presentation. I would be happy to take any questions.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我的簡報到此結束，我很樂意回答任何問題。
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於簡報結尾並開放問答，語氣禮貌且專業。

extra_vocab.en: a list that shows when things will happen
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，the timetable 指新產品從測試到量產的「時程」，後面接著說明測試與量產的時間點。timetable 是英式用法較常見的字，美式多說 schedule，兩者在簡報中都能用。

example.en: Please send me the timetables for all three production lines.
example.zh: 請把三條生產線的時程表都寄給我。

example.en: We must stick to the timetable to finish before the holiday.
example.zh: 我們必須按照時程進行，才能在假期前完成。

example.en: The team is working to a tight timetable this quarter.
example.zh: 團隊本季的工作時程很緊湊。

example.en: The project timetable has changed because of the delay in testing.
example.zh: 由於測試延誤，專案時程表已經更動。

example.en: We need to revise the timetable after the supplier's response.
example.zh: 收到供應商的回覆後，我們需要修改時程表。

examples.en: Please review the timetable and tell me if any dates are a problem.
examples.zh: 請看一下時程表，若有任何日期有問題請告訴我。

examples.en: The train timetable shows a departure every thirty minutes.
examples.zh: 火車時刻表顯示每三十分鐘有一班車出發。

examples.en: The conference timetable will be sent to all participants next week.
examples.zh: 研討會的時間表將於下週寄給所有參加者。

confusable.diff: schedule 是美式較常用的「時程、行程安排」，也可當動詞「安排」；timetable 多指列出時間的「時刻表、時程表」，英式用法較常見。

example.en: Please schedule a meeting with the client for Wednesday afternoon.
example.zh: 請替客戶安排在星期三下午的會議。

confusable.diff: agenda 是會議的「議程」，列的是討論項目；timetable 列的是各項事情發生的時間。

example.en: Please send the agenda to everyone before the meeting starts.
example.zh: 會議開始前，請把議程寄給每個人。

example.en: We are behind schedule because of the late delivery.
example.zh: 由於延遲交貨，我們的進度落後了。

example.en: The first item on the agenda is the budget.
example.zh: 議程上的第一項是預算。

example.en: The deadline for the proposal is next Monday.
example.zh: 提案的截止期限是下週一。

example.en: I added the meeting to the shared calendar.
example.zh: 我把這場會議加進了共用行事曆。

senses.en: a plan that shows when things will happen

example.en: The project timetable has changed because of the testing delay.
example.zh: 由於測試延誤，專案時程表已經更動。

senses.en: a list that shows when trains or buses leave
senses.distinguish: 談火車、公車、航班時，指班次的時刻表。

example.en: The bus timetable shows a departure every twenty minutes.
example.zh: 公車時刻表顯示每二十分鐘有一班車。

extra_vocab.en: beautiful in a simple and attractive way
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，sleek, elegant fabric finish 形容推車的布料表面質感簡潔又有品味，是在強調產品的外觀賣點。elegant 在商務情境中多用來描述設計、空間或場合，有「簡單卻高雅」的正面語感。

example.en: The new logo looks more elegant than the old one.
example.zh: 新的標誌看起來比舊的更雅緻。

example.en: This is the most elegant design in our current catalog.
example.zh: 這是我們目前型錄中最雅緻的設計。

example.en: The product page presents our new models elegantly and clearly.
example.zh: 這個產品頁面典雅又清楚地展示了我們的新款式。

example.en: The elegance of the packaging impressed our overseas buyers.
example.zh: 包裝的雅緻讓我們的海外買家印象深刻。

example.en: Customers praised the elegant design of the new laptop.
example.zh: 顧客稱讚這台新筆電的設計優雅。

example.en: The engineers found an elegant solution to the heat problem.
example.zh: 工程師找到了一個簡潔巧妙的方法來解決過熱問題。

example.en: The lobby is elegantly designed and very welcoming.
example.zh: 大廳設計典雅，讓人感覺很親切。

examples.en: The brochure has an elegant layout that customers find easy to read.
examples.zh: 這本手冊的版面雅緻，顧客覺得容易閱讀。

examples.en: The hotel restaurant offers an elegant dining room for client dinners.
examples.zh: 飯店餐廳提供雅緻的用餐空間，適合招待客戶晚宴。

examples.en: She gave an elegant speech at the awards dinner.
examples.zh: 她在頒獎晚宴上發表了一場優雅得體的演說。

confusable.diff: stylish 是「時髦的、有流行感的」；elegant 是「高雅、簡潔有品味」，不一定追求流行。

example.en: The new phone looks stylish, but it is not very practical.
example.zh: 這支新手機看起來很時髦，但不太實用。

confusable.diff: luxurious 是「奢華的」，強調昂貴與豪華；elegant 強調簡潔優雅，不一定貴。

example.en: The luxurious hotel suite costs over a thousand dollars a night.
example.zh: 這間奢華的飯店套房一晚要價超過一千美元。

example.en: The elegance of the product made it popular in Europe.
example.zh: 這項產品的雅緻風格使它在歐洲大受歡迎。

example.en: The room was elegantly decorated for the opening event.
example.zh: 這個房間為開幕活動布置得典雅大方。

example.en: The store sells stylish bags at fair prices.
example.zh: 這家店以合理的價格販售時髦的包包。

derived.link: elegant 的 -ant 換成 -ance，變成名詞，像 important → importance
elegant + -ly，變成副詞，像 quickly、carefully

extra_vocab.en: a sudden strong shaking of the ground
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，The earthquake last spring 指去年春天的地震損壞了現有供應商的部分工廠，使產能尚未完全恢復，因此提案才建議找第二家供應商。商務文章中常用它來說明供應風險或營運中斷的原因。

example.en: Earthquakes in the region have raised insurance costs for local factories.
example.zh: 該地區的地震使當地工廠的保險費用上升。

example.en: A strong earthquake shook the city early this morning.
example.zh: 今天清晨一場強烈地震震動了這座城市。

example.en: Earthquake damage to the warehouse delayed all shipments this month.
example.zh: 倉庫的地震災損使本月所有貨物出貨都延遲了。

example.en: Does the company carry earthquake insurance for its main factory?
example.zh: 公司有為主要工廠投保地震險嗎？

example.en: The new office building was built to be earthquake-resistant.
example.zh: 這棟新辦公大樓是以耐震為目標興建的。

examples.en: The earthquake forced the airport to close for several hours.
examples.zh: 地震迫使機場關閉了數小時。

examples.en: Our insurance covers damage to the building caused by an earthquake.
examples.zh: 我們的保險涵蓋地震對建築物造成的損害。

examples.en: After the earthquake, many factories had to stop production for weeks.
examples.zh: 地震過後，許多工廠必須停產數週。

confusable.diff: quake 是 earthquake 的簡短說法，常見於新聞標題；正式的商務文件多用 earthquake。

example.en: Reports of a quake near the plant appeared on the news.
example.zh: 新聞上出現了工廠附近發生地震的報導。

confusable.diff: disaster 是「災難」的泛稱，包含地震、水災、火災等；earthquake 只指「地震」這種災害。

example.en: The flood was a disaster for the small local business.
example.zh: 這場水災對這家當地小企業來說是一場災難。

example.en: The company has a plan for natural disasters.
example.zh: 公司對天然災害訂有應變計畫。

example.en: The storm caused serious damage to the roof.
example.zh: 暴風雨對屋頂造成了嚴重損壞。

example.en: Sales have started to recover after the slow winter.
example.zh: 經過冷清的冬天後，銷售額開始回升。

example.en: Staff should know the exit routes in an emergency.
example.zh: 員工應該知道緊急情況下的逃生路線。

extra_vocab.en: strong and able to last a long time
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，too fragile to be considered durable 指市面上多數推車太脆弱，稱不上耐用，這正是新產品要解決的問題之一。durable 常用來形容產品在長期使用下不易損壞。

example.en: Steel is more durable than plastic for this kind of frame.
example.zh: 這種車架用鋼材比塑膠更耐用。

example.en: This is the most durable fabric we have ever tested.
example.zh: 這是我們測試過最耐用的布料。

example.en: The bags are durably stitched to survive years of heavy use.
example.zh: 這些袋子縫得很牢固，能承受多年的高強度使用。

example.en: Buyers care about durability when they choose a stroller.
example.zh: 買家在挑選嬰兒推車時很在意耐用性。

example.en: Aluminum is a light and durable material for strollers.
example.zh: 鋁是用來製作嬰兒推車的輕巧又耐用的材料。

example.en: Sales of durable goods rose during the holiday season.
example.zh: 耐久財的銷售額在假期期間上升。

example.en: The packaging is highly durable and protects products during shipping.
example.zh: 這種包裝非常耐用，能在運送過程中保護商品。

examples.en: Customers want a durable product that will last for many years.
examples.zh: 顧客想要能使用多年的耐用產品。

examples.en: We chose steel because it is cheap and durable.
examples.zh: 我們選擇鋼材，因為它既便宜又耐用。

examples.en: Our new phone case is light yet very durable.
examples.zh: 我們的新手機殼很輕，卻非常耐用。

confusable.diff: sturdy 強調外型「結實、穩固」（如 sturdy chair）；durable 強調「長期使用不易壞」。

example.en: We need a sturdy table for the heavy printing equipment.
example.zh: 我們需要一張結實的桌子來放這台沉重的印刷設備。

confusable.diff: fragile 是反義字，指「易碎、脆弱的」；durable 是「耐用的」。

example.en: Mark the carton fragile because the glass cups can easily break.
example.zh: 請在紙箱上標示易碎，因為玻璃杯很容易破。

example.en: The tests showed excellent durability under heavy use.
example.zh: 測試顯示它在高強度使用下耐用性極佳。

example.en: The shelf is sturdy enough to hold heavy boxes.
example.zh: 這個架子夠結實，可以放重的箱子。

example.en: Please mark the box as fragile before shipping.
example.zh: 出貨前請在箱子上標示為易碎品。

derived.link: durable 去掉 le 加 -ility，變成名詞，像 able → ability

example.en: This durable case protects the phone for many years.
example.zh: 這個耐用的保護殼能保護手機好幾年。

example.en: Sales of durables rose sharply during the holiday season.
example.zh: 耐久財的銷售額在假期期間大幅上升。

extra_vocab.en: the first model of a product, made to test the design
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇簡報裡，prototype 指推車的第一件試作樣品，用來證明新設計能同時解決「太重」與「不耐用」兩個問題。產品提案中說「Our prototype…」是很常見的開場方式。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: prototype 是可數名詞，單數前一定要加 a 或 the（或 our 等所有格），例如 a prototype、our prototype。

example.en: The team showed three prototypes to the board on Thursday morning.
example.zh: 團隊在週四早上向董事會展示了三件原型。

example.en: The engineers need two weeks to build a prototype of the new chair.
example.zh: 工程師需要兩週時間製作新椅子的原型。

example.en: We will test a prototype with real customers before approving production.
example.zh: 我們會先讓真實顧客測試原型，再核准量產。

example.en: Investors asked to see a working prototype before they signed the agreement.
example.zh: 投資人在簽約前要求看可運作的原型。

example.en: Prototype testing showed that the handle broke under heavy use.
example.zh: 原型測試顯示把手在重度使用下會斷裂。

examples.en: Our prototype weighs less than any model currently on the market.
examples.zh: 我們的原型比目前市面上任何機型都輕。

examples.en: The design team will present the first prototype at Monday's meeting.
examples.zh: 設計團隊將在週一的會議中展示第一件原型。

examples.en: Please send me photos of the prototype by the end of the day.
examples.zh: 請在今天下班前把原型的照片寄給我。

confusable.diff: protocol 是「通訊協定／標準作業程序」，開頭拼法相似，但和產品試作品無關。

example.en: All staff must follow the safety protocol when entering the factory.
example.zh: 所有員工進入工廠時都必須遵守安全規範。

similar.diff: sample 通常是從已完成的產品或供應商拿到的樣品；prototype 是還在開發階段的試作品。

example.en: The supplier sent us a sample of the new fabric yesterday.
example.zh: 供應商昨天寄給我們新布料的樣品。

similar.diff: model 可以指模型或產品款式，不一定是試作品，語意比 prototype 廣。

example.en: This model is lighter than last year's version, but it costs more.
example.zh: 這個款式比去年的版本輕，但價格比較高。

example.en: The design of the new handle is simple and comfortable.
example.zh: 新把手的設計簡單又舒適。

example.en: The launch of the product is scheduled for early June.
example.zh: 產品預定在六月初上市。

example.en: Each part must meet the specification in the contract.
example.zh: 每個零件都必須符合合約中的規格。

derived.link: prototype + -ing，把「做原型」這個過程變成名詞，像 marketing、planning

items.tag: 大樓通道維修封閉與臨時停車安排備忘錄

level.why: 備忘錄以 After 引導的被動與 linking 分詞構句、which 非限定子句、although 讓步子句與多個被動結構，並需整合通道封閉期間、北側入口、僅限 Lot C 的費用吸收、許可證擺放與聯絡時限等資訊；干擾項多取自文中出現過的停車區、入口與費用細節，需精確區分。

items.passage:
MEMO TO ALL STAFF: Temporary Changes to Building Access and Parking

After water damage was discovered beneath the covered walkway linking the main office tower to the parking structure, the facilities department closed the passage, which is not expected to reopen for approximately three weeks. Until repairs are completed, employees arriving from the parking structure should use the north entrance, which has been staffed during peak hours to prevent congestion.

Because the lower levels of the structure will also be partly blocked, drivers are encouraged to park in Lot C, where ample space is available. The company will absorb the daily fee charged at that lot, although employees who park elsewhere will not be reimbursed. Temporary permits will be administered by the facilities office and must be displayed on the dashboard at all times.

Staff who regularly carry heavy equipment between buildings should contact the facilities office urgently, preferably before Friday, so that alternative arrangements can be made.
items.zh:
全體員工注意：大樓進出與停車的臨時調整

在主辦公大樓與停車場之間的有頂走道下方被發現有積水損壞後，設施部門已封閉該通道，預計大約三週內不會重新開放。在維修完成之前，從停車場進入的員工應使用北側入口，該入口在尖峰時段已派人駐守，以避免擁擠。

由於停車場的低樓層也將部分封閉，我們鼓勵駕駛人改停 C 停車區，那裡有充足的空位。公司將吸收該停車區的每日費用，不過停在其他地方的員工將無法獲得報銷。臨時停車許可證將由設施辦公室負責核發，且必須隨時放置在儀表板上。

經常在大樓之間搬運重型設備的員工，應盡快與設施辦公室聯絡，最好在週五之前，以便安排替代方案。

vocab.col: absorb the cost / absorb the impact

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the memo?
opts: To announce a permanent change in the company's parking policy
To explain temporary arrangements while a passage between buildings is repaired
To ask employees to volunteer for repair work on the parking structure
To report that a new parking structure will be built near the office tower
why: 文中只說明維修期間的暫時安排（預計約三週），並未提到永久性的停車政策變更。
正解：備忘錄說明走道因積水損壞而封閉，並交代維修期間的入口、停車與許可證等臨時安排。
文中沒有徵求志願者；員工只被要求改走北側入口、改停 C 停車區或聯絡設施辦公室。
停車場是既有設施，文中只提到其低樓層將被部分封閉，並未提到要興建新的停車場。

questions.q: According to the memo, what will the company do about parking costs?
opts: Pay for employees to use any nearby parking lot
Lower the price of permits for the lower levels of the structure
Provide a free shuttle from the north entrance to Lot C
Pay the daily fee only at Lot C
why: 文中明說停在其他地方的員工不會獲得報銷，因此並非任何附近停車區都由公司負擔。
文中沒有提到調降許可證價格；低樓層只是被部分封閉，並非降價。
文中並未提到接駁車；北側入口是給從停車場進入的員工使用的入口。
正解：公司只吸收 Lot C 的每日費用（absorb the daily fee charged at that lot），在其他地方停車者不予報銷。

questions.q: What can be inferred about the north entrance?
opts: It is likely to be crowded at certain times of the day.
It has been closed until the repairs are completed.
It was used only by visitors before the walkway closed.
It is the only entrance that staff carrying equipment may use.
why: 正解：該入口在尖峰時段已派人駐守以避免擁擠（to prevent congestion），可推論尖峰時段可能會很擁擠。
北側入口是替代入口，開放給員工使用；被封閉的是走道。
文中沒有說明該入口之前的使用對象，無法推論只有訪客使用。
文中只要求搬運設備的員工聯絡設施辦公室，並未限制他們只能使用北側入口。

questions.q: ______ the elevators are being serviced, staff on the upper floors should use the east stairwell.
why: Although 表示讓步，「儘管電梯在維修，員工仍應走樓梯」語意不合邏輯。
Despite 是介系詞，後面要接名詞或動名詞，不能接完整子句。
正解：While 是連接詞，引導子句，表示「在電梯維修期間」，語意通順且文法正確。
During 是介系詞，後面要接名詞，不能直接接 the elevators are being serviced 這個子句。

questions.q: Please report any ______ damaged equipment to the facilities office by the end of the day.
why: visible 是形容詞，不能修飾 damaged（形容詞用法的分詞）；此處需要副詞。
visibility 是名詞，不能放在 any 與 damaged 之間修飾 damaged。
vision 是名詞，語意與文法都不符。
正解：visibly 是副詞，修飾形容詞 damaged，表示「明顯受損的」設備。

questions.q: The renovation, ______ was originally scheduled to end in May, has been extended by two weeks.
why: 逗號之後的非限定子句不能使用 that 作關係代名詞。
正解：which 在逗號後引導非限定關係子句，指前面的 the renovation，並在子句中作主詞。
whose 表示所有格，後面要接名詞，此處語意與結構都不通。
what 是名詞子句的連接詞，不能在逗號後修飾前面的名詞 renovation。

extra_vocab.en: a path for people to walk along, often with a roof
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡，walkway 指連接辦公大樓與停車場的有頂通道，因為漏水損壞而暫時封閉。公告中常用 closed、blocked 來說明通道不能使用。

example.en: Both walkways will stay closed until the repairs are finished.
example.zh: 兩條通道在維修完成前都會保持封閉。

example.en: Use the covered walkway when it rains to stay dry.
example.zh: 下雨時請走有頂的通道，才不會淋濕。

example.en: A pedestrian walkway was built beside the new parking lot.
example.zh: 新停車場旁邊蓋了一條行人通道。

example.en: Please do not block the walkway with delivery carts.
example.zh: 請不要用送貨推車擋住通道。

examples.en: The walkway between the two buildings will be closed for repairs.
examples.zh: 兩棟大樓之間的通道將因維修而封閉。

examples.en: Please keep the walkway clear of boxes and other equipment.
examples.zh: 請讓通道保持暢通，不要堆放箱子和其他設備。

examples.en: Employees can reach the cafeteria through the covered walkway.
examples.zh: 員工可以經由有頂的通道前往自助餐廳。

confusable.diff: sidewalk 是街道旁的人行道；walkway 是建築物之間或園區內的通道。

example.en: Visitors should stay on the sidewalk outside the main entrance.
example.zh: 訪客請留在主要入口外面的人行道上。

confusable.diff: 兩個字都是複合字，但 crosswalk 是馬路上的斑馬線，walkway 是建築物之間的通道。

example.en: The crosswalk in front of the office has new safety lights.
example.zh: 辦公室前的斑馬線裝了新的安全燈。

similar.diff: corridor 指建築物內部的長走廊；walkway 可以在室外，也可以有頂棚。

example.en: The corridor on the third floor leads to the meeting rooms.
example.zh: 三樓的走廊通往各個會議室。

similar.diff: passage 通常比較窄，可指室內外通道，語氣中性；文章裡的 passage 就是同一個意思。

example.en: The narrow passage behind the lobby is for staff only.
example.zh: 大廳後方的狹窄通道僅限員工使用。

example.en: A short path leads from the gate to the main entrance.
example.zh: 一條短路從大門通往主要入口。

example.en: The north entrance opens at seven o'clock every morning.
example.zh: 北側入口每天早上七點開放。

example.en: Please use the stairway if the elevator is out of service.
example.zh: 電梯停用時，請使用樓梯間。

extra_vocab.en: more than enough
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡，ample space 指 C 停車場的車位很充裕，足夠停放，語氣正面，常用來保證「不用擔心不夠」。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: ample 通常修飾不可數名詞或複數名詞，如 ample space、ample opportunities；本身已有「很夠」的意思，不加 very，要加強可用 more than ample。

example.en: The new parking lot is ampler than the old one.
example.zh: 新的停車場比舊的更寬裕。

example.en: Lot C offers the amplest space of all the lots.
example.zh: 所有停車場中，C 停車場的空間最充裕。

example.en: The budget amply covers the cost of the new equipment.
example.zh: 這筆預算足以充分支付新設備的費用。

example.en: The new warehouse has ample space for all our stock.
example.zh: 新倉庫有充裕的空間可放所有庫存。

example.en: Please arrive early to leave ample time for security checks.
example.zh: 請提早抵達，留下充足的時間做安檢。

example.en: Staff will have ample opportunity to ask questions after the talk.
example.zh: 演講後，員工有充分的機會提問。

example.en: The hotel offers ample parking for guests and visitors.
example.zh: 飯店為住客與訪客提供充足的停車位。

examples.en: We have ample time to review the budget before noon.
examples.zh: 中午前我們有充足的時間檢視預算。

examples.en: The supplier keeps ample stock, so orders ship quickly.
examples.zh: 供應商庫存充足，所以訂單出貨很快。

examples.en: The conference center provides ample seating for all guests.
examples.zh: 會議中心為所有賓客提供充足的座位。

confusable.diff: 拼法與發音相近，但 example 是名詞「例子」，ample 是形容詞「充足的」。
confusable.usage: ample 是形容詞，放在名詞前；example 是名詞，常見 for example。

example.en: Please give an example of a successful marketing plan.
example.zh: 請舉一個成功行銷計畫的例子。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近，但 sample 是名詞「樣品」，ample 是形容詞「充足的」。
confusable.usage: sample 是名詞（也可當動詞「試用」），ample 只能當形容詞。

example.en: The supplier will send a free sample of the new fabric.
example.zh: 供應商會寄來新布料的免費樣品。

similar.diff: sufficient 較正式，強調剛好夠用；ample 強調綽綽有餘。

example.en: The budget is sufficient to cover all travel costs.
example.zh: 這筆預算足以支付所有差旅費用。

similar.diff: plenty of 較口語，後面直接接名詞；ample 是形容詞，放在名詞前。

example.en: There is plenty of room in the conference hall.
example.zh: 會議廳裡有很多空間。

example.en: The spacious meeting room can hold fifty people.
example.zh: 這間寬敞的會議室可容納五十人。

example.en: We have adequate funds to start the project next month.
example.zh: 我們有足夠的資金，下個月就能開始這個專案。

example.en: The company offers a generous benefits package to new staff.
example.zh: 公司提供新進員工豐厚的福利方案。

derived.link: ample + -ify（使成為），像 simplify、clarify，使變大、變強

extra_vocab.en: to take something in; here, to pay a cost so that someone else does not have to
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡，absorb the daily fee 是公司負擔每日停車費，員工不用自己付。這是 absorb 在商務上很常見的意思：自行吸收成本，不轉嫁給別人。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: absorb 當「吸收、承擔」是及物動詞，後面直接接受詞，如 absorb the cost；「全神貫注於」要用被動 be absorbed in。

example.en: The supplier absorbs the shipping cost on every bulk order.
example.zh: 供應商負擔每一筆大宗訂單的運費。

example.en: The firm absorbed the extra costs instead of raising its prices.
example.zh: 公司自行吸收了額外成本，而沒有調漲價格。

example.en: Absorbing the fee will cost the company about two thousand dollars.
example.zh: 負擔這筆費用會讓公司花掉大約兩千美元。

example.en: The company will absorb the cost of the extra training.
example.zh: 公司將負擔額外培訓的費用。

example.en: Thick padding helps absorb the impact during shipping.
example.zh: 厚墊料能在運送過程中吸收衝擊。

example.en: Interns absorb information quickly when they shadow experienced staff.
example.zh: 實習生跟著資深員工做事時，吸收資訊很快。

examples.en: The supplier agreed to absorb the price increase this quarter.
examples.zh: 供應商同意本季自行吸收漲價的部分。

examples.en: The store will absorb the repair fee for damaged items.
examples.zh: 商店會負擔受損商品的維修費。

examples.en: Trainees absorb new skills faster with hands-on practice.
examples.zh: 學員透過實際操作能更快吸收新技能。

confusable.diff: 拼法與字首相近，但 observe 是「觀察、遵守」，absorb 是「吸收、承擔」。

example.en: All staff must observe the safety rules in the warehouse.
example.zh: 所有員工都必須遵守倉庫的安全規定。

similar.diff: bear 較中性，指承擔責任由誰負擔；absorb 強調自行吸收，不轉嫁給別人。

example.en: The client will bear the cost of any design changes.
example.zh: 客戶將負擔任何設計變更的費用。

similar.diff: cover 是「支付」費用，不一定帶有損失的意味。

example.en: The grant will cover the cost of the new equipment.
example.zh: 這筆補助金會支付新設備的費用。

example.en: The total cost of the project is lower than expected.
example.zh: 這個專案的總成本比預期低。

example.en: There is no extra fee for changing your reservation.
example.zh: 更改訂位不需另外收費。

example.en: Travel expenses must be approved by your manager first.
example.zh: 差旅開銷必須先經主管核准。

derived.link: absorb + -ent（具有…性質的），能吸收的
absorb 的 b 變成 p，再加 -tion，像 subscribe → subscription

senses.en: to pay a cost so that someone else does not have to

example.en: We will absorb the shipping cost for all online orders.
example.zh: 所有網路訂單的運費由我們負擔。

senses.en: to take in a liquid, heat, or force
senses.distinguish: 受詞是水、熱或力量等物質時，是物理上的「吸收」。

example.en: These mats absorb water and keep the entrance floor dry.
example.zh: 這些地墊會吸水，讓入口地板保持乾燥。

senses.en: to learn and understand new information
senses.distinguish: 受詞是資訊或知識時，指學習、消化。

example.en: New employees must absorb a lot of information in the first week.
example.zh: 新進員工第一週必須吸收大量資訊。

extra_vocab.en: to manage or carry out a program, rule, or system
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡，permits will be administered by the facilities office，指臨時停車證由總務處負責發放與管理。用被動語態強調「由誰負責」，語氣正式。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: administer 的受詞通常是制度、計畫、測驗或藥物，不是人；管理員工要用 manage。被動常寫成 be administered by + 單位。

example.en: The finance office administers all travel budgets for the sales team.
example.zh: 財務部門負責管理業務團隊所有的差旅預算。

example.en: The final exam was administered by the training department.
example.zh: 期末測驗由訓練部門負責施行。

example.en: Administering the new policy will take careful planning and clear rules.
example.zh: 執行這項新政策需要縝密的規畫和明確的規則。

example.en: The local office administers a program for small businesses.
example.zh: 當地辦公室負責執行一項小型企業的計畫。

example.en: Interviewers will administer a short test to each applicant.
example.zh: 面試官會對每位應徵者施行一份簡短測驗。

example.en: A committee will administer the funds for the new project.
example.zh: 一個委員會將管理新專案的資金。

example.en: Only trained staff may administer medication to patients.
example.zh: 只有受過訓練的人員才能給病患用藥。

examples.en: Our payroll team administers salaries for all regional offices.
examples.zh: 我們的薪資團隊負責處理所有區域辦公室的薪資。

examples.en: The new refund policy is administered by customer service.
examples.zh: 新的退款政策由客服部門負責執行。

examples.en: Entry permits are administered by the security desk.
examples.zh: 入場許可證由保全櫃檯負責管理。

similar.diff: manage 更通用，可以管人也可以管事；administer 偏重制度、計畫與程序的執行。

example.en: She manages the daily operations of the branch office.
example.zh: 她負責管理分公司的日常營運。

similar.diff: oversee 強調從上而下監督、掌握全局；administer 強調實際負責執行與管理。

example.en: A senior director will oversee the new hiring process.
example.zh: 一位資深主管將監督新的招募流程。

example.en: You need a permit to park in the staff lot.
example.zh: 你需要許可證才能停在員工停車場。

example.en: Two managers supervise the entire inventory count.
example.zh: 兩位經理負責監督整個庫存盤點。

example.en: Please follow the standard procedure for filing complaints.
example.zh: 請依標準程序提出客訴。

derived.link: administer + -ation，把「管理」變成名詞，像 organize → organization
administrat- + -or，做事的人，像 operator、creator
administrat- + -ive（形容詞），像 creative、active

senses.en: to manage or be in charge of a system or program

example.en: The HR department administers the company's training program.
example.zh: 人資部門負責執行公司的培訓計畫。

senses.en: to give a test or a medicine to someone
senses.distinguish: 受詞是測驗或藥物，對象是人時，指「給予」。

example.en: A nurse will administer the flu vaccine to staff.
example.zh: 護理師會為員工施打流感疫苗。

extra_vocab.en: to pay someone back for money they spent
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡，not be reimbursed 是指員工在其他停車場自行停車的費用，公司不會補貼。reimburse 是報帳、核銷的常用字，語氣正式。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: reimburse 的句型是 reimburse + 人 + for + 費用（不是 reimburse + 費用 + to + 人）；被動為 be reimbursed for + 費用。

example.en: The company reimburses employees for approved travel costs within two weeks.
example.zh: 公司會在兩週內核銷員工經核准的差旅費用。

example.en: I was reimbursed for the hotel bill last Friday.
example.zh: 我的飯店費用上週五已經核銷了。

example.en: Reimbursing every expense claim takes the finance team several days.
example.zh: 核銷每一筆費用申請，財務團隊要花好幾天。

example.en: The company will reimburse all reasonable travel expenses.
example.zh: 公司會核銷所有合理的差旅費用。

example.en: Employees can be reimbursed for meals during business trips.
example.zh: 員工出差期間的餐費可以申請核銷。

example.en: We will reimburse you in full if the item is faulty.
example.zh: 如果商品有瑕疵，我們會全額退還給你。

examples.en: Please attach receipts so we can reimburse you quickly.
examples.zh: 請附上收據，我們才能快速為你核銷。

examples.en: The firm reimbursed me for my flight to Chicago.
examples.zh: 公司已補償我飛往芝加哥的機票費用。

examples.en: The program reimburses staff for approved training courses.
examples.zh: 這項方案會補助員工經核准的培訓課程費用。

confusable.diff: compensate 是補償損失或損害，也可指給薪酬；reimburse 是把你先墊的錢還給你。

example.en: The airline will compensate passengers for the long flight delay.
example.zh: 航空公司會就航班長時間延誤補償乘客。

similar.diff: refund 通常是顧客買東西後拿回錢；reimburse 是公司把員工先墊的費用還給員工。

example.en: Customers can request a refund within thirty days of purchase.
example.zh: 顧客可在購買後三十天內申請退款。

similar.diff: pay back 較口語，可用在朋友或同事之間；reimburse 較正式，用在公司報帳。

example.en: I will pay you back for the taxi on Friday.
example.zh: 星期五我會把計程車費還給你。

example.en: All business expenses must be reported by the fifth.
example.zh: 所有業務開銷必須在五號前申報。

example.en: Keep every receipt when you travel for work.
example.zh: 出差時請保留每一張收據。

example.en: Submit your expense claim before the end of the month.
example.zh: 請在月底前提交你的費用申請。

derived.link: reimburse + -ment，把動作變成名詞，像 payment、agreement

extra_vocab.en: in a way that needs quick action right away
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇備忘錄裡，urgently 修飾 contact，提醒需要搬運重型設備的員工要盡快聯絡總務處；後面的 preferably before Friday 再把「盡快」具體化成期限。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: urgently 是副詞，修飾動詞，通常放在動詞片語後面（contact the office urgently）；要修飾名詞時用形容詞 urgent（an urgent request）。

example.en: The delivery problem is more urgent than the website update.
example.zh: 出貨問題比網站更新更緊急。

example.en: Fixing the broken server is our most urgent task this week.
example.zh: 修復故障的伺服器是我們本週最緊急的任務。

example.en: We urgently need a larger storage room for the new equipment.
example.zh: 我們迫切需要更大的儲藏室來放新設備。

example.en: The board must act urgently to prevent further losses.
example.zh: 董事會必須緊急採取行動，以防止更多損失。

example.en: Several customers urgently request a faster refund process this month.
example.zh: 本月有數位顧客緊急要求更快的退款流程。

examples.en: Please reply urgently if you cannot attend the safety briefing.
examples.zh: 如果你無法參加安全說明會，請盡快回覆。

examples.en: The manager asked us to fix the server problem urgently.
examples.zh: 經理要求我們緊急修復伺服器的問題。

examples.en: Employees should report any damage urgently to the facilities office.
examples.zh: 員工應立即向總務處回報任何損壞。

confusable.diff: important 強調「重要」，不一定要馬上處理；urgent／urgently 強調「時間緊迫」。

example.en: This report is important, but it can wait until next week.
example.zh: 這份報告很重要，但可以等到下週再處理。

similar.diff: immediately 是「立刻、馬上」，語氣更強、沒有緩衝時間；urgently 強調事情緊急、需要快速處理。

example.en: Please call the client immediately after the meeting ends.
example.zh: 會議一結束，請立刻打電話給客戶。

similar.diff: as soon as possible 是「越快越好」，語氣較客氣、較常用在請求；urgently 更強調情況緊急。

example.en: Please send the signed contract as soon as possible, preferably today.
example.zh: 請盡快寄回簽好的合約，最好今天。

example.en: Safety is our top priority during the repair work.
example.zh: 維修期間，安全是我們的首要考量。

example.en: The deadline for the budget report is next Friday.
example.zh: 預算報告的截止日是下週五。

example.en: We had to rush the order to meet the shipping date.
example.zh: 我們得趕這張訂單，才能趕上出貨日。

derived.link: urge 是詞幹，「用力催」；加上 -ent 就變成形容詞 urgent「緊急的」
urgent 把 t 換成 -cy，變成名詞，像 agent → agency

example.en: The client urgently needs a revised quote before noon.
example.zh: 客戶在中午前迫切需要一份修正後的報價。

example.en: We received an urgent request from the head office this morning.
example.zh: 今天早上我們收到總公司的緊急要求。

items.tag: 醫療客戶巡迴拜訪的公務租車與山路行車須知

level.why: 電子郵件使用 Having compared 的完成式分詞構句、which 非限定子句、Because 原因子句、unless 條件子句與 Should 開頭的倒裝條件句，並需整合異地還車免費、里程不限但燃料與停車自付、週四七點前出發及道路封閉時的通報流程；干擾項多取自文中出現過的 drop-off fee、mileage 與紙本地圖等細節，需精確區分。

items.passage:
To: Regional Sales Team
Subject: Rental Vehicles for the Healthcare Client Tour

Having compared several quotations, the travel office has reserved mid-size sedans for next week's tour of healthcare clients from an agency with a nationwide network of branches, which allows you to return a vehicle in any tour city without paying a drop-off fee. Mileage is unlimited, but drivers are responsible for fuel and for any parking charges incurred at client sites.

Because the mountain road between Asheville and Knoxville can become hazardous in heavy rain, we recommend leaving no later than 7:00 A.M. on Thursday unless the weather service advises otherwise. A paper map may prove handy if your navigation app loses its signal. Should the road be closed, please notify the travel office immediately so that your hotel booking can be adjusted accordingly.
items.zh:
收件人：區域業務團隊
主旨：醫療保健客戶巡迴拜訪的租車安排

比較過數份報價之後，差旅辦公室已向一家在全國設有分店網絡的租車公司，為下週拜訪醫療保健客戶的行程預訂了中型轎車，這讓您可以在巡迴行程中的任何城市還車，而不必支付異地還車費。里程數不限，但駕駛須自行負擔燃料費，以及在客戶地點產生的任何停車費用。

由於阿什維爾與諾克斯維爾之間的山路在大雨中可能變得危險，我們建議週四最晚上午七點出發，除非氣象單位另有建議。若導航應用程式收不到訊號，紙本地圖可能會派上用場。萬一道路封閉，請立即通知差旅辦公室，以便相應調整您的飯店訂房。

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the email?
opts: To compare the prices of several rental agencies
To announce a change to the tour schedule
To explain rental car arrangements and driving advice for a client tour
To ask employees to approve a travel budget
why: 報價已由差旅辦公室比較完畢（Having compared several quotations），信件目的不是比較價格。
文中沒有提到行程表有變動，只說明租車與行車建議。
正解：信件交代租車安排（車型、還車、費用負擔）與山路行車建議，主旨是租車與行車的相關說明。
文中沒有要求員工核准預算，只是通知已完成的安排。

questions.q: According to the email, what are drivers responsible for paying?
opts: Fuel and parking charges at client sites
A fee for returning the car in another city
Extra charges for each mile driven
why: 正解：drivers are responsible for fuel and for any parking charges incurred at client sites，即燃料費與客戶地點的停車費。
文中明說可在任一巡迴城市還車而不必付 drop-off fee，所以異地還車費不需支付。
文中說 Mileage is unlimited，里程不限，因此沒有按里程加收費用。
文中沒有提到保險費用，這是未被提及的資訊。

questions.q: What should drivers do if the mountain road is closed?
opts: Use a paper map to find another route to the client sites
Leave the hotel no later than 7:00 A.M. on Thursday
Return the vehicle to the nearest branch without paying a fee
Tell the travel office so their hotel booking can be adjusted
why: 紙本地圖是用於導航應用程式沒有訊號時，並不是道路封閉時的指示。
7:00 A.M. 是建議出發時間，與道路封閉時該採取的行動無關。
免費還車是指在巡迴城市中還車，與道路封閉無關，文中也沒有這項指示。
正解：Should the road be closed 之後，要求立即通知差旅辦公室，以便調整飯店訂房。

questions.q: Passengers ______ flights are canceled because of severe weather will be rebooked at no extra charge.
why: who 是主格關係代名詞，後面不能直接接 flights are canceled 這種含名詞的子句。
正解：whose 表示所有格，Passengers whose flights 意為「班機被取消的乘客」，文法與語意皆正確。
which 用於指物，不能修飾 passengers（指人）。
whom 是受格，後面通常接主詞加動詞，句型不符。

questions.q: The restaurant's new menu has been ______ received by business travelers visiting the downtown area.
why: 正解：favorably 是副詞，放在 has been 與 received 之間修飾過去分詞，表示「受到好評地被接受」。
favorable 是形容詞，不能修飾動詞形式 received。
favor 是名詞或動詞，放在此處詞性與語意都不通。
favorite 是名詞或形容詞，放在此處詞性與語意都不通。

questions.q: Travelers should confirm their reservations at least 24 hours ______ departure.
why: ahead 後面需接 of 才能引導名詞，單獨使用不能直接接 departure。
while 是連接詞，後面要接子句，不能直接接名詞 departure。
正解：prior to 是介系詞片語，意為「在…之前」，at least 24 hours prior to departure 是常見用法。
since 表示「自從」，不能用來表示出發前的時間點。

extra_vocab.en: in or across the whole country
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡，a nationwide network of branches 指租車公司在全國都有分公司，所以可以異地還車而不用付費。形容詞放名詞前，說明服務範圍遍及全國。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: nationwide 可當形容詞（放名詞前）也可當副詞（放動詞後）；當副詞時直接接在動詞或受詞後面，不需要介系詞，不寫 in nationwide。

example.en: The courier has a nationwide network of delivery centers.
example.zh: 這家快遞公司擁有全國性的配送中心網絡。

example.en: Our supplier is a nationwide chain of building materials stores.
example.zh: 我們的供應商是全國連鎖的建材店。

example.en: The company launched a nationwide campaign for its new product.
example.zh: 公司為新產品展開了全國性的宣傳活動。

example.en: We can ship your order nationwide within three business days.
example.zh: 我們可以在三個工作天內把您的訂單配送到全國各地。

examples.en: The new phone will be available in stores nationwide next month.
examples.zh: 這款新手機下個月會在全國各地的商店上市。

examples.en: Our nationwide search for a new manager ends this week.
examples.zh: 我們在全國尋找新經理的工作本週結束。

examples.en: The courier offers nationwide delivery at one flat rate.
examples.zh: 這家快遞提供全國統一價格的配送服務。

confusable.diff: worldwide 是遍及全世界；nationwide 只涵蓋一個國家。

example.en: Our software is now used by customers in offices worldwide.
example.zh: 我們的軟體現在全世界各地的辦公室都在使用。

confusable.diff: citywide 是全市範圍；nationwide 是全國範圍。

example.en: A citywide ban on parking will begin on Monday morning.
example.zh: 全市禁止停車的規定將從星期一早上開始。

similar.diff: 是片語，常放在句尾或名詞後面；nationwide 是單字，可放名詞前。

example.en: Our stores across the country will close early on Friday.
example.zh: 我們全國各地的門市星期五將提早打烊。

similar.diff: national 是「國家的、全國性的」，也可指代表國家；nationwide 強調範圍遍及全國。

example.en: The company won a national award for customer service.
example.zh: 這家公司獲得全國客戶服務獎。

example.en: The bank has a large network of branches in the north.
example.zh: 這家銀行在北部有龐大的分行網絡。

example.en: The new branch will open in the city center in June.
example.zh: 新分公司六月會在市中心開幕。

example.en: The regional manager visits each store once a month.
example.zh: 區域經理每個月拜訪每家店一次。

derived.link: nation + -al（形容詞），像 final、personal
national + -ly（副詞），像 quickly、clearly
nation + -ality（名詞），表示隸屬的國家，像 reality
inter-（之間）+ national，國與國之間的，像 internet

example.en: The airline runs a nationwide sale on domestic tickets.
example.zh: 這家航空公司舉辦全國性的國內機票促銷。

example.en: The new product will be sold nationwide starting in May.
example.zh: 新產品從五月開始在全國各地販售。

extra_vocab.en: dangerous or likely to cause harm
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡，hazardous 形容山路在大雨中可能變得危險，用來提醒員工提早出發。這個字比 dangerous 更正式，常用在安全公告。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: hazardous 後面接 to + 名詞，表示「對…有危險」，如 hazardous to your health。

example.en: Drivers should avoid travel in hazardous conditions.
example.zh: 駕駛應避免在危險的狀況下行車。

example.en: Hazardous materials must be stored in a locked room.
example.zh: 危險物品必須存放在上鎖的房間裡。

example.en: The factory pays a company to remove hazardous waste.
example.zh: 工廠付費請公司清除有害廢棄物。

example.en: Some cleaning products are hazardous to your health.
example.zh: 有些清潔產品對你的健康有害。

examples.en: Wet floors can be hazardous, so please walk carefully.
examples.zh: 濕滑的地板可能很危險，所以請小心行走。

examples.en: Heavy snow made the highway hazardous for early commuters.
examples.zh: 大雪讓公路對早起的通勤者變得危險。

examples.en: Workers must wear gloves when handling hazardous chemicals.
examples.zh: 員工處理危險化學品時必須戴手套。

confusable.diff: hazard 是名詞，指危險因素；hazardous 是形容詞，指危險的。
confusable.usage: hazard 是名詞，常見 a safety hazard、a hazard to；hazardous 是形容詞，修飾名詞或接在 be 後面。

example.en: Loose cables in the hallway are a serious safety hazard.
example.zh: 走廊上鬆脫的電線是嚴重的安全隱患。

similar.diff: dangerous 日常通用；hazardous 較正式，常見於安全公告與書面規定。

example.en: It is dangerous to drive in thick fog at night.
example.zh: 在濃霧中夜間開車很危險。

similar.diff: risky 指有風險、可能失敗；hazardous 指可能造成傷害。

example.en: Investing all our money in one project is risky.
example.zh: 把所有資金投入單一專案很冒險。

example.en: The risk of delay increases during the rainy season.
example.zh: 雨季期間延誤的風險會升高。

example.en: Safety is our first concern on every construction site.
example.zh: 在每個工地，安全都是我們最優先的考量。

example.en: Please use caution when driving on the mountain road.
example.zh: 行駛山路時請小心謹慎。

derived.link: hazardous 去掉 -ous 就是名詞 hazard，像 danger → dangerous

extra_vocab.en: easy to use, or useful
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡，prove handy 意思是「證明很有用」，指紙本地圖在手機導航沒訊號時能派上用場。語氣輕鬆實用，常用在提醒或建議。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: keep + 物品 + handy 表示把…放在手邊；come in handy 是「派上用場」，handy 在這裡是形容詞，不加 -ly。

example.en: A tablet is handier than a laptop on short client visits.
example.zh: 短程拜訪客戶時，平板比筆電更方便。

example.en: The shortcut key is the handiest feature of this software.
example.zh: 快捷鍵是這套軟體最方便的功能。

example.en: The new app handily tracks all your mileage and fuel receipts.
example.zh: 這個新應用程式能方便地記錄你所有的里程與油資收據。

example.en: A spare charger can come in handy on a long trip.
example.zh: 備用充電器在長途旅行時可能派上用場。

example.en: This handy tool helps you sort e-mails quickly.
example.zh: 這個好用的工具能幫你快速整理電子郵件。

example.en: Please keep your ID card handy at the security gate.
example.zh: 在安檢門前請把證件放在手邊。

example.en: The handy guide lists all hotels near the venue.
example.zh: 這份實用指南列出會場附近的所有飯店。

examples.en: A small umbrella is handy during the rainy season.
examples.zh: 雨季期間，一把小雨傘很好用。

examples.en: The new software is handy for tracking customer orders.
examples.zh: 這套新軟體很方便用來追蹤客戶訂單。

examples.en: The hotline number is handy if you need quick help.
examples.zh: 如果你需要快速協助，服務專線的號碼很方便。

confusable.diff: handle 是動詞，意思是「處理」；handy 是形容詞，意思是「方便的」。
confusable.usage: handle 是動詞（也可當名詞「把手」），後面可接受詞；handy 是形容詞，不能接受詞。

example.en: Our team can handle large orders without any delay.
example.zh: 我們的團隊可以處理大量訂單而不延誤。

similar.diff: useful 通用，也可用在抽象的事物；handy 較口語，強調隨手可用。

example.en: The report contains useful data for planning.
example.zh: 這份報告含有對規畫很有用的資料。

similar.diff: convenient 強調省時省力，常用來形容位置或安排；handy 較口語，強調隨手可用。

example.en: The office is in a convenient location near the station.
example.zh: 辦公室位在靠近車站的便利地點。

example.en: The training offers practical advice for new managers.
example.zh: 這項培訓為新任經理提供實用的建議。

example.en: A portable printer is useful for client visits.
example.zh: 拜訪客戶時，可攜式印表機很有用。

senses.en: useful and easy to use

example.en: This pocket guide is handy for first-time visitors.
example.zh: 這本口袋指南對第一次來的訪客很方便。

senses.zh: 近在手邊的、位置方便的
senses.en: close and easy to reach
senses.distinguish: 常接 for + 地點，指位置方便。

example.en: The hotel is handy for the airport and the train station.
example.zh: 這間飯店離機場和火車站都很近。

senses.en: good at using tools or doing small jobs
senses.distinguish: 常用 be handy with + 工具，形容人。

example.en: Our maintenance staff are handy with electrical tools.
example.zh: 我們的維修人員很會使用電動工具。

extra_vocab.en: the services and care that keep people healthy
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇的標題裡，healthcare 放在 client 前面當形容詞用，healthcare clients 指醫療產業的客戶。這是名詞直接修飾名詞的常見用法。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: healthcare 是不可數名詞，不加 s；放在名詞前面可直接修飾，如 healthcare workers。也可以寫成兩個字 health care。

example.en: The hospital is the largest healthcare provider in the region.
example.zh: 這間醫院是當地最大的醫療服務提供者。

example.en: She has worked in the healthcare industry for ten years.
example.zh: 她在醫療產業工作了十年。

example.en: Rising healthcare costs are a major concern for many small companies.
example.zh: 醫療費用上漲是許多小公司主要的擔憂。

example.en: Only a licensed healthcare professional may give medical advice.
example.zh: 只有持有執照的醫療專業人員才能提供醫療建議。

examples.en: Our company offers full healthcare coverage to all employees.
examples.zh: 我們公司提供所有員工完整的醫療保障。

examples.en: She sells medical software to healthcare clients across the country.
examples.zh: 她向全國的醫療客戶銷售醫療軟體。

examples.en: The government plans to spend more on healthcare next year.
examples.zh: 政府計畫明年在醫療保健上投入更多經費。

confusable.diff: health insurance 是付醫療費用的保險制度；healthcare 是醫療服務本身。

example.en: Health insurance pays part of the bill for your hospital stay.
example.zh: 健康保險會支付你住院費用的一部分。

similar.diff: 意思相同，只是寫成兩個字；當名詞修飾名詞時，常見寫成 healthcare 一個字。

example.en: The new law will improve health care for rural families.
example.zh: 這項新法律將改善鄉村家庭的醫療保健。

similar.diff: medical care 偏指診療照護；healthcare 範圍更廣，包含預防保健與整個產業。

example.en: Visitors can receive medical care at the airport clinic.
example.zh: 旅客可以在機場診所接受醫療照護。

example.en: All staff must complete a medical check every year.
example.zh: 所有員工每年都必須完成健康檢查。

example.en: The company runs a small clinic on the ground floor.
example.zh: 公司在一樓設有一間小診所。

example.en: Each patient receives a reminder before the appointment.
example.zh: 每位病人在預約前都會收到提醒。

derived.link: health + -y（形容詞），像 rainy、sunny，有健康的
un-（不）+ healthy，像 unhappy、unable

extra_vocab.en: the number of miles a vehicle has traveled
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡，Mileage is unlimited 指租車不限行駛里程，不會因為跑得多而加收費用。租車合約中常見，常和 fuel、parking 一起說明費用由誰負責。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: mileage 是不可數名詞，不加 s，也不說 a mileage；形容里程多寡用 low mileage、high mileage。

example.en: Most rental companies offer unlimited mileage on weekly rates.
example.zh: 多數租車公司的週租方案提供不限里程。

example.en: This used van has low mileage and a full service record.
example.zh: 這輛二手廂型車里程數低，保養紀錄完整。

example.en: Smaller cars usually have better gas mileage in the city.
example.zh: 小型車在市區通常有比較好的油耗表現。

example.en: Mileage reimbursement is paid at the end of each month.
example.zh: 里程津貼在每個月底發放。

examples.en: The rental fee includes full insurance and unlimited mileage for a week.
examples.zh: 租車費用包含全額保險與一週不限里程。

examples.en: Please record your mileage in the travel log every day.
examples.zh: 請每天把你的里程數記錄在行車日誌裡。

examples.en: We chose the hybrid model because of its excellent mileage.
examples.zh: 我們選擇油電混合車款，是因為它的油耗表現很好。

confusable.diff: distance 是兩地之間的距離；mileage 是車子累計行駛了多少，或和里程有關的費用。

example.en: The distance between the two offices is about ten kilometers.
example.zh: 兩間辦公室之間的距離大約十公里。

example.en: The driver is responsible for fuel during the rental period.
example.zh: 租車期間，燃料由駕駛負責。

example.en: The distance from the airport to the hotel is short.
example.zh: 從機場到飯店的距離很短。

senses.en: the number of miles a vehicle has traveled

example.en: The car's mileage is already over eighty thousand miles.
example.zh: 這輛車的里程數已經超過八萬英里。

senses.zh: 油耗（每單位油量的行駛距離）
senses.en: how far a vehicle can go on a certain amount of fuel
senses.distinguish: 常見 gas mileage、good mileage，指車子省不省油。

example.en: This hybrid truck gets excellent mileage on long trips.
example.zh: 這輛油電混合貨車在長途行駛時油耗表現極佳。

senses.en: money paid to an employee for using a personal car for work
senses.distinguish: 常和 pay、reimburse 一起出現，指公司給的錢。

example.en: The company pays mileage when staff use their own cars.
example.zh: 員工使用自己的車辦公時，公司會支付里程津貼。

items.tag: 管理職培訓工作坊報名與導師配對語音通知

level.why: 語音公告使用 which 非限定子句、Since 原因子句、because 子句、被動語態與 who 關係子句，並需整合活動地點與時間、報名截止、攜帶作品集、導師依經驗配對與候補名單等資訊；干擾項多取自文中出現過的 statistics、報名與部門等細節，需精確區分。

items.passage:
Good afternoon, everyone. This is Karen Lopez from Human Resources with an announcement about the career development workshop for staff who hope to move into management. The session will be held in the auditorium, which was remodeled last spring, at ten o'clock next Thursday morning. Since seating is limited, please register through the Human Resources portal before Monday.

Participants are asked to bring a portfolio that outlines their major projects, because each of them will be paired with a mentor according to their experience. Statistics from last year's program showed that employees who completed the workshop were far more likely to be promoted within two years.

If you cannot attend, please contact me directly, and I will place you on the waiting list for the next session.
items.zh:
各位午安，我是人力資源部的凱倫．羅培茲，要向大家宣布針對有意晉升管理職的員工所舉辦的職涯發展工作坊。這場課程將於下週四上午十點在禮堂舉行，該禮堂去年春天剛重新整修過。由於座位有限，請在週一之前透過人力資源入口網站報名。

參加者請攜帶一份概述自己主要專案的作品集，因為每位參加者都會依照自身經驗與一位導師配對。去年課程的統計數據顯示，完成這場工作坊的員工在兩年內獲得晉升的可能性高出許多。

如果您無法出席，請直接與我聯絡，我會將您列入下一場課程的候補名單。

vocab.col: remodel the lobby / remodel an office

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the announcement?
opts: To report this year's promotion statistics to employees
To tell interested staff about an upcoming management workshop
To announce the reopening of the remodeled auditorium
To ask experienced managers to volunteer as mentors
why: promotion statistics 只是用來說明去年課程成效的佐證，並非公告的主要目的。
正解：公告說明為有意晉升管理職的員工舉辦的職涯發展工作坊，包含時間、地點、報名與準備事項。
禮堂只是活動地點，文中提到它去年春天重新整修，但公告並非為了宣布重新開放。
文中是每位參加者會被配對一位導師，並沒有徵求經理自願擔任導師。

questions.q: What are participants asked to bring to the workshop?
opts: A list of the mentors they would prefer
A document that outlines their major projects
why: 文中說導師是依經驗配對，沒有要求參加者列出偏好的導師。
statistics 是講者引用去年課程的結果，並不是要求參加者攜帶的資料。
報名是透過入口網站完成，文中沒有要求攜帶報名確認。
正解：參加者須攜帶 a portfolio that outlines their major projects，也就是概述主要專案的作品集。

questions.q: According to the speaker, how will mentors be assigned?
opts: By drawing names at the workshop
In the order in which people register
why: 正解：each of them will be paired with a mentor according to their experience，也就是依經驗配對。
文中沒有提到抽籤，這是文中未出現的資訊。
文中沒有以部門作為配對依據，部門並未被提及。
報名順序只和座位有限、須在週一前報名有關，與導師配對的方式無關。

questions.q: Ms. Chen was promoted to senior manager in ______ of her outstanding sales record.
why: recognize 是動詞原形，放在介系詞 in 之後不符合文法。
recognizable 是形容詞，意為「可辨認的」，語意與文法都不符。
正解：in recognition of 是固定用法，意為「為了表彰…」，recognition 是名詞，放在 in 之後並接 of。
recognizing 是動名詞或現在分詞，無法與 in…of 組成這個片語。

questions.q: The company offers tuition support to employees who wish to ______ their professional skills.
why: reserve 意為「預訂、保留」，不能搭配 skills 表示提升。
正解：enhance 意為「提升、增進」，enhance professional skills 是常見搭配。
conclude 意為「結束、斷定」，與 skills 搭配語意不通。
postpone 意為「延後」，與 skills 搭配語意不通。

questions.q: Employees will be eligible for the annual bonus ______ they remain with the company until the end of the year.
why: unless 表示「除非」，會讓句意變成「除非留下，否則有資格」，邏輯不通。
although 表示讓步，「儘管留在公司」與領獎金的條件關係不符。
so that 表示目的，不能表示留任是獲得資格的條件。
正解：as long as 意為「只要」，引導條件子句，表示只要留任到年底就有資格領取獎金。

extra_vocab.en: a collection of work that shows what a person has done
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡，portfolio 是參加者要帶的作品資料，整理自己做過的重要專案，讓主辦單位據此配對導師。語感偏專業，不是單純的履歷。

example.en: Applicants brought portfolios showing their best projects to the interview.
example.zh: 應徵者帶著展示最佳專案的作品集來面試。

example.en: Designers build a portfolio to show clients their skills.
example.zh: 設計師會累積作品集，向客戶展示自己的能力。

example.en: Her investment portfolio grew by eight percent last year.
example.zh: 她的投資組合去年成長了百分之八。

example.en: The merger will widen the company's product portfolio significantly.
example.zh: 這次合併將大幅擴大公司的產品組合。

example.en: A portfolio review is part of the interview process.
example.zh: 作品集審查是面試流程的一部分。

examples.en: The interviewer asked to see my portfolio of recent work.
examples.zh: 面試官要求看我近期作品的作品集。

examples.en: Please attach a portfolio when you apply for the design job.
examples.zh: 申請這份設計工作時，請附上作品集。

examples.en: The bank offers advice on how to manage your portfolio.
examples.zh: 銀行提供如何管理投資組合的建議。

confusable.diff: resume 是用文字列出學經歷的履歷；portfolio 是展示實際作品與成果的資料。

example.en: Please send your resume and a portfolio of recent projects.
example.zh: 請寄來你的履歷和近期專案的作品集。

confusable.diff: profile 是簡短的個人或公司簡介；portfolio 是實際作品的集合。

example.en: Update your online profile before the recruiter calls you.
example.zh: 在招募人員打給你之前，先更新你的線上簡介。

example.en: She led three major projects during her first two years.
example.zh: 她在頭兩年主導了三個重要專案。

example.en: The workshop focuses on career development for new managers.
example.zh: 這場工作坊著重新任經理的職涯發展。

example.en: Candidates need at least three years of sales experience.
example.zh: 應徵者需要至少三年的業務經驗。

senses.en: a collection of a person's work or projects

example.en: Applicants should bring a portfolio of their best designs.
example.zh: 應徵者應帶上他們最佳設計的作品集。

senses.en: all the investments that a person or company owns
senses.distinguish: 前面常有 investment、stock，談的是金錢與資產。

example.en: The fund manager updated the client's investment portfolio.
example.zh: 基金經理人更新了客戶的投資組合。

senses.en: all the products or services a company offers
senses.distinguish: 前面常有 product、service，指公司的整體產品線。

example.en: Our product portfolio now includes three new office chairs.
example.zh: 我們的產品組合現在多了三款新辦公椅。

extra_vocab.en: a large room where many people sit to watch a talk or show
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡，auditorium 是舉辦工作坊的場地，因為座位有限，所以要先報名。公告中常用來指公司或學校裡的大型活動空間。

example.en: Both auditoriums were booked for the annual training day.
example.zh: 兩間禮堂都已被預約作年度訓練日使用。

example.en: The university's auditoria are used for lectures and company events.
example.zh: 這所大學的各禮堂用於演講和公司活動。

example.en: The awards ceremony will be held in the school auditorium.
example.zh: 頒獎典禮將在學校禮堂舉行。

example.en: Auditorium seating is limited to two hundred people per session.
example.zh: 禮堂座位每場限兩百人。

example.en: More than five hundred guests filled the auditorium for the launch.
example.zh: 超過五百位賓客坐滿禮堂參加發表會。

example.en: Registration opens in the main auditorium at nine.
example.zh: 報到九點在主禮堂開始。

examples.en: The product launch will take place in the company auditorium.
examples.zh: 新產品發表會將在公司禮堂舉行。

examples.en: All trainees should gather in the auditorium by nine o'clock.
examples.zh: 所有學員請在九點前到禮堂集合。

examples.en: The auditorium has a large screen and a modern sound system.
examples.zh: 這間禮堂有大螢幕和現代化的音響系統。

confusable.diff: 拼法開頭相近，但 auditor 是稽核員或查帳人員，auditorium 是禮堂。

example.en: The auditor will review our accounts next month.
example.zh: 稽核員下個月會審查我們的帳目。

confusable.diff: audience 是「聽眾」（人）；auditorium 是聽眾坐的「禮堂」（地方）。

example.en: The audience listened carefully during the whole presentation.
example.zh: 聽眾在整場簡報中都專心聆聽。

similar.diff: hall 泛指大廳或大型空間，常見 conference hall；auditorium 特指有舞台與固定座位的禮堂。

example.en: The conference hall holds about three hundred people.
example.zh: 這間會議廳可容納約三百人。

similar.diff: lecture hall 是階梯式的講堂，多用在學校；auditorium 更常用在公司或活動。

example.en: The lecture hall has seats for two hundred students.
example.zh: 這間階梯講堂有兩百個學生座位。

example.en: The speaker walked onto the stage and greeted everyone.
example.zh: 講者走上舞台向大家問好。

example.en: Seating is limited, so please register early.
example.zh: 座位有限，請提早報名。

example.en: The venue for the annual meeting has not been chosen yet.
example.zh: 年會的場地還沒決定。

extra_vocab.en: to change the design or structure of a room or building
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡，remodeled 用被動語態說明禮堂去年春天已改建完成，用來補充場地的資訊。remodel 側重改變格局或外觀，不只是修理。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: remodel 是及物動詞，後面直接接地點或建築物；被動寫成 was remodeled。美式拼 remodeled，英式拼 remodelled。

example.en: The landlord remodels the office floors every few years.
example.zh: 房東每隔幾年就會改建辦公室樓層。

example.en: The hotel remodeled its lobby before the tourist season began.
example.zh: 飯店在旅遊旺季開始前改建了大廳。

example.en: The bank remodelled its London branch to add meeting rooms.
example.zh: 這家銀行改建了倫敦分行，增設會議室。

example.en: Remodeling the lobby will begin right after the holiday.
example.zh: 大廳的改建將在假期結束後立刻開始。

example.en: They decided to remodel the break room this summer.
example.zh: 他們決定今年夏天改建休息室。

example.en: The newly remodeled lobby has a modern reception desk.
example.zh: 新近改建的大廳有一張現代化的接待櫃檯。

example.en: The remodeling project will be finished by the end of May.
example.zh: 改建工程將在五月底前完成。

examples.en: We will remodel the second floor to create more meeting rooms.
examples.zh: 我們會改建二樓，增加更多會議室。

examples.en: The owner remodeled the building before leasing it to tenants.
examples.zh: 屋主在把大樓出租給房客之前先做了改建。

examples.en: The remodeling budget was approved by the board last week.
examples.zh: 改建預算上週已獲董事會核准。

similar.diff: renovate 強調把舊的修復、翻新，使它煥然一新；remodel 強調改變格局或樣式。

example.en: The firm will renovate the old warehouse into offices.
example.zh: 這家公司將把舊倉庫翻新成辦公室。

similar.diff: rebuild 是拆掉重建或重新建造；remodel 是在原有的建築上改造。

example.en: They had to rebuild the entire wall after the flood.
example.zh: 水災後，他們必須重建整面牆。

example.en: Construction on the new wing begins early next month.
example.zh: 新側翼大樓的施工將在下個月初開始。

example.en: The contractor promised to finish the work before the holidays.
example.zh: 承包商承諾在假期前完工。

example.en: The new design makes better use of the available space.
example.zh: 新設計能更有效運用現有空間。

derived.link: remodel 是 re-（重新）+ model（造型、樣式），重新塑造成新的樣子，像 rewrite

example.en: The company plans to remodel the lobby next spring.
example.zh: 公司計畫明年春天改建大廳。

example.en: The office remodel took about six weeks to finish.
example.zh: 辦公室的改建工程花了約六週完成。

extra_vocab.en: numbers that show facts about a group of people or things
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡，Statistics 指去年課程的統計數據，用數字說明參加工作坊的員工晉升機會更高。這裡當複數使用，語氣客觀、有說服力。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 指「統計數據」時是複數，動詞用複數（statistics show）；指「統計學」這門學科時當單數（Statistics is …）。一項數字用單數 statistic。

example.en: One statistic in the report surprised the whole sales team.
example.zh: 報告中有一項統計數字讓整個業務團隊吃了一驚。

example.en: Recent statistics show that customer complaints have dropped.
example.zh: 最近的統計數據顯示，客訴已經減少。

example.en: According to official statistics, the market grew by five percent.
example.zh: 根據官方統計數據，市場成長了百分之五。

example.en: Please send me the latest sales statistics by noon.
example.zh: 請在中午前把最新的銷售統計寄給我。

example.en: We collect statistics on website visits every week.
example.zh: 我們每週蒐集網站訪客的統計數據。

examples.en: The annual report includes statistics on employee satisfaction and turnover.
examples.zh: 年度報告包含員工滿意度與離職率的統計數據。

examples.en: The manager used statistics to support her proposal.
examples.zh: 經理用統計數據來支持她的提案。

examples.en: Statistics from the survey helped us choose the best advertising channel.
examples.zh: 問卷調查的統計數據幫助我們選出最好的廣告管道。

similar.diff: figures 較口語，泛指數字、金額；statistics 指經過整理分析的統計資料。

example.en: The latest sales figures for the quarter look very encouraging.
example.zh: 本季最新的銷售數字看起來非常令人振奮。

similar.diff: data 是原始資料；statistics 是把資料整理分析後得出的統計結果。

example.en: We need more data before making a final decision.
example.zh: 做最後決定前，我們需要更多資料。

example.en: We need more data before we make a final decision.
example.zh: 做最後決定前，我們需要更多資料。

example.en: The survey asked customers how they use the product.
example.zh: 這份問卷詢問客戶如何使用這項產品。

example.en: A large percentage of staff chose to attend the workshop.
example.zh: 很大比例的員工選擇參加工作坊。

derived.link: statistic + -al（形容詞），像 final、personal
statistical + -ly（副詞），像 quickly
statistic + -ian（專業人員），像 musician、electrician

senses.en: numbers that show facts about people or things
senses.distinguish: 當複數用，後面接複數動詞，如 statistics show。

example.en: Sales statistics show that online orders are rising quickly.
example.zh: 銷售統計數據顯示網路訂單快速增加。

senses.en: the study of collecting and analyzing numbers
senses.distinguish: 指這門學科時當單數，如 Statistics is a useful subject。

example.en: She studied statistics before joining the research department.
example.zh: 她在加入研究部門前學過統計學。

extra_vocab.en: an experienced person who helps and advises a less experienced person
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡，mentor 是公司為參加者配對的導師，會依各人的經驗提供職涯建議。管理職培訓與新人訓練常見這個字。

forms.label: 名詞複數／動詞第三人稱單數

example.en: Several mentors attended the workshop to meet their new partners.
example.zh: 幾位導師出席工作坊，與他們的新夥伴見面。

example.en: She mentored three junior analysts during her first year as manager.
example.zh: 她擔任經理的第一年指導了三位初階分析師。

example.en: Mentoring younger staff has improved our team's retention rate.
example.zh: 指導年輕員工提高了我們團隊的留任率。

example.en: HR will assign a mentor to every new employee.
example.zh: 人資部會為每位新進員工指派一位導師。

example.en: He agreed to serve as a mentor for young engineers.
example.zh: 他同意擔任年輕工程師的導師。

example.en: The mentor program helps new hires adjust to their roles.
example.zh: 導師計畫幫助新進員工適應他們的角色。

examples.en: My mentor gave me useful advice about moving into management.
examples.zh: 我的導師給了我關於轉任管理職的實用建議。

examples.en: Your mentor will meet with you once a month.
examples.zh: 你的導師每個月會和你見一次面。

examples.en: Having a good mentor can speed up your career growth.
examples.zh: 有一位好導師能加快你的職涯成長。

confusable.diff: 拼法有點像，但 monitor 是「監看、追蹤」，mentor 是「指導、提供建議」。

example.en: The supervisor will monitor sales while the mentor gives career advice.
example.zh: 主管會追蹤銷售狀況，而導師會提供職涯建議。

similar.diff: coach 偏重指導具體技能；mentor 偏重長期的職涯經驗傳承。

example.en: The company hired a coach to improve our presentation skills.
example.zh: 公司聘請了一位教練來提升我們的簡報技巧。

similar.diff: adviser 提供專業建議，不一定長期陪伴；mentor 通常有持續的指導關係。

example.en: The financial adviser suggested a safer investment plan.
example.zh: 財務顧問建議了一個較穩健的投資方案。

example.en: Each trainee receives a workbook on the first day.
