examples.en: Analysts expect the downturn to last until the end of the year.
examples.zh: 分析師預期這波衰退會持續到年底。

confusable.diff: downtown 是「市中心」，拼法只差一個字母，與景氣無關。

example.en: Our head office is located in the downtown area of the city.
example.zh: 我們的總公司位在城市的市中心區。

similar.diff: decline 是較中性的「下降」，可用於任何數字；downturn 特指景氣或業績轉為下滑。

example.en: We saw a steady decline in orders over the summer.
example.zh: 夏天期間，我們的訂單穩定下降。

similar.diff: slump 是「突然、大幅的低迷」，語氣更強、更口語；downturn 較正式。

example.en: The company is trying to recover from a long sales slump.
example.zh: 公司正努力從長期的銷售低迷中恢復。

example.en: The recession lasted for almost two years in this country.
example.zh: 這個國家的經濟衰退持續了將近兩年。

example.en: Demand for our products dropped during the winter months.
example.zh: 冬季期間，我們產品的需求下降了。

example.en: Economists expect a slow recovery in the retail sector.
example.zh: 經濟學家預期零售業會緩慢復甦。

extra_vocab.en: a small change made to make something better or more correct
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇通知裡，salary adjustments 指依績效評等做的「薪資調整」，通常是加薪；這是人資通知中很常見的委婉說法。

example.en: HR will announce the salary adjustments for all staff next week.
example.zh: 人資部門下週會公布全體員工的薪資調整。

example.en: We need to make an adjustment to the delivery schedule.
example.zh: 我們需要對送貨時程做出調整。

example.en: Every salary adjustment must be approved by the director.
example.zh: 每一項薪資調整都必須經主任核准。

example.en: The supplier announced a price adjustment starting next month.
example.zh: 供應商宣布下個月起調整價格。

example.en: Only minor adjustments were needed before the final version.
example.zh: 最終版本之前，只需要小幅調整。

examples.en: Please send me the adjustments you would like to make.
examples.zh: 請把你想做的調整寄給我。

examples.en: A few adjustments to the plan could reduce our costs.
examples.zh: 對計畫稍作調整，可能降低我們的成本。

confusable.diff: adjourn 是「休會、暫停（會議）」，拼法開頭相似，但意思不同。

example.en: The chairman decided to adjourn the meeting until Monday.
example.zh: 主席決定將會議延到週一再開。

confusable.diff: adjacent 是「相鄰的」，開頭拼法相似，與調整無關。

example.en: The conference room is adjacent to the main office.
example.zh: 會議室就在主辦公室隔壁。

similar.diff: change 是一般的「改變」，可大可小；adjustment 通常指為了更好而做的小幅修正。

example.en: The change in policy surprised many of the employees.
example.zh: 政策的改變讓許多員工感到驚訝。

similar.diff: modification 是較正式的「修改」，常用於設計或規格；adjustment 較常用於數字或安排。

example.en: The engineers proposed a modification to the original design.
example.zh: 工程師提議修改原始設計。

example.en: The revision of the contract took almost two weeks.
example.zh: 修訂合約花了將近兩週。

example.en: Please make the corrections before sending the report.
example.zh: 寄出報告前請先做更正。

example.en: We will send you an update on the schedule tomorrow.
example.zh: 我們明天會寄給您行程的最新資訊。

derived.link: adjust 是詞幹；adjust + -ment 變成名詞，像 pay → payment、agree → agreement
adjust + -able，「可以被…的」，像 available、reasonable

extra_vocab.en: in a way that fits the situation or what was just said
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇通知裡，will be applied accordingly 表示薪資調整會「依照績效評等」相應套用，accordingly 把前面的評等與後面的結果連起來，語氣正式。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: accordingly 是副詞，不能像 and、but 一樣連接兩個完整子句；要連接時用分號或句號隔開。

example.en: Please read the notice carefully and act accordingly.
example.zh: 請仔細閱讀通知並據此行動。

example.en: The road will be closed, so please plan accordingly.
example.zh: 這條路會封閉，請據此做好安排。

example.en: If demand rises, we will adjust production accordingly.
example.zh: 如果需求上升，我們會相應調整產量。

examples.en: The schedule has changed, and staff will be informed accordingly.
examples.zh: 時程已經改變，員工將會被相應通知。

examples.en: Prices will be set accordingly once the costs are confirmed.
examples.zh: 成本確認後，價格會據此訂定。

confusable.diff: according to 是介系詞片語，意思是「根據…」，後面接名詞；accordingly 是副詞。
confusable.usage: according to 後面接資料來源或人（according to the report）；accordingly 單獨使用，放在句尾或動詞後。

example.en: According to the report, sales rose by five percent last month.
example.zh: 根據報告，上個月銷售成長了百分之五。

similar.diff: therefore 強調因果，是「因此」；accordingly 強調「依照前面的情況做相應處理」。

example.en: The budget is limited, and therefore we cannot hire anyone.
example.zh: 預算有限，因此我們無法聘人。

similar.diff: consequently 強調「結果」，語氣較正式；accordingly 強調「配合」。

example.en: Orders doubled, and consequently the warehouse needed more staff.
example.zh: 訂單增加一倍，因此倉庫需要更多人手。

example.en: The deadline has passed, so we therefore cannot accept new requests.
example.zh: 截止期限已過，因此我們無法接受新的申請。

example.en: Sales dropped, and consequently the team was reduced.
example.zh: 銷售下滑，因此團隊縮編。

example.en: Please dress appropriately for the client meeting.
example.zh: 請為客戶會議穿著得宜。

derived.link: accord 是詞幹，「一致」；according 是它的 -ing 形，accordingly 再加 -ly 變副詞
accord + -ance，變成名詞，像 appear → appearance；常見片語 in accordance with（依照）

extra_vocab.en: the act of pressing and rubbing the body to help it relax
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇通知裡，massage sessions 是員工可用年度健康補助金支付的項目之一，和健身房會員、語言課程並列，屬於福利項目。

example.en: The spa offers two massages per visit with the premium package.
example.zh: 水療館的高級方案每次造訪提供兩次按摩。

example.en: The therapist massaged his shoulders gently for twenty minutes.
example.zh: 治療師輕輕地為他按摩肩膀二十分鐘。

example.en: The therapist is massaging a client in the next room.
example.zh: 治療師正在隔壁房間為一位客人按摩。

example.en: The spa hired a new massage therapist last month.
example.zh: 這間水療館上個月聘請了一位新的按摩治療師。

example.en: The hotel offers a free foot massage to all guests.
example.zh: 這間飯店提供所有賓客免費的足部按摩。

example.en: Each massage session lasts about forty-five minutes.
example.zh: 每次按摩療程大約持續四十五分鐘。

examples.en: The wellness credit can be used for a massage or a gym pass.
examples.zh: 健康補助金可用於按摩或健身房通行證。

examples.en: After the long flight, I booked a massage at the hotel.
examples.zh: 長途飛行後，我在飯店預約了按摩。

confusable.diff: message 是「訊息」，拼法只差一個字母，發音也不同，但常被看錯。

example.en: Please leave a message if the manager is not available.
example.zh: 如果經理不在，請留言。

similar.diff: spa treatment 是更廣的「水療護理」，可包含按摩、護膚；massage 專指按摩。

example.en: The package includes a spa treatment and a three-course dinner.
example.zh: 這個套裝行程包含一次水療護理和三道菜晚餐。

example.en: The company runs a wellness program for all employees.
example.zh: 公司為所有員工辦理身心健康計畫。

example.en: Physical therapy helped him recover from the injury.
example.zh: 物理治療幫助他從傷勢中復原。

example.en: The lounge offers a quiet space for relaxation.
example.zh: 休息室提供一個安靜的放鬆空間。

example.en: Regular exercise can help reduce work stress.
example.zh: 規律運動有助於減輕工作壓力。

example.en: A short massage can help you relax after a long day.
example.zh: 忙了一整天後，短時間的按摩能幫助放鬆。

example.en: The therapist will massage your shoulders for twenty minutes.
example.zh: 治療師會為你按摩肩膀二十分鐘。

extra_vocab.en: not needed
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇通知裡，it is unnecessary to bring any documents 是告訴員工：新線上表單取代紙本，所以不必親自帶文件到人資部，語氣是方便、省事的提醒。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 常用句型 it is unnecessary (for + 人) to + V，to 後面接原形動詞。

example.en: Printing the report twice was more unnecessary than we first thought.
example.zh: 把報告印兩次，比我們原先想的更沒有必要。

example.en: Cutting the training budget was the most unnecessary decision we made this year.
example.zh: 削減訓練預算是我們今年最沒必要的決定。

example.en: The old process unnecessarily delayed every request by several days.
example.zh: 舊流程不必要地把每份申請延遲了好幾天。

example.en: We should avoid unnecessary costs during the busy season.
example.zh: 旺季期間，我們應該避免不必要的成本。

example.en: Please submit the form today to prevent unnecessary delay.
example.zh: 請今天就送出表格，以免不必要的延誤。

example.en: It is unnecessary to call us if the system is working.
example.zh: 如果系統運作正常，就不必打電話給我們。

example.en: Try to avoid unnecessary meetings so that the team can focus.
example.zh: 請盡量避免不必要的會議，讓團隊能專心。

examples.en: It is unnecessary to print the form; you can submit it online.
examples.zh: 不必列印表格，您可以在線上提交。

examples.en: The extra step proved unnecessary and slowed down the whole process.
examples.zh: 多出來的這個步驟被證明沒必要，還拖慢了整個流程。

similar.diff: needless 較書面，常修飾 expense、delay 等名詞；unnecessary 更常用，也能用在 It is unnecessary to ... 句型。

example.en: The new system will reduce needless paperwork in the office.
example.zh: 新系統將減少辦公室裡不必要的文書作業。

similar.diff: not required 是較白話的「不需要」，強調規定上不要求；unnecessary 強調「沒有必要」。

example.en: A signature is not required for deliveries under fifty dollars.
example.zh: 五十美元以下的包裹不需要簽收。

example.en: Attendance at the safety training is required for all staff.
example.zh: 所有員工都必須參加安全訓練。

example.en: The extra workshop is optional but strongly recommended.
example.zh: 額外的工作坊是自由參加，但強烈建議出席。

example.en: Clear communication is essential for any successful project.
example.zh: 清楚的溝通對任何成功的專案都不可或缺。

example.en: There is no extra charge for online payments.
example.zh: 線上付款不收額外費用。

derived.link: necessary 是詞幹；加上 un-（不）就變成 unnecessary，像 happy → unhappy
necessary 去 -ary 加 -ity，變成名詞，像 able → ability
necessary + -ly，常用 not necessarily（未必）

items.tag: 竹片材料採購需求與防潮保存確認電子郵件

level.why: 使用分詞構句（Having reviewed）、in which 關係子句、even 讓步與 because 因果子句等複合句，並需整合厚度規格、成本比較、乾燥處理與保存方式等多項資訊；選項干擾項取自文中相近細節，字彙如 streamline、warp 較抽象。

items.passage:
To: Daniel Wu, Procurement
From: Emily Chen, Product Development
Subject: Bamboo Strips for the New Stroller Frame

Our team is developing a stroller frame in which bamboo strips are joined to aluminum tubes, and we need your help finding a reliable source for the raw material. Having reviewed the prototype results, we would like strips that are 12 millimeters thick, since thinner ones cracked when the tube connectors were tightened.

Cost is our first concern. Please prepare a spreadsheet comparing the unit prices from at least three suppliers, including shipping and any import fees. However, even the lowest price is not acceptable if the strips have not been properly dried, because our earlier samples warped repeatedly after only two weeks in the warehouse. For that reason, please ask each supplier how the bamboo is treated and how it should be stored. Our current plan is to keep the strips in a room that is properly ventilated and to avoid stacking them directly on the floor.

If a supplier can also cut the strips to length, it may help streamline our assembly process. Please send me your findings by next Wednesday.
items.zh:
收件人：採購部 丹尼爾．吳
寄件人：產品開發部 艾蜜莉．陳
主旨：新款嬰兒推車車架所需的竹片

我們團隊正在開發一款嬰兒推車車架，其中竹片會與鋁管結合，因此需要您協助尋找可靠的原料來源。檢視過試作品的結果後，我們希望採用厚度 12 公釐的竹片，因為較薄的竹片在鎖緊管件接頭時出現了裂痕。

成本是我們最先考量的問題。請準備一份試算表，比較至少三家供應商的單價，並包含運費與任何進口費用。然而，如果竹片沒有經過適當乾燥，即使價格再低也無法接受，因為我們先前的樣品只在倉庫放了兩週，就一再翹曲變形。因此，請詢問每家供應商竹材如何處理，以及應如何保存。我們目前的計畫是把竹片放在通風良好的房間，並避免直接堆放在地板上。

如果供應商還能把竹片依長度裁切，可能有助於簡化我們的組裝流程。請在下週三前把您的調查結果寄給我。

questions.q: Why is Emily writing to Daniel?
opts: To report that the prototype has been completed
To ask for help finding a source of bamboo strips
To complain about the price of aluminum tubes
To order a new shelving system for the warehouse
why: 錯誤：文中提到的是檢視試作品的結果，並不是通知試作品已經完成。
正解：艾蜜莉請採購部協助尋找竹片這項原料的可靠來源。
錯誤：鋁管只是與竹片結合的零件，信中沒有抱怨鋁管價格。
錯誤：倉庫只是樣品存放的地點，信中沒有要訂購貨架。

questions.q: What is Daniel asked to include in the spreadsheet?
opts: The thickness of each bamboo strip
The results of the prototype tests
The storage method used by each supplier
Unit prices, shipping, and import fees from three or more suppliers
why: 錯誤：12 公釐的厚度是規格需求，不是要放進試算表的比較項目。
錯誤：試作品結果是研發端已檢視過的資料，並未要求放進試算表。
錯誤：供應商的保存方式是要另外詢問的事項，不是試算表的內容。
正解：試算表要比較至少三家供應商的單價，並包含運費與進口費用。

questions.q: Why does Emily say the lowest price may not be acceptable?
opts: Strips that are not properly dried changed shape in storage.
Thinner strips cracked when the connectors were tightened.
Import fees are higher for cheaper suppliers.
The supplier cannot cut the strips to length.
why: 正解：先前未適當乾燥的樣品在倉庫放兩週後就翹曲變形，所以最低價不一定能接受。
錯誤：竹片太薄而裂開是厚度規格的理由，不是不接受最低價的原因。
錯誤：文中沒有說便宜的供應商進口費用較高。
錯誤：裁切服務只是能簡化組裝的加分條件，與價格是否可接受無關。

questions.q: The tubes, ______ were delivered last week, have already been cut to length.
why: 錯誤：who 只能指人，這裡的先行詞 tubes 是物品。
錯誤：whose 後面要接名詞，表示所屬，這裡後面是動詞 were delivered。
正解：非限定關係子句中，指物的先行詞用 which，並當 were delivered 的主詞。
錯誤：what 是名詞子句用的關係詞，不能接在先行詞 tubes 之後。

questions.q: The factory has ______ increased its output since the new production line was installed.
why: 錯誤：significance 是名詞，不能修飾動詞 increased。
正解：空格修飾動詞 increased，需要副詞 significantly（顯著地）。
錯誤：significant 是形容詞，只能修飾名詞，不能修飾動詞。
錯誤：signify 是動詞（表示），has 之後的結構不符。

questions.q: Orders ______ before the end of the month will receive a ten percent discount.
why: 錯誤：place 是原形動詞，不能直接接在名詞 Orders 後面修飾它。
錯誤：placing 表示主動，但訂單是「被下」的，語意不通。
錯誤：to place 表示目的或未來，不符合「在月底前下的訂單」的被動修飾。
正解：過去分詞 placed 修飾 Orders，表示「被下的訂單」，等於 Orders that are placed。

extra_vocab.en: a computer file with rows and columns for numbers and calculations
extra_vocab.note: 在這封信裡，Emily 請採購部做一份試算表，把至少三家供應商的單價（含運費與進口費）並排比較，方便決定採購對象。

example.en: She keeps separate spreadsheets for each supplier and shipping method.
example.zh: 她為每家供應商和每種運送方式分別建立試算表。

example.en: I will create a spreadsheet to track all monthly expenses.
example.zh: 我會製作一份試算表來追蹤所有每月支出。

example.en: Please update the spreadsheet after each new delivery arrives.
example.zh: 每次新貨送到後，請更新試算表。

example.en: I attached a spreadsheet showing the cost of each option.
example.zh: 我附上了一份顯示各方案成本的試算表。

example.en: Most accountants use spreadsheet software to prepare their reports.
example.zh: 大部分會計師用試算表軟體準備報告。

examples.en: Please send me the spreadsheet by the end of the day.
examples.zh: 請在今天下班前把試算表寄給我。

examples.en: The spreadsheet shows that shipping costs rose by ten percent.
examples.zh: 試算表顯示運費上漲了百分之十。

confusable.diff: worksheet 是試算表檔案裡的「工作表」（分頁），或給人填寫的練習紙；spreadsheet 是整份試算表。

example.en: Each worksheet in the file covers a different supplier.
example.zh: 檔案裡的每個工作表都針對不同的供應商。

similar.diff: table 是文件或簡報中整理資料的「表格」；spreadsheet 是可計算、可排序的電腦檔案。

example.en: The table on page three compares the three suppliers.
example.zh: 第三頁的表格比較了三家供應商。

example.en: The last column shows the total cost for each supplier.
example.zh: 最後一欄顯示每家供應商的總成本。

example.en: Use this formula to calculate the average price.
example.zh: 請用這個公式計算平均價格。

example.en: We entered all the sales data into the system.
example.zh: 我們把所有銷售資料輸入了系統。

example.en: The chart makes the price differences easy to see.
example.zh: 這張圖表讓價格差異一目了然。

extra_vocab.en: many times, again and again
extra_vocab.note: 在這封信裡，warped repeatedly 強調早期樣品不是偶爾，而是「一再」發生翹曲，用來說明為什麼不能只看最低價、必須確認竹片乾燥處理。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: repeatedly 多放在動詞前或句尾（repeatedly asked／asked repeatedly），不放在句首修飾名詞；形容詞是 repeated（repeated attempts）。

example.en: Customers repeatedly ask when the new model will be available.
example.zh: 顧客一再詢問新機型什麼時候會上市。

example.en: The old machine repeatedly failed during the quality test.
example.zh: 這台舊機器在品質測試中一再故障。

example.en: Engineers repeatedly warned us about the risk of delays.
example.zh: 工程師一再警告我們有延遲的風險。

examples.en: We have repeatedly asked the supplier to correct the invoice.
examples.zh: 我們已經一再要求供應商更正發票。

examples.en: The same complaint was repeatedly mentioned in the customer survey.
examples.zh: 客戶調查中一再提到同樣的抱怨。

confusable.diff: regularly 是「定期、規律地」，強調有固定的間隔；repeatedly 是「一再地」，強調次數多，不一定規律。

example.en: We regularly inspect the storage room on the first Monday.
example.zh: 我們每月第一個週一定期檢查儲藏室。

similar.diff: again and again 較口語、語氣更強烈；repeatedly 較正式，常用於書面與報告。

example.en: The same error appeared again and again during testing.
example.zh: 同樣的錯誤在測試中一再出現。

similar.diff: over and over 最口語，常帶有厭煩的語氣；repeatedly 語氣中性。

example.en: I explained the process over and over, but nothing changed.
example.zh: 我一再解釋流程，但什麼都沒改變。

example.en: The printer frequently jams when the paper is damp.
example.zh: 紙張受潮時，印表機經常卡紙。

example.en: Prices are constantly changing in this market.
example.zh: 這個市場的價格不斷在變動。

example.en: Delays occur only occasionally during the winter.
example.zh: 冬天只是偶爾會發生延誤。

derived.link: repeat 是詞幹，「再做一次」
repeat + -ed，變成形容詞，像 repeated attempts
repeat 的字尾變 -ition，變成名詞，像 compete → competition
repetition 去 -ion 加 -ive，變形容詞，像 active、creative

extra_vocab.en: to make a process simpler and faster
extra_vocab.note: 在這封信裡，streamline our assembly process 是「簡化組裝流程」，意思是如果供應商能把竹片先切好長度，組裝時就能少一道工序、更有效率。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: streamline 是及物動詞，直接接受詞（streamline the process），不加 for 或 on；常和 process、operations、procedure 等名詞搭配。

example.en: The new template streamlines the way we record customer complaints.
example.zh: 新的範本簡化了我們記錄客訴的方式。

example.en: Management streamlined the approval process last year to save time.
example.zh: 管理階層去年精簡了核准流程以節省時間。

example.en: We are streamlining our ordering system to reduce paperwork.
example.zh: 我們正在精簡訂購系統，以減少文書作業。

example.en: The new software helps us streamline a process that took weeks.
example.zh: 新軟體幫助我們簡化一個原本要花數週的流程。

example.en: The company hopes to streamline operations and cut costs.
example.zh: 公司希望精簡營運並降低成本。

example.en: Standard parts will streamline production on the factory floor.
example.zh: 標準化零件將簡化工廠的生產作業。

example.en: We plan to streamline procedures for approving travel requests.
example.zh: 我們打算簡化差旅申請的核准程序。

examples.en: This change should streamline our ordering process considerably.
examples.zh: 這項改變應該能大幅簡化我們的訂購流程。

examples.en: We are working to streamline the way invoices are approved.
examples.zh: 我們正努力簡化發票的核准方式。

confusable.diff: stream 是「溪流、串流」，是 streamline 的前半部，但單獨使用時意思不同。

example.en: The conference will be available as a live stream online.
example.zh: 這場研討會將以線上直播串流的方式提供。

similar.diff: simplify 是「使變簡單」；streamline 強調去除多餘步驟、讓流程更順暢有效率。

example.en: We should simplify the form so that customers can finish it quickly.
example.zh: 我們應該簡化表格，讓顧客能很快填完。

similar.diff: make more efficient 是白話說法，語氣中性；streamline 是商務慣用的簡潔單字。

example.en: The goal is to make the workflow more efficient this year.
example.zh: 今年的目標是讓工作流程更有效率。

example.en: The new system improved efficiency in the warehouse.
example.zh: 新系統提高了倉庫的效率。

example.en: The approval process usually takes about three days.
example.zh: 核准流程通常需要大約三天。

example.en: A clear workflow reduces mistakes in the assembly line.
example.zh: 清楚的工作流程能減少組裝線上的錯誤。

extra_vocab.en: to bend or twist out of the normal shape
extra_vocab.note: 在這封信裡，our earlier samples warped repeatedly 指早期的竹片樣品在倉庫放兩週後一再翹曲變形，原因是沒有乾燥好，所以才要確認供應商的處理與保存方式。

example.en: Cheap bamboo often warps when the humidity changes suddenly.
example.zh: 便宜的竹子在濕度突然改變時常會翹曲。

example.en: Several boards warped during shipping because the crates were left outside.
example.zh: 因為木箱被放在室外，有幾片木板在運送途中翹曲了。

example.en: Warping became a serious problem once the humidity rose last month.
example.zh: 上個月濕度升高後，翹曲成了嚴重的問題。

example.en: Cheap plastic parts can warp under heat inside the truck.
example.zh: 便宜的塑膠零件在卡車內受熱可能變形。

example.en: The boards started to warp after the humid weekend.
example.zh: 在潮濕的週末後，木板開始翹曲。

example.en: We rejected the shipment because of warped wood in every crate.
example.zh: 因為每個箱子裡都有變形的木材，我們拒收了這批貨。

example.en: Proper drying is the best way to prevent warping.
example.zh: 適當的乾燥是防止翹曲的最好方法。

examples.en: The shelves began to warp after a month in storage.
examples.zh: 架子在倉庫放了一個月後開始變形。

examples.en: Wet bamboo tends to warp when it dries too quickly.
examples.zh: 潮濕的竹子如果太快乾，容易變形。

confusable.diff: wrap 是「包裹」，只是字母 a、r 順序不同；warp 是「變形翹曲」，意思完全不同。

example.en: Please wrap each strip in plastic before putting it in the box.
example.zh: 放進箱子前，請用塑膠膜包好每一片竹片。

confusable.diff: warm 是「溫暖的」，拼法和發音都有點像 warp，但沒有變形的意思。

example.en: Keep the warehouse warm enough so the glue can dry.
example.zh: 請讓倉庫保持足夠溫暖，膠才能乾。

similar.diff: bend 是「彎曲」，可以是人為造成、可以彎回來；warp 是材料因濕氣或熱而變形，通常無法復原。

example.en: You can bend the strip slightly without breaking it.
example.zh: 你可以稍微彎曲這片竹片而不會折斷。

similar.diff: twist 是「扭轉」，強調繞著軸旋轉；warp 是整體翹起、不平整。

example.en: Do not twist the tube when you attach the connector.
example.zh: 安裝接頭時，請不要扭轉管子。

example.en: The thin strips cracked when we tightened the screws.
example.zh: 我們鎖緊螺絲時，薄的竹片裂開了。

example.en: Wood can shrink slightly as it dries in the sun.
example.zh: 木頭在陽光下乾燥時可能會稍微收縮。

example.en: Wet bamboo may expand and change its shape.
example.zh: 潮濕的竹子可能膨脹並改變形狀。

extra_vocab.en: having fresh air that can move in and out
extra_vocab.note: 在這封信裡，a room that is properly ventilated 指通風良好的房間，是保存竹片、避免受潮變形的條件之一，也呼應前面提到的樣品翹曲問題。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: ventilated 常和 well／properly／poorly 連用；放在名詞前時用連字號（a well-ventilated room），放在後面時不用（The room is well ventilated）。

example.en: This fan ventilates the whole storage room within ten minutes.
example.zh: 這台風扇能在十分鐘內讓整個儲藏室通風。

example.en: We are ventilating the showroom more often during the rainy season.
example.zh: 雨季期間，我們更常讓展示間通風。

example.en: Store the paint in a well-ventilated room away from heat.
example.zh: 請把油漆存放在遠離熱源、通風良好的房間。

example.en: The poorly ventilated warehouse was damp and unpleasant to work in.
example.zh: 通風不良的倉庫又潮濕、又讓人不舒服。

example.en: The kitchen must be properly ventilated to meet safety rules.
example.zh: 廚房必須通風良好，才能符合安全規定。

example.en: We open the windows every morning to ventilate the warehouse.
example.zh: 我們每天早上開窗，讓倉庫通風。

examples.en: Keep the storage area dry and well ventilated at all times.
examples.zh: 請隨時讓儲存區保持乾燥且通風良好。

examples.en: Workers should use these chemicals only in a ventilated space.
examples.zh: 員工應只在通風的空間使用這些化學品。

confusable.diff: venture 是「冒險、新事業」，拼法開頭相近，但與通風無關。

example.en: The joint venture will open its first factory next year.
example.zh: 這家合資企業明年將開設第一間工廠。

similar.diff: airy 形容空間「通風明亮、寬敞」，較口語、描述感受；ventilated 強調有通風設施或空氣流通。

example.en: The new office is bright and airy, with large windows.
example.zh: 新辦公室明亮通風，有很大的窗戶。

example.en: Good airflow keeps the stored goods dry.
example.zh: 良好的空氣流通能讓儲存的貨物保持乾燥。

example.en: We installed a fan to improve air movement in the room.
example.zh: 我們安裝了風扇來改善室內的空氣流動。

example.en: Proper storage helps materials last much longer.
example.zh: 適當的儲存能讓材料更耐用。

example.en: High humidity can damage materials in poor storage.
example.zh: 高濕度可能損壞保存不當的材料。

derived.link: ventilate 去 e 加 -ion，變成名詞，像 decorate → decoration
ventilate + -or，做這件事的東西，像 elevator、calculator

example.en: Please keep the paint in a well-ventilated storage room.
example.zh: 請把油漆放在通風良好的儲藏室。

example.en: We should ventilate the meeting room before the clients arrive.
example.zh: 客戶抵達前，我們應該讓會議室通風。

items.tag: 整批嬰兒推車煞車瑕疵與返工寄回客戶倉庫討論對話

level.why: 兩人對話中使用 that 名詞子句、so 引導的結果子句、if 條件句與 suggest 後接子句等複合句，並需整合客戶回饋、瑕疵原因、退款與返工兩種方案的利弊；publicity、substantially 等字彙較抽象，選項干擾項取自對話中出現過但並非結論的做法。

items.passage:
Mia: Thanks for joining me, Kevin. The customer feedback on last month's stroller batch is worse than we expected. Several units arrived with defective brakes, and the retailer is threatening to cancel its next order.
Kevin: I spoke with the factory this morning. They confirmed that the placement of the brake cable was slightly off throughout the entire batch, so issuing refunds one by one would not solve the problem.
Mia: I agree. Negative publicity could substantially hurt our sales if the reviews keep spreading online. I suggest we ask the factory to rework every unit and ship them straight back to the customer's warehouse.
Kevin: That will cost more than refunds, but it should protect the relationship. I will confirm the schedule by Thursday.
items.zh:
米雅：謝謝你來參加，凱文。上個月那批嬰兒推車的客戶回饋比我們預期的還要糟。好幾台到貨時煞車就有瑕疵，而且零售商正威脅要取消下一筆訂單。
凱文：我今天早上跟工廠談過了。他們確認整批推車的煞車線位置都稍微偏掉，所以一件一件辦理退款解決不了問題。
米雅：我同意。如果負面評價持續在網路上擴散，不良的曝光可能會大幅衝擊我們的銷售。我建議請工廠把每一台都重工修改，然後直接寄回客戶的倉庫。
凱文：那樣成本會比退款高，但應該能保住雙方的關係。我會在週四前確認時程。

vocab.col: careful placement / placement of the part

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
opts: How to increase sales of a new stroller
Whether to change the factory they use
How to deal with a batch of faulty strollers
When to launch next month's promotion
why: 錯誤：對話提到銷售可能受影響，但主題不是如何增加新推車的銷量。
錯誤：只提到請工廠返工，沒有討論是否更換工廠。
正解：兩人討論整批有瑕疵的推車該如何處理，最後決定返工後寄回客戶倉庫。
錯誤：文中提到的是零售商可能取消下一筆訂單，與下個月的促銷活動無關。

questions.q: Why does Kevin say that refunds would not solve the problem?
opts: The problem affects the whole batch.
The factory refuses to pay for them.
Customers would rather have new strollers.
Refunds take too long to process.
why: 正解：工廠確認整批推車的煞車線位置都偏了，所以逐一退款解決不了問題。
錯誤：文中沒有說工廠拒絕付款。
錯誤：沒有人提到客戶想要換新的推車。
錯誤：對話並沒有提到退款處理時間太久。

questions.q: What does Mia suggest doing with the strollers?
opts: Moving them to a different warehouse
Sending the repaired units straight to the customer's warehouse
why: 錯誤：取消下一筆訂單是零售商可能採取的行動，不是米雅的建議。
錯誤：逐一退款是凱文說不能解決問題的做法，米雅並未建議。
錯誤：米雅說的是寄回客戶的倉庫，不是搬到另一個倉庫。
正解：米雅建議請工廠重工每一台，並直接寄回客戶的倉庫。

questions.q: We apologize for the inconvenience and will ______ the problem as soon as possible.
why: 錯誤：resolution 是名詞，不能接在助動詞 will 之後。
正解：will 之後接原形動詞，resolve the problem 意為「解決問題」。
錯誤：resolving 是現在分詞，不能直接接在 will 之後。
錯誤：resolved 是過去式或過去分詞，與 will 搭配時時態不符。

questions.q: Customers who are dissatisfied with a product may return it ______ thirty days of purchase.
why: 錯誤：for thirty days 表示持續三十天，不是期限。
錯誤：on 用於特定日期，後面不能接 thirty days of purchase。
錯誤：until 表示持續到某個時間點，與「在期限內退貨」的語意不符。
正解：within thirty days of purchase 表示「購買後三十天內」。

questions.q: The company has received ______ complaints about the delayed delivery this week.
why: 正解：numerous（許多的）是形容詞，可修飾複數名詞 complaints。
錯誤：number 是名詞，不能直接修飾 complaints（需用 a number of）。
錯誤：numerously 是副詞，不能修飾名詞。
錯誤：numeral 是名詞（數字），語意不符。

extra_vocab.en: not made correctly and not working as it should
extra_vocab.note: 在這段對話裡，defective brakes 指推車煞車有瑕疵、無法正常運作，是客戶抱怨與零售商威脅取消訂單的原因；這是品管與客訴情境的常用字。

example.en: Customers can return any defective product within thirty days.
example.zh: 顧客可在三十天內退回任何瑕疵品。

example.en: The technician replaced the defective part free of charge.
example.zh: 技術人員免費更換了有瑕疵的零件。

example.en: All defective items must be reported before the end of the week.
example.zh: 所有有瑕疵的商品都必須在本週結束前回報。

examples.en: The retailer received several complaints about defective zippers.
examples.zh: 零售商收到好幾件有關拉鍊瑕疵的客訴。

examples.en: The inspector found that two percent of the units were defective.
examples.zh: 檢驗員發現百分之二的產品有瑕疵。

confusable.diff: effective 是「有效的」，字形與字尾相近，意思卻相反於 defective（有缺陷的）。

example.en: The new training method proved effective for all the new staff.
example.zh: 新的訓練方法對所有新進員工都很有效。

confusable.diff: defensive 是「防衛的、防禦性的」，開頭拼法相似，與瑕疵無關。

example.en: He became defensive when the manager questioned his report.
example.zh: 經理質疑他的報告時，他變得有些防衛。

similar.diff: faulty 較口語，常用於機器、電路、設備；defective 較正式，常用於產品與批次。

example.en: A faulty switch caused the machine to stop working.
example.zh: 一個有問題的開關讓機器停止運作。

similar.diff: broken 是「壞掉了」，可能是使用後才壞；defective 強調原本製造時就有問題。

example.en: The package arrived with a broken handle and a torn label.
example.zh: 包裹送達時把手斷了，標籤也撕破了。

example.en: Every batch goes through a careful inspection before shipping.
example.zh: 每一批貨在出貨前都要經過仔細檢驗。

example.en: We will send a replacement as soon as possible.
example.zh: 我們會盡快寄出更換品。

example.en: The warranty covers any defects for the first two years.
example.zh: 保固涵蓋前兩年內的任何瑕疵。

derived.link: defect 是詞幹；defect + -ive 變成形容詞 defective，像 act → active

extra_vocab.en: the way or the place where something is put
extra_vocab.note: 在這段對話裡，the placement of the brake cable 指煞車線「裝置的位置」，整批都稍微偏掉，所以問題出在製造設定，不是個別零件，逐一退款解決不了。

example.en: The designer tested three placements of the handle before choosing one.
example.zh: 設計師在選定之前，測試了把手的三種位置配置。

example.en: Correct placement of the sensor is important for accurate results.
example.zh: 感應器正確的擺放位置對準確的結果很重要。

collocations.zh: 產品置入、商品陳列位置

example.en: Product placement near the entrance can increase sales.
example.zh: 把商品陳列在入口附近能提高銷量。

example.en: The agency offers job placement services for recent graduates.
example.zh: 這家機構為應屆畢業生提供就業安置服務。

examples.en: A small error in placement can affect the whole assembly line.
examples.zh: 擺放位置的一個小錯誤，可能影響整條組裝線。

examples.en: The placement of the ad on the homepage cost extra.
examples.zh: 把廣告放在首頁的版位要額外收費。

confusable.diff: replacement 是「更換、替代品」，只多了 re-；placement 是「擺放的位置」。

example.en: The replacement arrived two days after we reported the problem.
example.zh: 我們回報問題兩天後，更換品就送到了。

similar.diff: positioning 強調「定位、擺放的動作與方式」，也用於市場定位；placement 強調最後放的位置。

example.en: The positioning of the logo on the box was changed.
example.zh: 標誌在箱子上的位置被改了。

similar.diff: location 是「地點、所在位置」，常指較大的地方；placement 指東西被放在哪裡的細節。

example.en: The new store location is close to the train station.
example.zh: 新店的地點靠近火車站。

example.en: Please check the position of the switch before starting.
example.zh: 開始前請檢查開關的位置。

example.en: The seating arrangement was changed for the client meeting.
example.zh: 為了客戶會議，座位安排被更動了。

example.en: Installation of the new brakes takes about ten minutes.
example.zh: 安裝新煞車大約要十分鐘。

derived.link: place 是詞幹；place + -ment 變成名詞，像 pay → payment、agree → agreement
re-（再一次）+ place，放另一個在原位，像 return、rebuild
mis-（錯）+ place，像 misunderstand、mistake

senses.en: the way or place where something is put

example.en: The placement of the buttons makes the device easy to use.
example.zh: 按鈕的位置配置讓這個裝置很容易操作。

senses.en: the act of finding a job or a place for someone
senses.distinguish: 看到 job、student、agency 等字，多半是人員安置。

example.en: The school helps students with placement in local companies.
example.zh: 學校協助學生安置到本地公司工作。

senses.en: the act of putting an ad or product where people will see it
senses.distinguish: 看到 ad、product、shelf、website 等字，是廣告或商品的版位。

example.en: Ad placement on the front page is more expensive.
example.zh: 刊登在首頁的廣告費用比較貴。

extra_vocab.en: money that is paid back to a customer
extra_vocab.note: 在這段對話裡，issuing refunds one by one 是「逐一退款」的意思；因為問題出在整批，個別退款無法根本解決，所以才決定整批返工。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 名詞重音在前 /ˈriːfʌnd/，動詞重音在後 /rɪˈfʌnd/；要說「給某人退款」用 refund + 人 + 金額，或 give someone a refund。

example.en: Refunds usually take about five business days to appear on your card.
example.zh: 退款通常要大約五個工作天才會出現在你的卡上。

example.en: The retailer refunded every customer whose stroller had faulty brakes.
example.zh: 零售商退款給每一位推車煞車有瑕疵的顧客。

example.en: Refunding each order separately would take our team several weeks.
example.zh: 逐筆訂單分別退款，會讓我們團隊花上好幾週。

example.en: The store agreed to issue a refund for the damaged item.
example.zh: 商店同意為受損的商品辦理退款。

example.en: Customers may request a refund within fourteen days of purchase.
example.zh: 顧客可在購買後十四天內申請退款。

example.en: We will offer a full refund if the product arrives late.
example.zh: 如果商品延遲送達，我們會提供全額退款。

example.en: Please read our refund policy before placing an order.
example.zh: 下單前，請先閱讀我們的退款政策。

examples.en: You will receive your refund within five business days.
examples.zh: 您會在五個工作天內收到退款。

examples.en: We apologize for the delay and will send a refund today.
examples.zh: 我們為延遲致歉，並將於今天退款。

confusable.diff: fund 是「資金、基金」；refund 是把已付的錢退回去，多了 re-（回）。

example.en: The fund will be used to build a new training center.
example.zh: 這筆資金將用來興建新的訓練中心。

similar.diff: reimburse 是「補償、報銷」已花的費用（如公司付差旅費）；refund 是把顧客付的錢退還。

example.en: The company will reimburse you for all travel expenses.
example.zh: 公司會報銷您所有的差旅費用。

similar.diff: money back 是口語，常見於廣告用語（money-back guarantee）；refund 較正式。

example.en: The product comes with a money back guarantee for thirty days.
example.zh: 這項產品附有三十天退款保證。

example.en: Please bring your receipt when you ask for a refund.
example.zh: 要求退款時，請攜帶收據。

example.en: You can ask for an exchange instead of a refund.
example.zh: 您可以要求換貨，而不是退款。

example.en: The store gave me a credit to use on my next order.
example.zh: 商店給了我一筆抵用額度，可用在下一筆訂單。

derived.link: refund + -able，「可以被退的」，像 available、reasonable
non-（不）+ refundable，常見於機票、訂金

example.en: She asked for a refund because the item was damaged.
example.zh: 她因為商品受損而要求退款。

example.en: We will refund your payment if the order is canceled.
example.zh: 如果訂單取消，我們會退還您的款項。

extra_vocab.en: attention that a person, company, or product gets in the news or online
extra_vocab.note: 在這段對話裡，negative publicity 指負面的媒體或網路評論；Mia 擔心評價在網路上擴散會大幅損害銷量，所以主張儘快整批返工。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: publicity 是不可數名詞，不加 s，也不說 a publicity；要形容好壞用 good／bad／negative publicity。

example.en: Negative publicity can damage a brand within a few days.
example.zh: 負面報導可能在幾天內傷害一個品牌。

example.en: The charity event brought us good publicity in the local news.
example.zh: 這場慈善活動為我們在地方新聞中帶來正面宣傳。

example.en: The new logo helped generate publicity before the launch.
example.zh: 新標誌在上市前幫忙引起了關注。

example.en: Winning the award gave the company free publicity worldwide.
example.zh: 獲獎為公司帶來全球性的免費宣傳。

examples.en: We want to avoid any publicity until the problem is solved.
examples.zh: 在問題解決之前，我們想避免任何曝光。

examples.en: The publicity around the product launch attracted many new customers.
examples.zh: 產品上市的宣傳吸引了許多新顧客。

confusable.diff: publish 是動詞「出版、發表」；publicity 是名詞「公眾關注、宣傳」。
confusable.usage: publish 是動詞（publish a report）；publicity 是不可數名詞，不能當動詞用。

example.en: The magazine will publish our interview in next month's issue.
example.zh: 雜誌將在下個月的那一期刊登我們的訪談。

similar.diff: promotion 是公司主動做的促銷或推廣；publicity 多指受媒體或大眾關注，不一定自己花錢。

example.en: The store runs a special promotion every weekend.
example.zh: 這家店每個週末都有特別促銷。

similar.diff: media coverage 專指新聞媒體的報導；publicity 還包含網路口碑與社群討論。

example.en: The opening received wide media coverage across the country.
example.zh: 開幕獲得全國媒體廣泛報導。

example.en: A single mistake can harm a company's reputation.
example.zh: 一個錯誤就可能損害公司的名聲。

example.en: The press reported on the product recall this morning.
example.zh: 新聞媒體今天早上報導了這次產品回收。

example.en: The company worked hard to improve its public image.
example.zh: 公司努力改善它的公眾形象。

derived.link: public 是詞幹；public + -ity 變成名詞，像 active → activity
public + -ize，「使成為公開的」，像 organize、modernize
public + -ly，形容詞加 -ly 變副詞，像 quickly
publish 的字尾改成 -ication，變成名詞，像 apply → application

extra_vocab.en: by a large amount
extra_vocab.note: 在這段對話裡，substantially hurt our sales 表示負面報導會「大幅」損害銷量，語氣強調影響程度大，是商務對話中常見的強調副詞。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: substantially 常放在動詞前或比較級前（substantially higher）；形容詞是 substantial，用來修飾名詞（a substantial increase）。

example.en: Our online orders increased substantially during the holiday season.
example.zh: 假期期間，我們的線上訂單大幅增加。

example.en: The two proposals differ substantially in cost and schedule.
example.zh: 這兩份提案在成本與時程上差異很大。

example.en: The new process will reduce waiting time substantially.
example.zh: 新流程將大幅減少等待時間。

example.en: Prices in this area are substantially higher than in the suburbs.
example.zh: 這個地區的價格比郊區高出許多。

examples.en: The new model is substantially lighter than the old one.
examples.zh: 新機型比舊機型輕許多。

examples.en: Delays could substantially affect our delivery date for the order.
examples.zh: 延誤可能大幅影響我們這筆訂單的交貨日。

confusable.diff: substitute 是「替代品；取代」，開頭拼法 sub- 相近，但意思無關。

example.en: You can use a similar part as a substitute for this one.
example.zh: 你可以用類似的零件來代替這一個。

similar.diff: significantly 強調「明顯到值得注意」，常用於數據與分析；substantially 強調「量或程度很大」。

example.en: Sales improved significantly after the new campaign started.
example.zh: 新活動開始後，銷售有明顯的改善。

similar.diff: considerably 語氣稍柔和，意思是「相當地」；substantially 更強調數量上的大。

example.en: Shipping costs are considerably lower than we expected.
example.zh: 運費比我們預期的低了不少。

example.en: Profits dropped dramatically after the factory closed.
example.zh: 工廠關閉後，利潤急遽下降。

example.en: The price has risen slightly since last month.
example.zh: 價格自上個月以來略為上漲。

example.en: Customer satisfaction has noticeably improved this quarter.
example.zh: 本季客戶滿意度有明顯改善。

derived.link: substance 是詞幹；去掉 -ce 加 -tial，變成形容詞「實質的」substantial
substance 變形 + -ial，變成形容詞，像 office → official

items.tag: 新市場進入與新產品商業可行性初步評估備忘錄

level.why: 使用 although 讓步、with 分詞構句、Assuming that 與 provided that 等條件結構，以及 which 非限定關係子句；需整合市場競爭、獲利條件、配送方式與後續建議等多項資訊，選項干擾項取自文中相近數字與條件，比上週稍難。

items.passage:
To: Executive Committee
From: Grace Lin, Finance Analyst
Subject: Feasibility of the Southeast Asian Launch

At the request of our founder, the finance team has completed a preliminary study on whether launching our compact air purifier in Southeast Asia would be commercially viable. The results suggest that, although demand is growing quickly in urban areas, competition is stronger than initially assumed, with three established brands already controlling most of the market.

Even so, the projected figures are encouraging. Assuming that we capture only five percent of the market within the first two years, the product would still generate a tidy profit, provided that production costs remain unchanged. Sales would be handled online and delivered through the national postal service, which would keep shipping expenses low.

Before the committee makes a final decision, a more detailed feasibility study covering import duties and local regulations will be required. I recommend delaying any investment until those findings are available.
items.zh:
收件人：執行委員會
寄件人：財務分析師 林葛蕾絲
主旨：東南亞上市的可行性

應創辦人的要求，財務團隊已完成一項初步研究，評估我們的小型空氣清淨機在東南亞上市是否具有商業可行性。結果顯示，雖然都會區的需求成長快速，但競爭比原先假設的更激烈，已有三個成熟品牌掌握了大部分市場。

即便如此，預估數字仍令人樂觀。假設我們在前兩年只取得百分之五的市占率，只要生產成本維持不變，這項產品仍能創造可觀的利潤。銷售將透過線上進行，並由國家郵政系統配送，這能讓運費維持在低水準。

在委員會做出最終決定之前，還需要一份涵蓋進口關稅與當地法規的更詳細可行性研究。我建議在取得那些結果之前，暫緩任何投資。

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the memo?
opts: To announce the launch of a new product in Southeast Asia
To report preliminary findings on whether entering a market is viable
To request a larger budget for production
To compare three competing brands in detail
why: 錯誤：備忘錄是在評估是否上市，並沒有宣布產品已經上市。
正解：備忘錄報告初步研究結果，評估進入東南亞市場是否具有商業可行性。
錯誤：信中提到生產成本，但沒有要求增加預算。
錯誤：三個品牌只是說明競爭情形，並沒有詳細比較它們。

questions.q: What is indicated about the market in Southeast Asia?
opts: Demand for air purifiers is falling in cities.
Local brands have been losing market share.
Import duties will be lower than expected.
A few established brands already dominate it.
why: 錯誤：文中說都會區的需求正在快速成長，不是下降。
錯誤：文中沒有提到本地品牌的市占率下滑。
錯誤：進口關稅還需要進一步研究，文中沒有說會比預期低。
正解：文中說已有三個成熟品牌控制了大部分市場。

questions.q: Under what condition would the product still be profitable?
opts: If the company captures more than half of the market
If sales are made only in physical stores
If the launch is delayed for two years
why: 正解：即使只取得百分之五的市占率，只要生產成本維持不變，仍能創造可觀利潤。
錯誤：文中假設的是只取得百分之五的市占率，並不需要過半。
錯誤：銷售是透過線上進行，而不是只在實體店面。
錯誤：兩年是預估取得市占率的期間，並不是延後上市的條件。

questions.q: The company is considering ______ its operations to several overseas markets next year.
why: 錯誤：consider 後面要接動名詞，不能直接接原形動詞。
錯誤：expanded 是過去式或過去分詞，不能接在 considering 之後當受詞。
正解：consider 後面接動名詞，considering expanding 意為「考慮擴大」。
錯誤：expansion 是名詞，後面不能再接 its operations 當受詞。

questions.q: Our analysts expect the market to grow ______ over the next decade.
why: 錯誤：steady 是形容詞，不能修飾動詞 grow。
正解：副詞 steadily 修飾動詞 grow，表示「穩定地成長」。
錯誤：steadiness 是名詞，不能修飾動詞。
錯誤：steadier 是形容詞比較級，不能修飾動詞，且語意缺少比較對象。

questions.q: ______ the economy slows down, many investors choose to keep their money in savings accounts.
why: 錯誤：Despite 是介系詞，後面不能接完整子句。
錯誤：During 是介系詞，後面不能接完整子句。
錯誤：Therefore 是副詞，不能連接兩個子句。
正解：Whenever 是連接詞，引導時間子句，表示「每當經濟趨緩時」。

extra_vocab.en: a person who starts a company or an organization
extra_vocab.note: 在本篇指創辦公司的人。At the request of our founder 表示這份評估是創辦人要求才做的，語氣正式，帶有高層指示的意味。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: founder 是可數名詞，單數前要加 a／the／our 等限定詞；the founder of + 公司 表示某公司的創辦人。

example.en: The two founders met at university and launched the company together.
example.zh: 兩位創辦人在大學認識，並一起創立了這家公司。

example.en: She is the founder and CEO of a small software firm.
example.zh: 她是一家小型軟體公司的創辦人兼執行長。

example.en: The company founder still approves every major investment plan.
example.zh: 公司創辦人仍會核准每一項重大投資計畫。

example.en: Mr. Chen is the founder of the company and its largest shareholder.
example.zh: 陳先生是公司創辦人，也是最大股東。

examples.en: Our founder will join the meeting to discuss the new market plan.
examples.zh: 我們的創辦人會參加會議，討論新的市場計畫。

examples.en: The founder sent an email asking every department to cut costs.
examples.zh: 創辦人寄了電子郵件，要求每個部門降低成本。

examples.en: The founder started the business in a small garage twenty years ago.
examples.zh: 創辦人二十年前在一間小車庫裡開始了這門生意。

confusable.diff: funder 是出資、提供資金的人；founder 是創立公司的人。

example.en: The main funder agreed to support the project for another two years.
example.zh: 主要出資者同意再支持這個專案兩年。

similar.diff: owner 是擁有者，不一定是創辦人；founder 強調是開創公司的人。

example.en: The owner of the store decided to open a second branch.
example.zh: 這家店的老闆決定開第二間分店。

similar.diff: entrepreneur 泛指創業的人，不一定指某一家公司的創辦人。

example.en: The young entrepreneur raised funds to launch her first product.
example.zh: 這位年輕創業家募資推出她的第一項產品。

example.en: Several executives will review the results next Monday.
example.zh: 幾位高階主管下週一會審閱結果。

example.en: The chairman thanked the staff for their hard work this year.
example.zh: 董事長感謝員工今年的辛勤工作。

example.en: Investors want to see a clear plan before giving more money.
example.zh: 投資人想先看到明確的計畫才會再投入資金。

derived.link: found（創立）+ -er，做這件事的人，像 teach → teacher。注意 found 也是 find 的過去式，要看句意。
co-（一起）+ founder，像 co-worker（同事）。
found + -ing，用來形容「創立時的」，如 founding member（創始成員）。
found + -ation，像 organize → organization，把動作變成名詞。

extra_vocab.en: able to work well or to make money
extra_vocab.note: commercially viable 指在商業上行得通、能賺錢，是評估報告常見的用語。本篇用它表示「到東南亞推出產品值不值得做」。

example.en: Experts doubt the new device will be commercially viable this year.
example.zh: 專家懷疑這款新裝置今年在商業上是否可行。

example.en: Moving production overseas is now a viable option for us.
example.zh: 把生產移到海外現在對我們是個可行的選項。

example.en: The plan is financially viable only if sales reach the target.
example.zh: 這項計畫只有在銷售達標時，財務上才可行。

example.en: We are looking for a viable alternative to our current supplier.
example.zh: 我們正在尋找目前供應商的可行替代方案。

examples.en: Is it viable to open two stores in the same district?
examples.zh: 在同一個區域開兩間店可行嗎？

examples.en: The study shows the project is viable under current conditions.
examples.zh: 研究顯示在目前的條件下，這個專案是可行的。

examples.en: Please let me know if this schedule is still viable.
examples.zh: 請告訴我這個時程是否仍然可行。

confusable.diff: available 是「可取得的、有空的」；viable 是「行得通的」。

example.en: The meeting room is available from two to four o'clock.
example.zh: 會議室兩點到四點可以使用。

confusable.diff: variable 是「會變動的」，和是否可行無關。

example.en: Shipping costs are variable, so the final price may change.
example.zh: 運費會變動，所以最後價格可能不同。

similar.diff: feasible 偏重條件或技術上做得到；viable 還強調能持續、能獲利。

example.en: A new warehouse seems feasible if we get approval by May.
example.zh: 如果五月前獲得核准，新倉庫似乎是做得到的。

similar.diff: practical 強調實際好用、容易執行，不一定談到獲利。

example.en: Working from home is a practical solution for some teams.
example.zh: 在家工作對某些團隊是實用的解決辦法。

example.en: Their sales target is realistic, given last year's results.
example.zh: 考慮到去年的成績，他們的銷售目標很合理。

example.en: The online store became profitable after only six months.
example.zh: 這家網路商店只花六個月就開始獲利。

example.en: We need a sustainable plan for long term growth.
example.zh: 我們需要一個可持續的長期成長計畫。

derived.link: viable + -ity，把形容詞變名詞，像 able → ability。
viable + -ly，形容詞變副詞，像 easy → easily。
un-（不）+ viable，像 unable、unfair。

extra_vocab.zh: 相當可觀的（金額）；整齊的
extra_vocab.en: fairly large in amount; or clean and in good order
extra_vocab.note: a tidy profit 是比較口語的說法，指一筆不小的利潤，語氣是「結果令人滿意」。這裡不是「整齊」的意思。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「可觀」這個意思幾乎只用在 a tidy sum／profit／amount 這類固定搭配，放在名詞前，前面要加 a。

example.en: A tidier warehouse would help workers find parts much faster.
example.zh: 更整齊的倉庫能幫助員工更快找到零件。

example.en: Hers is the tidiest desk on the entire sales floor.
example.zh: 她的桌子是整個業務部最整齊的。

example.en: The cleaning crew tidies the conference room every evening at six.
example.zh: 清潔人員每天傍晚六點整理會議室。

example.en: Staff tidied the showroom before the investors arrived this morning.
example.zh: 員工在今天早上投資人抵達前整理了展示間。

example.en: We spent the afternoon tidying the storage room and labeling shelves.
example.zh: 我們整個下午都在整理儲藏室並為架子貼標籤。

example.en: He earned a tidy sum from selling his old company.
example.zh: 他賣掉舊公司，賺了一大筆錢。

example.en: The small shop made a tidy profit last winter.
example.zh: 這家小店去年冬天賺了不少利潤。

example.en: Please tidy up the meeting room before the client arrives.
example.zh: 請在客戶抵達前整理好會議室。

example.en: Please keep your desk tidy when you leave the office.
example.zh: 離開辦公室時，請保持你的桌面整齊。

examples.en: The sale of the old equipment brought in a tidy sum.
examples.zh: 出售舊設備帶來了一筆可觀的收入。

examples.en: Our manager likes a tidy workspace with clear labels on every shelf.
examples.zh: 我們經理喜歡整齊的工作空間，每個架子都有清楚的標籤。

examples.en: A tidy profit like this will make our investors happy.
examples.zh: 像這樣可觀的利潤會讓我們的投資人很高興。

confusable.diff: tiny 是「很小的」，拼法和發音都很像，但和整齊或金額多寡無關。

example.en: The tiny part costs only two dollars, but it is very important.
example.zh: 這個很小的零件只要兩美元，但非常重要。

similar.diff: neat 指整齊乾淨、看起來舒服，不能用來表示金額可觀。

example.en: Her report was neat and easy to follow.
example.zh: 她的報告整齊又容易看懂。

similar.diff: considerable 表示金額、數量很大，比較正式，可搭配各種名詞。

example.en: The new contract brought a considerable amount of income.
example.zh: 新合約帶來了相當多的收入。

example.en: The company made a substantial profit in the first quarter.
example.zh: 公司在第一季賺了相當可觀的利潤。

example.en: The storage room is orderly and easy to search.
example.zh: 倉庫很有條理，很容易找東西。

example.en: She is very organized and never misses a deadline.
example.zh: 她很有條理，從不錯過期限。

derived.link: tidy 的 y 變 i，再加 -ly 變副詞，像 easy → easily。
tidy 的 y 變 i，再加 -ness 變名詞，像 happy → happiness。
un-（不）+ tidy，像 unclear、unhappy。

example.en: The company reported a tidy profit after the first quarter.
example.zh: 公司在第一季後公布了一筆可觀的利潤。

example.en: Could you tidy the files before the visitors arrive?
example.zh: 你能在訪客抵達前整理好這些檔案嗎？

senses.en: fairly large in amount
senses.distinguish: 後面接 profit、sum、amount 等金額名詞，就是「可觀」的意思。

example.en: Selling the old machines earned the company a tidy sum.
example.zh: 賣掉舊機器為公司賺進一大筆錢。

senses.en: clean and in good order
senses.distinguish: 描述桌面、房間、倉庫等空間或物品時，就是「整齊」的意思。

example.en: The tidy warehouse made it easy to find every part.
example.zh: 整齊的倉庫讓人很容易找到每個零件。

extra_vocab.en: related to sending letters and packages by mail
extra_vocab.note: the national postal service 指國家的郵政機構（郵局）。本篇說明產品用郵局寄送，所以運費可以維持在低水準。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: postal 是形容詞，只放在名詞前（postal service、postal code），不能單獨當補語，如不說 The service is postal。

example.en: The postal service delivers most parcels within three working days.
example.zh: 郵政服務大多會在三個工作天內送達包裹。

example.en: Please enter your postal code to calculate the shipping fee.
example.zh: 請輸入你的郵遞區號以計算運費。

example.en: Our postal address is printed at the bottom of the invoice.
example.zh: 我們的郵寄地址印在發票最下方。

example.en: Postal rates will rise slightly at the end of this year.
example.zh: 郵資費率會在今年年底小幅調漲。

examples.en: We chose the national postal service because it covers every region.
examples.zh: 我們選擇國家郵政服務，因為它涵蓋每個地區。

examples.en: Please send the signed contract to our postal address by Friday.
examples.zh: 請在星期五前把簽好的合約寄到我們的郵寄地址。

examples.en: Postal fees are shown at checkout before you pay for the order.
examples.zh: 郵資會在結帳時、付款前顯示出來。

confusable.diff: postal 是形容詞（郵政的）；postage 是名詞（郵資）。
confusable.usage: postage 是不可數名詞，不加 s；postal 要接在名詞前面，如 postal fee。

example.en: The postage for this parcel is lower than the courier fee.
example.zh: 這個包裹的郵資比快遞費低。

confusable.diff: portal 是「入口網站」，拼法接近但和郵政無關。

example.en: Customers can track their orders through our online portal.
example.zh: 客戶可以透過我們的線上入口網站追蹤訂單。

similar.diff: courier 是民間快遞，通常比郵局快但較貴；postal 指郵政系統。

example.en: We use a courier for urgent documents that must arrive tomorrow.
example.zh: 必須明天送到的急件，我們使用快遞。

similar.diff: mailing address 與 postal address 意思相近，美式英文更常說 mailing address。

example.en: Please confirm your mailing address before we ship the order.
example.zh: 在我們出貨前，請確認你的郵寄地址。

example.en: The mail usually arrives at our office before ten o'clock.
example.zh: 郵件通常在十點前送到我們辦公室。

example.en: The parcel was delivered to the wrong address yesterday.
example.zh: 包裹昨天被送到錯誤的地址。

example.en: The next shipment will leave the warehouse on Thursday.
example.zh: 下一批貨會在星期四離開倉庫。

example.en: Free delivery applies to orders over fifty dollars.
example.zh: 訂單滿五十美元可享免費配送。

derived.link: postal 的詞幹。post + -al，變成「與郵政有關的」，像 national、final。
post + -age，表示「郵寄的費用」，像 package、storage。
post（張貼）+ -er，被貼出來的東西，像 printer、folder。

extra_vocab.en: how possible and practical it is to do something
extra_vocab.note: 這裡是備忘錄的主旨（Subject），用名詞片語直接點出主題：評估東南亞上市的可行性。主旨欄常省略動詞，只寫名詞片語。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: feasibility 是不可數名詞，常用 the feasibility of + N／V-ing（…的可行性），後面不直接接 to V。

example.en: The team compared the feasibilities of three possible factory sites.
example.zh: 團隊比較了三個可能設廠地點的可行性。

example.en: A feasibility study will be completed before the end of March.
example.zh: 可行性研究會在三月底前完成。

example.en: We are checking the feasibility of a second factory in Vietnam.
example.zh: 我們正在評估在越南設第二間工廠的可行性。

example.en: The engineers will assess the feasibility of the new design.
example.zh: 工程師會評估新設計的可行性。

example.en: Technical feasibility is our biggest concern for this project.
example.zh: 技術可行性是這個專案我們最擔心的問題。

examples.en: Let's discuss the feasibility of launching the product this autumn.
examples.zh: 我們來討論今年秋天推出產品的可行性。

examples.en: I would like your opinion on the feasibility of this schedule.
examples.zh: 我想聽聽你對這個時程可行性的意見。

examples.en: The report raises doubts about the feasibility of the original budget.
examples.zh: 這份報告對原本預算的可行性提出了質疑。

confusable.diff: possibility 是「有可能發生」；feasibility 是「實際上做不做得到、划不划算」。

example.en: There is a possibility that the supplier will raise prices.
example.zh: 供應商有可能會調漲價格。

similar.diff: viability 強調能否持續經營或獲利；feasibility 強調做不做得到。

example.en: The viability of the new brand depends on first year sales.
example.zh: 新品牌是否可行，取決於第一年的銷售。

similar.diff: practicality 指實際好用、容易執行，用於日常也用於計畫評估。

example.en: Some managers questioned the practicality of the new filing system.
example.zh: 一些經理質疑新歸檔系統的實用性。

example.en: Higher shipping costs reduced the profitability of the product.
example.zh: 較高的運費降低了這項產品的獲利能力。

example.en: This market has great potential for our smaller models.
example.zh: 這個市場對我們的小型機種有很大的潛力。

example.en: The analysis shows that demand is growing in cities.
example.zh: 分析顯示城市地區的需求正在成長。

derived.link: 最基礎的字。feasible 去掉 -ible，加 -ibility 就變成名詞 feasibility。
feasible 去掉 e 加 -y，像 possible → possibly。
un-（不）+ feasible，像 unable、unlikely。

items.tag: 簡報／提案：竹材結合管件推車概念產品成果簡報與客戶問答

level.why: 簡報使用 that 與 which 關係子句、although 讓步子句、Compared with 分詞片語、so 結果子句等長句，後半加入客戶問答，需整合設計理念、組裝方式、儲存測試、成本增幅、強度疑慮與顏色需求等多項資訊；干擾項多取自文中出現過的百分比與測試細節，需精確區分。

items.passage:
Linda: Good afternoon, Mr. Harris, and thank you for coming. Today I would like to report on the results of our concept development for a stroller that combines bamboo strips with aluminum tubes.

Let me begin with the design idea. Parents increasingly want products that look warm and natural, yet remain light and safe. Early feedback from parents who are outdoor enthusiasts has been especially positive. Bamboo offers a pleasing appearance, and its natural flexibility helps absorb vibration on uneven sidewalks. Fortunately, our first prototypes confirmed that the strips can be joined to the tubes with simple metal connectors, so no special tools are needed during assembly.

Now, about the test results. After four weeks of storage in a humid room, only two percent of the strips showed any change in shape, which is evident from the photos on this slide. Based on these results, we recommend treating all strips before delivery.

Next, let me turn to cost. Compared with a full aluminum frame, the bamboo version would raise material costs by about eight percent, although a higher selling price could more than cover the difference. That concludes my report, and I would be glad to take your questions.

Mr. Harris: Thank you, Linda. The design looks promising, but I am concerned about long term strength. How do you know the bamboo will not crack under heavy use?

Linda: That is a fair question. We ran loading tests equal to three years of daily use, and no cracks appeared at the joints.

Mr. Harris: I see. And would other colors be possible? Our sales team has shown great enthusiasm for a darker finish.

Linda: Yes, the surface can be stained in several shades, and we will send color samples by the end of the month.
items.zh:
琳達：哈里斯先生，午安，謝謝您蒞臨。今天我想報告我們針對一款結合竹片與鋁管的嬰兒推車所進行的概念開發成果。

讓我先從設計構想說起。家長越來越想要外觀溫暖自然，同時又輕巧安全的產品。喜愛戶外活動的家長所給的早期回饋特別正面。竹子外觀討喜，而且它天然的柔韌性有助於吸收不平人行道上的震動。幸運的是，我們的第一批試作品證實，竹片可以用簡單的金屬接頭與管件結合，因此組裝時不需要任何特殊工具。

接著談測試結果。在潮濕的房間存放四週後，只有百分之二的竹片出現形狀變化，從這張投影片上的照片就能明顯看出。根據這些結果，我們建議所有竹片在出貨前都要經過處理。

接下來談成本。與全鋁車架相比，竹材版本的材料成本會增加約百分之八，不過較高的售價足以彌補這個差額。我的報告到此結束，我很樂意回答您的問題。

哈里斯先生：謝謝你，琳達。這個設計看起來很有潛力，但我擔心長期使用的強度。你怎麼確定竹子在大量使用下不會裂開？

琳達：這問題問得好。我們做了相當於三年每日使用量的負荷測試，接合處沒有出現任何裂痕。

哈里斯先生：我明白了。那有可能做其他顏色嗎？我們的業務團隊對深色的表面處理很感興趣。

琳達：可以，表面可以染成多種色調，我們會在月底前寄出色樣。

vocab.col: fortunately for us / fortunately, there is

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the presentation?
opts: To propose a new factory location
To report the results of a concept development for a bamboo stroller
To announce a price increase to the client
To train staff to assemble strollers
why: 錯誤：簡報中完全沒有提到工廠地點。
正解：琳達報告結合竹片與鋁管的嬰兒推車概念開發成果。
錯誤：成本增加是簡報其中一個部分，並不是向客戶宣布漲價。
錯誤：簡報只說明組裝不需要特殊工具，並非訓練員工。

questions.q: According to Linda, why is the assembly process simple?
opts: The bamboo strips arrive already cut to length.
The tubes are made of lightweight plastic.
The strips are glued directly to the tubes.
Simple metal connectors can join the parts without special tools.
why: 錯誤：文中沒有說竹片已經預先裁切好。
錯誤：文中說的是鋁管，不是塑膠管。
錯誤：竹片是用金屬接頭與管件結合，不是用膠黏合。
正解：竹片可用簡單的金屬接頭與管件結合，組裝時不需要特殊工具。

questions.q: What was found after four weeks of storage in a humid room?
opts: Only a small portion of the strips changed shape.
Eight percent of the strips changed shape.
The strips no longer needed any treatment.
The metal connectors had lost their color.
why: 正解：只有百分之二的竹片出現形狀變化，屬於很小的比例。
錯誤：百分之八是材料成本增加的幅度，不是形狀改變的比例。
錯誤：講者仍建議所有竹片在出貨前都要經過處理。
錯誤：文中沒有提到金屬接頭褪色。

questions.q: What is Mr. Harris concerned about?
opts: The look of the stroller on uneven sidewalks
The strength of the bamboo after long use
The delivery schedule of the color samples
why: 錯誤：哈里斯先生沒有對售價提出疑慮。
錯誤：不平的人行道是說明竹子柔韌性能吸震的例子，不是他的疑慮。
正解：他擔心竹子在長期大量使用下是否會裂開，也就是強度問題。
錯誤：色樣是琳達承諾月底前寄出，並不是他擔心的事。

questions.q: The proposal was ______ by the committee after a long discussion.
why: 錯誤：was 後面不能接原形動詞。
正解：被動語態 was approved by 表示「被核准」，用過去分詞。
錯誤：approving 是現在分詞，會變成進行式，語意是「正在核准」，與 by the committee 不合。
錯誤：approval 是名詞，不能接在 was 之後構成被動語態。

questions.q: ______ the presentation had ended, several clients stayed to ask questions.
why: 錯誤：During 是介系詞，後面不能接完整子句。
錯誤：Despite 是介系詞，後面不能接完整子句，且語意不合。
錯誤：Unless 表示「除非」，不符合時間先後關係。
正解：After 是連接詞，引導時間子句，表示「簡報結束後」。

questions.q: Neither the client ______ the consultant had seen the final report before the meeting.
why: 正解：Neither … nor … 是固定搭配，表示「兩者都不」。
錯誤：or 要搭配 either，不能與 neither 搭配。
錯誤：and 不能與 neither 搭配，語意也不符。
錯誤：but 不能與 neither 搭配成否定並列結構。

questions.q: The team is ______ to present its findings at next week's conference.
why: 錯誤：is 之後不能直接接原形動詞。
錯誤：scheduling 是現在分詞，主動語意不符，團隊是被安排的對象。
正解：be scheduled to 表示「預定要…」，用過去分詞構成被動。
錯誤：schedules 是第三人稱單數形式，不能接在 is 之後。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Today I would like to report on ...
presentation_phrases.usage: 簡報開場，說明這次報告的主題與目的。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Let me begin with ...
presentation_phrases.usage: 進入第一個主要段落，例如設計構想或背景。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Now, about the test results.
presentation_phrases.usage: 從一個主題轉換到下一個主題，提示聽眾重點改變。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Based on these results, we recommend ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 根據這些結果，我們建議…
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明數據之後提出具體建議。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Next, let me turn to cost.
presentation_phrases.usage: 轉到下一個要點，引出下一段說明。

presentation_phrases.phrase: That concludes my report.
presentation_phrases.usage: 簡報結尾，表示正式報告已完成。

presentation_phrases.phrase: I would be glad to take your questions.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我很樂意回答各位的問題。
presentation_phrases.usage: 邀請聽眾提問，進入問答。

presentation_phrases.phrase: That is a fair question.
presentation_phrases.usage: 回答客戶提問前的緩衝語，表示認同這個疑慮。

extra_vocab.en: a person who really loves a certain activity or subject
extra_vocab.note: outdoor enthusiasts 指熱愛戶外活動的人。Linda 用它說明早期回饋來自目標客群中的重度使用者，所以正面評價很有參考價值。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「領域 + enthusiast」是常見組合（car enthusiast）；enthusiast 是人，可數；熱情本身是 enthusiasm，不可數。

example.en: Many enthusiasts attend the annual trade show to see new models.
example.zh: 許多愛好者參加年度貿易展，一睹新機型。

example.en: Outdoor enthusiasts tested the new tent for two weeks.
example.zh: 戶外活動愛好者測試這頂新帳篷兩週。

example.en: As a technology enthusiast, he always buys the latest gadgets.
example.zh: 身為科技愛好者，他總是買最新的小工具。

example.en: The show attracts thousands of car enthusiasts every spring.
example.zh: 這場展覽每年春天吸引數千名汽車愛好者。

examples.en: We want to reach fitness enthusiasts through online communities.
examples.zh: 我們想透過線上社群接觸健身愛好者。

examples.en: Early buyers are often enthusiasts who enjoy trying new products.
examples.zh: 早期購買者通常是喜歡嘗試新產品的愛好者。

examples.en: The trade show welcomed coffee enthusiasts from many countries.
examples.zh: 這場貿易展歡迎來自許多國家的咖啡愛好者。

confusable.diff: enthusiast 是「人」；enthusiasm 是「熱情」這種感受。
confusable.usage: enthusiast 是可數名詞（an enthusiast）；enthusiasm 是不可數名詞，不加 a。

example.en: The team showed great enthusiasm for the new design.
example.zh: 團隊對新設計展現出很大的熱情。

similar.diff: fan 更口語，常指「迷」；enthusiast 比較中性，也常用於專業嗜好。

example.en: She is a big fan of our brand's new line.
example.zh: 她是我們品牌新系列的忠實粉絲。

similar.diff: hobbyist 指把空閒時間投入嗜好的業餘者，不一定像 enthusiast 那麼狂熱。

example.en: Many hobbyists buy bamboo to make their own furniture.
example.zh: 許多嗜好者買竹子來自己做家具。

example.en: An expert reviewed the strength test before the launch.
example.zh: 一位專家在上市前審閱了強度測試。

example.en: Our supporters helped us test the first prototype.
example.zh: 我們的支持者幫忙測試了第一個原型。

example.en: Consumers are paying more attention to natural materials.
example.zh: 消費者越來越注意天然材質。

derived.link: enthusiast（人）→ enthusiasm（感受），像 optimist → optimism。
enthusiast + -ic，變成形容詞，像 artist → artistic。
enthusiastic + -ally，變成副詞，像 basic → basically。
un-（不）+ enthusiastic，像 unclear、unhappy。

extra_vocab.en: the ability to bend easily, or to change when needed
extra_vocab.note: 本篇指竹材天然的柔韌性，讓它能吸收不平人行道的震動，是產品的一項賣點。這裡是「材料特性」的意思，不是安排上的彈性。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: flexibility 是不可數名詞，不加 s；常說 flexibility in + N（在…方面的彈性）。

example.en: This contract offers flexibility if our order volume changes.
example.zh: 如果我們的訂購量改變，這份合約提供了彈性。

example.en: We need more flexibility in scheduling during the busy season.
example.zh: 旺季時，我們在排程上需要更多彈性。

example.en: Remote work gives employees greater flexibility in planning their day.
example.zh: 遠距工作讓員工在安排一天時有更大的彈性。

example.en: The supplier's lack of flexibility caused several delivery problems.
example.zh: 供應商缺乏彈性，造成了幾次交貨問題。

examples.en: The flexibility of the material helps it handle daily use.
examples.zh: 這種材料的柔韌性使它能承受日常使用。

examples.en: Many applicants value flexibility more than a higher salary.
examples.zh: 許多應徵者重視彈性勝過更高的薪水。

examples.en: Our supplier showed flexibility when we changed the delivery date.
examples.zh: 我們更改交貨日期時，供應商展現了彈性。

confusable.diff: 拼法結尾相似；feasibility 是「可行性」，flexibility 是「彈性」。

example.en: The feasibility of the plan depends on our budget.
example.zh: 這項計畫的可行性取決於我們的預算。

similar.diff: adaptability 強調能適應新環境或改變，多用在人或組織；flexibility 也可指材料能彎曲。

example.en: Her adaptability helped the team handle the sudden schedule change.
example.zh: 她的適應力幫助團隊處理突然的時程變動。

similar.diff: versatility 指用途多樣、一物多用；flexibility 指能彎曲或能調整。

example.en: Customers like the versatility of this compact tool set.
example.zh: 客戶喜歡這套小型工具組的多功能。

example.en: The test measured the strength of the joints.
example.zh: 這項測試量測了接合處的強度。

example.en: Durability is the main reason customers choose this brand.
example.zh: 耐用性是客戶選擇這個品牌的主要原因。

example.en: The company's adaptability kept it strong during the crisis.
example.zh: 公司的適應力讓它在危機中保持強勢。

derived.link: 最基礎的字，指「彎一彎」，字根是 flex（彎）。
flex + -ible，「能被彎」的，像 possible、visible。
flexible 去掉 e 加 -y，像 possible → possibly。
in-（不）+ flexible，像 incorrect、inactive。
inflexible 去掉 -ible 加 -ibility，變成名詞。

senses.en: the ability of a material to bend without breaking
senses.distinguish: 談材料、產品特性時，指能彎曲而不斷。

example.en: Bamboo is popular because of its strength and natural flexibility.
example.zh: 竹子因其強度和天然的柔韌性而受歡迎。

senses.en: the ability to change plans or ways of working
senses.distinguish: 談時程、合約、工作方式時，指可以調整。

example.en: The new policy gives staff more flexibility in working hours.
example.zh: 新政策讓員工在工作時間上有更多彈性。

extra_vocab.en: in a lucky way; used to say something good happened
extra_vocab.note: 放在句首，表示「幸好」，後面是對團隊有利的好消息：原型證實竹條可以用簡單的金屬接頭固定。語氣正面，用來帶出簡報的好結果。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: fortunately 是修飾整句的副詞，放句首後面加逗號，再接完整子句；不能直接接名詞。

example.en: Fortunately for us, the supplier agreed to extend the deadline.
example.zh: 對我們來說很幸運，供應商同意延長期限。

example.en: Fortunately, no one was injured when the shelf fell in the warehouse.
example.zh: 幸好倉庫的架子倒下時沒有人受傷。

examples.en: Fortunately, the missing files were found on the shared drive.
examples.zh: 幸好遺失的檔案在共用磁碟中找到了。

examples.en: Fortunately, the delay did not affect our final delivery date.
examples.zh: 幸好這次延誤沒有影響到我們的最終交貨日。

examples.en: Fortunately, the damaged item was covered by the warranty.
examples.zh: 幸好受損的商品在保固範圍內。

confusable.diff: 意思相反，表示「很遺憾、可惜」，用來帶出壞消息。

example.en: Unfortunately, the supplier cannot deliver the parts before next Friday.
example.zh: 很遺憾，供應商無法在下週五前交貨。

similar.diff: luckily 更口語；fortunately 比較正式，常用在書面和簡報。

example.en: Luckily, our flight arrived early and we reached the meeting on time.
example.zh: 幸好我們的班機提早抵達，我們準時趕到會議。

similar.diff: thankfully 帶有「鬆一口氣」的感覺，情緒比 fortunately 更強。

example.en: Thankfully, the server problem was fixed before the customers noticed.
example.zh: 謝天謝地，伺服器問題在客戶發現前就修好了。

example.en: We had some luck finding a supplier on short notice.
example.zh: 我們運氣不錯，臨時找到了一家供應商。

example.en: This meeting is a good chance to present our ideas.
example.zh: 這場會議是展現我們想法的好機會。

example.en: Low shipping costs give us an advantage over competitors.
example.zh: 低運費讓我們比競爭對手更有優勢。

derived.link: 最基礎的字。fortune 是「運氣、財富」，加 -ate 變形容詞。
fortune + -ate，變成「有好運的」，像 moderate、accurate。
un-（不）+ fortunate，像 unfair、unclear。
unfortunate + -ly，變成副詞，用來帶出壞消息。

extra_vocab.en: easy to see or understand
extra_vocab.note: which is evident from the photos on this slide 指「從這張投影片的照片就能清楚看出」，是簡報中引導聽眾看圖、確認結果的常用說法。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 常用 be evident from + N（從…看得出來）或 It is evident that + 子句；from 後面接證據來源。

example.en: The problem became evident when sales fell for three months.
example.zh: 當銷售連續三個月下滑，問題就變得明顯了。

example.en: The improvement is evident from the latest customer survey.
example.zh: 從最新的客戶調查可以明顯看出改善。

collocations.phrase: It is evident that + 子句

example.en: It is evident that customers prefer a simpler ordering process.
example.zh: 很明顯，客戶比較喜歡更簡單的訂購流程。

example.en: The damage was clearly evident when we opened the box.
example.zh: 我們打開箱子時，損壞清楚可見。

examples.en: The growth in online sales is evident from this chart.
examples.zh: 從這張圖表可以明顯看出網路銷售的成長。

examples.en: It was evident that the team needed more time.
examples.zh: 很明顯，團隊需要更多時間。

examples.en: A clear drop in quality is evident in the second batch.
examples.zh: 第二批貨的品質明顯下降。

confusable.diff: evidence 是名詞「證據」；evident 是形容詞「明顯的」。
confusable.usage: evidence 是不可數名詞，不加 s（some evidence，不說 an evidence）；evident 是形容詞，修飾事情或補語。

example.en: We need more evidence before we change the supplier.
example.zh: 在更換供應商前，我們需要更多證據。

confusable.diff: incident 是「事件」，拼法結尾相似，意思無關。

example.en: The safety incident was reported to the manager immediately.
example.zh: 這起安全事件立刻被通報給經理。

similar.diff: obvious 較口語，指一看就知道；evident 較正式，常有證據可看，如 evident from…。

example.en: The reason for the delay was obvious to everyone.
example.zh: 延誤的原因對每個人都很明顯。

similar.diff: apparent 也是「明顯的」，但有時指「表面上看起來」，不一定是事實。

example.en: It soon became apparent that the schedule was too tight.
example.zh: 很快就能明顯看出，這個時程太緊了。

example.en: The company name is clearly visible on the front of the box.
example.zh: 公司名稱清楚顯示在盒子正面。

example.en: There was a noticeable change in sales after the new ad.
example.zh: 新廣告推出後，銷售有明顯的變化。

example.en: Please send proof of payment with your request.
example.zh: 請隨申請附上付款證明。

derived.link: evident 去掉 -ent 加 -ence，像 different → difference、silent → silence。
evident + -ly，變成副詞，像 recent → recently。

extra_vocab.en: a strong feeling of interest and excitement about something
extra_vocab.note: show great enthusiasm for 表示「對…表現出很大的興趣」。Mr. Harris 用它說明業務團隊很期待深色塗裝，是在提出客戶端的正面需求。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: enthusiasm 是不可數名詞，不加 a；後面常接 for／about + N 或 V-ing，如 show enthusiasm for the plan。

example.en: Several customers showed enthusiasm for the new color options.
example.zh: 好幾位客戶對新的顏色選項表現出熱情。

example.en: The staff welcomed the new project with great enthusiasm.
example.zh: 員工以極大的熱情迎接新專案。

example.en: A lack of enthusiasm among staff slowed down the training program.
example.zh: 員工缺乏熱情，拖慢了訓練計畫。

example.en: She answered every question with enthusiasm during the interview.
example.zh: 面試時，她熱情地回答每個問題。

examples.en: The manager's enthusiasm helped everyone feel confident about the launch.
examples.zh: 經理的熱情讓大家對上市更有信心。

examples.en: We are looking for someone with experience and real enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 我們正在找有經驗又真正有熱忱的人。

examples.en: Customer enthusiasm for the demo exceeded our expectations.
examples.zh: 客戶對展示的熱烈反應超出我們的預期。

confusable.diff: enthusiasm 是熱情這種感受；enthusiast 是有這種熱情的「人」。
confusable.usage: enthusiasm 不可數、不加 a；enthusiast 是可數名詞，如 an enthusiast。

example.en: Every enthusiast at the show wanted to try the new model.
example.zh: 展會上的每位愛好者都想試用新機型。

similar.diff: passion 比 enthusiasm 更強烈、更深入，常指長期的熱愛。

example.en: His passion for design shows in every product he creates.
example.zh: 他對設計的熱愛體現在他做的每一項產品上。

similar.diff: eagerness 強調急著想做某件事；enthusiasm 強調興趣與興奮感。

example.en: The team's eagerness to start made the kickoff meeting short.
example.zh: 團隊急著想開始，使啟動會議很短。

example.en: Many buyers have shown interest in our new product line.
example.zh: 許多買家對我們的新產品線表示有興趣。

example.en: Clear goals can improve the motivation of the whole team.
example.zh: 明確的目標可以提升整個團隊的幹勁。

example.en: We appreciate your commitment to meeting the deadline.
example.zh: 我們感謝你為趕上期限所做的投入。

derived.link: enthusiasm（熱情）→ enthusiast（有熱情的人），像 optimism → optimist。
enthusiasm 的形容詞，像 artist → artistic，常說 be enthusiastic about + N。
enthusiastic + -ally，變成副詞，像 basic → basically。
un-（不）+ enthusiastic，像 unclear、unhappy。

items.tag: 臨時助理徵選與休息室電器規定備忘錄

level.why: 以 although、because、provided that 等連接詞組成的複合句，搭配被動語態與分詞修飾（applications received by…），並出現 prerequisite、certify 等較抽象的字彙；需整合職缺條件、推薦管道與休息室電器新規兩個主題的資訊，難度與上週同日相當。

items.passage:
To: All Department Managers
From: Maria Lopez, Office Administration
Subject: Temporary Assistant Position and Break Room Appliances

We are looking for a temporary assistant to support the front office during the busy season. Interested applicants should submit a resume and a cover letter explaining why they are suited to the role, and applications received by the end of next week will be reviewed first. Although experience in an office is helpful, the only prerequisite is a working knowledge of our scheduling software. Alternatively, current employees may recommend a candidate, provided that the recommendation is sent to me in confidence.

Please also note a change affecting the break room. Because several circuits were overloaded last month, personal appliances may no longer be plugged in without written consent from the facilities office. The facilities team will certify each appliance, and any that fail the inspection will have to be taken home.
items.zh:
收件人：全體部門主管
寄件人：瑪麗亞・羅培茲，行政管理部
主旨：臨時助理職缺與休息室電器

我們正在尋找一位臨時助理，在旺季期間協助前台工作。有意應徵者請提交履歷與一封說明自己為何適任的求職信，而下週結束前收到的申請將優先審閱。雖然有辦公室工作經驗會有幫助，但唯一的必要條件是對我們的排程軟體有實際操作的知識。另外，現職員工也可以推薦人選，前提是推薦資料須以保密方式寄給我。

也請留意一項影響休息室的變更。由於上個月有數個電路超載，個人電器今後未經總務處書面同意，不得再插電使用。總務團隊將會檢驗並認證每一件電器，未通過檢查的電器必須帶回家。

vocab.col: submit a resume / update your resume

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the memo?
opts: To report an electrical accident in the break room
To announce a temporary job opening and a new appliance rule
To ask managers to hire several full-time employees
To explain how to use the scheduling software
why: 錯誤：文中只提到上個月電路超載，並沒有報告任何電氣意外。
正解：備忘錄先徵求臨時助理，再說明休息室個人電器的新規定。
錯誤：職缺是「臨時」助理，而且文中沒有要求主管招募全職員工。
錯誤：排程軟體只是應徵條件之一，備忘錄並未說明它的使用方式。

questions.q: What is required of people who apply for the position?
opts: A recommendation from a department manager
Several years of experience in an office
why: 錯誤：推薦是現職員工可選擇的另一種管道，並不是所有應徵者都必須具備。
錯誤：電器檢查由總務團隊負責，與應徵資格無關。
錯誤：文中說辦公室經驗「有幫助」，但並非必要條件。
正解：文中指出唯一的必要條件是對排程軟體有實際操作的知識。

questions.q: What will happen to a personal appliance that fails the inspection?
opts: It will have to be taken home.
It will be repaired by the facilities team.
It will be stored in the break room.
It will be replaced at the company's expense.
why: 正解：文末說明未通過檢查的電器必須帶回家。
錯誤：總務團隊只負責檢驗與認證，文中沒有提到維修。
錯誤：未通過檢查的電器不能留在休息室使用，文中也沒有提到存放。
錯誤：文中沒有說公司會出錢替換任何電器。

questions.q: Applicants must submit all of their documents ______ Friday at noon.
why: 錯誤：during 後面接一段期間，表示事情發生在該期間內，不能接特定時間點。
錯誤：until 用於持續到某時間點的狀態，submit 是一次性動作，不適合搭配。
正解：by 表示「在…之前（最遲到）」，by Friday at noon 即截止時間。
錯誤：since 表示「自從」，需搭配完成式，語意不符。

questions.q: Please contact the human resources office if you have any ______ about the application process.
why: 錯誤：inquire 是動詞，不能放在 any 之後當名詞使用。
正解：any 後面需接名詞，inquiries 是 inquiry 的複數，意為「詢問」。
錯誤：inquiring 是現在分詞或形容詞，不能直接當 have 的受詞。
錯誤：inquired 是動詞過去式或過去分詞，不能當名詞。

questions.q: The new safety rule applies to all electrical ______ brought into the office from home.
why: 正解：all 後面接複數名詞，appliances 意為「電器」，也符合「從家裡帶來」的語意。
錯誤：appliance 是單數，不能接在 all 之後。
錯誤：applicants 是「應徵者」，拼法相近但語意不符，人不是「被帶進辦公室的電器」。
錯誤：application 是單數名詞（申請），不符合 all 與 electrical 的搭配。

extra_vocab.en: a short document that lists your education, jobs, and skills
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，submit a resume and a cover letter 指應徵者要把履歷與求職信一起交給行政部。resume 是美式英語常用的「履歷」，英式多說 CV；注意動詞 resume（重新開始）拼法相同，但發音與重音不同。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: resume 當「履歷」是可數名詞，單數前要加 a（a resume），不能直接寫 resume 而不加冠詞。

example.en: We received more than forty resumes for the temporary assistant job.
example.zh: 我們為這個臨時助理職缺收到了四十多份履歷。

example.en: Production resumes on Monday once the new machine is installed.
example.zh: 新機器安裝完成後，生產將在星期一恢復。

example.en: Service resumed at nine o'clock after the network repair was finished.
example.zh: 網路修復完成後，服務在九點恢復。

example.en: We are resuming the discussion right after a short lunch break.
example.zh: 我們會在短暫的午休後立刻繼續討論。

example.en: Candidates must submit a resume through the company website.
example.zh: 應徵者必須透過公司網站提交履歷。

example.en: Please update your resume before the job fair next week.
example.zh: 請在下週的就業博覽會之前更新你的履歷。

example.en: Remember to attach a resume to your online application form.
example.zh: 記得在線上申請表附上履歷。

examples.en: Please bring a printed copy of your resume to the interview.
examples.zh: 請帶一份列印好的履歷來參加面試。

examples.en: Her resume shows five years of experience in customer service.
examples.zh: 她的履歷顯示她有五年的客服經驗。

examples.en: A clear one-page resume makes a strong first impression on recruiters.
examples.zh: 一份清楚的單頁履歷能給招募人員良好的第一印象。

confusable.diff: assume 是動詞，意思是「假定、認為」；resume 當名詞是履歷，當動詞是「重新開始」，兩字拼法與字尾相近。

example.en: We assume every applicant will attach a resume to the form.
example.zh: 我們假定每位應徵者都會在表格上附上履歷。

similar.diff: CV 是 curriculum vitae 的縮寫，英式英語常用，內容通常比 resume 更完整；resume 在美式英語較常見。

example.en: Applicants in Europe often send a CV instead of a resume.
example.zh: 歐洲的應徵者常寄 CV 而不是 resume。

example.en: The final candidate has ten years of experience in logistics.
example.zh: 最後一位人選有十年的物流經驗。

example.en: Each applicant must complete the online form before Friday.
example.zh: 每位應徵者必須在星期五前填完線上表格。

example.en: Her qualifications make her an ideal choice for the manager position.
example.zh: 她的資歷讓她成為經理職位的理想人選。

example.en: Please list two professional references at the bottom of your resume.
example.zh: 請在履歷底部列出兩位專業推薦人。

example.en: She updated her resume before applying for the senior position.
example.zh: 她在應徵資深職位前更新了履歷。

example.en: Work on the new building will resume after the holiday weekend.
example.zh: 新大樓的工程將在連假後恢復進行。

extra_vocab.en: a machine used in a home or office, such as a refrigerator
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，Break Room Appliances 指休息室裡員工自備的電器（如咖啡機、微波爐），因為可能造成電路過載，所以需要經同意與檢驗。appliance 是「物品」，不要和 applicant（人：應徵者）搞混。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: appliance 是可數名詞（an appliance、appliances）；表示「設備」的 equipment 才是不可數名詞，不能寫成 equipments。

example.en: Energy-efficient appliances can reduce a building's electricity costs significantly.
example.zh: 節能電器可以大幅降低大樓的電費。

example.en: Do not leave any electrical appliance running overnight in the office.
example.zh: 請不要讓任何電器在辦公室整晚運轉。

example.en: The store offers a ten percent discount on every kitchen appliance.
example.zh: 這家店的每一件廚房電器都打九折。

example.en: Sales of household appliances rose during the holiday season.
example.zh: 家用電器的銷售額在假期期間上升。

example.en: The appliance store on Main Street is hiring two sales assistants.
example.zh: 主街上的電器行正在徵兩位銷售助理。

examples.en: Please unplug all appliances in the break room before you leave.
examples.zh: 離開前，請把休息室裡所有電器的插頭拔掉。

examples.en: The new refrigerator is the most expensive appliance on our budget list.
examples.zh: 新冰箱是我們預算清單上最貴的電器。

examples.en: Any appliance with a damaged cord must be reported to facilities.
examples.zh: 任何電線受損的電器都必須通報總務部門。

confusable.diff: 兩字都以 appli- 開頭，且都是名詞；appliance 是「物品（電器）」，字尾 -ance，applicant 是「人（應徵者）」，字尾 -ant，像 assistant、participant。

example.en: The applicant asked whether she could bring her own appliance to the office.
example.zh: 這位應徵者問她能否把自己的電器帶到辦公室。

confusable.diff: application 是「申請（書）」或「應用程式」，不是實體電器；appliance 是你可以插電使用的機器。

example.en: The application form asks which appliance you plan to bring.
example.zh: 申請表會詢問你打算帶哪一種電器。

similar.diff: device 多指手機、平板等小型電子裝置；appliance 多指微波爐、咖啡機等較大的家用或辦公電器。

example.en: Employees may charge their personal devices at the front desk.
example.zh: 員工可以在前台為個人裝置充電。

example.en: The company provides all the equipment needed for the project.
example.zh: 公司提供這個專案所需的所有設備。

example.en: The coffee machine in the break room is out of order.
example.zh: 休息室的咖啡機故障了。

example.en: Please plug the printer into the outlet near the window.
example.zh: 請把印表機插到窗邊的插座上。

example.en: Too many machines on one circuit can cause a power failure.
example.zh: 同一條電路上接太多機器可能導致停電。

derived.link: 最基礎的詞幹；appliance 是 appl(y→i) + -ance，像 rely → reliance
apply 變成 applic- 再加 -ant，做事的人，像 assistant、participant
applic- + -ation，把「申請」變成名詞，像 inform → information
applic- + -able，可以…的，像 comfortable、available

extra_vocab.en: permission that someone gives for something to happen
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，written consent from the facilities office 指個人電器要先取得總務處的書面同意才能插電。consent 比 permission 更正式，常用在合約、公告與法律文件。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: consent 當名詞時是不可數，不加 a；當動詞用 consent to + 名詞，如 consent to the changes。

example.en: Our client rarely consents to changes without a written explanation.
example.zh: 我們的客戶很少在沒有書面說明的情況下同意變更。

example.en: The landlord consented to the renovation plan last Friday.
example.zh: 房東上週五同意了這個整修計畫。

example.en: Consenting to the new terms means accepting every condition listed.
example.zh: 同意新條款就表示接受所列的每一項條件。

example.en: Photos cannot be published without the employee's written consent.
example.zh: 未經員工書面同意，不得發布照片。

example.en: Parents must give consent before students join the trip.
example.zh: 學生參加旅行前，家長必須表示同意。

example.en: We must obtain consent before sharing customers' personal data.
example.zh: 分享客戶個人資料前，我們必須取得同意。

example.en: The plan was approved with the consent of all board members.
example.zh: 這項計畫經全體董事同意後獲得通過。

examples.en: Neither party may transfer the agreement without the other's consent.
examples.zh: 未經對方同意，任何一方都不得轉讓這份協議。

examples.en: Employees need their manager's consent before taking extra vacation days.
examples.zh: 員工在多請休假前需要經理的同意。

examples.en: Customer records may be shared only with the owner's consent.
examples.zh: 客戶紀錄只有在本人同意下才能分享。

confusable.diff: content 是「內容」（也可當形容詞「滿意的」），重音在第一音節；consent 是「同意」，重音在第二音節。

example.en: The content of the memo was approved by management.
example.zh: 這份備忘錄的內容已獲管理階層核准。

confusable.diff: consensus 是「共識」，指一群人的意見一致；consent 是某人表示「同意、許可」。

example.en: The committee reached a consensus after two hours of discussion.
example.zh: 委員會討論了兩個小時後達成共識。

similar.diff: permission 較口語、中性，常用 ask for permission；consent 更正式，常用於書面與法律情境。

example.en: You need permission from your supervisor to leave early today.
example.zh: 你今天提早離開需要主管的許可。

similar.diff: approval 強調計畫或申請被上級審查後「核准」；consent 強調當事人表示「同意」。

example.en: The budget still requires approval from the finance department.
example.zh: 這筆預算仍需要財務部門的核准。

example.en: Both companies signed the agreement on Monday morning.
example.zh: 兩家公司在星期一早上簽署了協議。

example.en: Company policy does not permit smoking inside the building.
example.zh: 公司規定不允許在大樓內吸菸。

example.en: Only managers can authorize payments over one thousand dollars.
example.zh: 只有主管能批准超過一千美元的付款。

example.en: Your request for extra equipment has been forwarded to purchasing.
example.zh: 你要求額外設備的申請已轉交採購部門。

example.en: The tenant needs the owner's consent to change the lighting.
example.zh: 房客更換照明需要屋主的同意。

example.en: The union will not consent to longer working hours.
example.zh: 工會不會同意延長工時。

extra_vocab.en: to officially say that something is true or meets a standard
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，The facilities team will certify each appliance 指總務團隊會檢查每件個人電器，確認合格後才能在休息室使用。certify 帶有「經正式檢驗後出具認可」的語感，常見於安全、品質與資格。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: certify 後面可直接接受詞，或接 that 子句；表示「經認證的」要用過去分詞 certified，如 a certified electrician。

example.en: The inspector certifies each machine before it enters the production line.
example.zh: 檢查員會先認證每台機器，才讓它進入生產線。

example.en: The laboratory certified the new product as safe for children.
example.zh: 實驗室認證了這項新產品對兒童是安全的。

example.en: All of our trainers are certified first aid instructors.
example.zh: 我們所有的訓練員都是經認證的急救教官。

example.en: Certifying every supplier takes about two weeks, so please submit early.
example.zh: 認證每家供應商大約要兩週，所以請提早提交。

example.en: The manager must certify that all figures are accurate.
example.zh: 經理必須證明所有數字都是正確的。

example.en: Please submit a certified copy of your university degree.
example.zh: 請提交你的大學學位認證副本。

example.en: Send the contract by certified mail so we have proof of delivery.
example.zh: 請用掛號寄送合約，這樣我們才有送達證明。

example.en: Our technicians are certified as safety inspectors by the national board.
example.zh: 我們的技術人員由國家委員會認證為安全檢查員。

examples.en: Only licensed electricians may certify electrical work in this building.
examples.zh: 在這棟大樓裡，只有持照電工可以認證電路工程。

examples.en: We hired an outside firm to certify our safety procedures.
examples.zh: 我們聘請外部公司來認證我們的安全程序。

examples.en: The auditor will certify the annual accounts by the end of March.
examples.zh: 稽核員會在三月底前認證年度帳目。

confusable.diff: certain 是形容詞，意思是「確定的」；certify 是動詞，意思是「認證」。兩字前半拼法相同。
confusable.usage: certain 是形容詞（be certain that…），certify 是動詞（certify that…）。

example.en: I am certain that the facilities team will finish by Friday.
example.zh: 我確定總務團隊會在星期五前完成。

confusable.diff: clarify 是「澄清、說明清楚」；certify 是「正式認證」。兩字都是 -ify 結尾的動詞。

example.en: Please clarify what the new rule means before we certify the plan.
example.zh: 在我們認證這項計畫之前，請先說明這條新規定的意思。

similar.diff: verify 是檢查後「確認屬實」，語氣中性；certify 是正式出具認可或證明，較正式。

example.en: Please verify the delivery address before the package is shipped.
example.zh: 包裹寄出前，請先確認送貨地址。

similar.diff: approve 是「核准」計畫或申請；certify 是證明某物符合標準或某事屬實。

example.en: The supervisor must approve all overtime requests in advance.
example.zh: 主管必須事先核准所有加班申請。

example.en: Inspectors will inspect the kitchen equipment every six months.
example.zh: 檢查人員每六個月會檢查廚房設備。

example.en: The company guarantees every product for two full years.
example.zh: 公司為每項產品提供整整兩年的保固。

example.en: Applicants must qualify through a short written test first.
example.zh: 應徵者必須先通過一場簡短的筆試。

example.en: The new model meets every international safety standard.
example.zh: 這款新機型符合所有國際安全標準。

derived.link: certify 去掉 y 加 -ication，變成名詞，像 qualify → qualification
certif- + -icate，認證後拿到的文件，像 diploma 是畢業證書

senses.en: to officially say that a product or person meets a standard

example.en: The agency will certify the factory once it passes the audit.
example.zh: 工廠通過稽核後，主管機關就會認證它。

senses.en: to state officially that information is true
senses.distinguish: 受詞是文件、簽名或事實時，指簽署證明其真實。

example.en: The notary will certify the signatures on both copies of the contract.
example.zh: 公證人會證明合約兩份副本上的簽名屬實。

extra_vocab.en: used to give another choice or way to do something
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，Alternatively, current employees may recommend a candidate 放在句首，引出和前面「自行投遞履歷」不同的另一條途徑——現職員工可以改用推薦。alternatively 常用來提出第二個可行的選擇。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: alternatively 是副詞，不是連接詞，不能單靠它用逗號連接兩個完整句子；要用句號或分號分開，或改用 or。

example.en: Alternatively, you can call our hotline during business hours.
example.zh: 或者，你也可以在上班時間撥打我們的服務專線。
